etymology.historical_story: Chakra comes from Sanskrit cakra, meaning wheel or cycle. That circular image appears in several religious settings: a Buddhist symbol of teaching, Vishnu's discus, and representations of spiritual centres in yogic traditions. Remembering the wheel helps connect these meanings, while the surrounding religious tradition determines which interpretation is intended. [Smithsonian glossary](https://asia.si.edu/glossary/chakra/), [yoga exhibition](https://asia.si.edu/whats-on/exhibitions/yoga-the-art-of-transformation/)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读作“查克拉”，联想一只转动的轮：宗教图像中是轮形象征，瑜伽语境中是脉轮。

etymology.historical_story: Cerdik has a long documented lexicographic history: Crawfurd's nineteenth-century dictionary includes it among equivalents for “sagacious.” Modern DBP records both quick understanding and deceptive cleverness. That contrast provides a useful cultural reading: intelligence may deserve praise, but ingenuity used to trick others attracts criticism. This is a history of recorded meaning, rather than a claim about the word's ultimate origin. See [Crawfurd's dictionary](https://deriv.nls.uk/dcn23/7945/79454630.23.pdf) and [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=320368&keyword=cerdik).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 cerdik 记成“脑筋转得快”：帮人解题是聪明，用来骗人就是狡黠。

morphology.formula: kadmium → Cd（化学符号）；compact disc → CD（首字母缩写）
morphology.pattern_note: 输入 cd 合并了大小写不同的两种形式：Cd 表示镉，CD 表示光盘。两者都不涉及马来语词缀或音变；所列 IPA 对应逐字母读 CD，化学符号 Cd 通常按元素名 kadmium 读出。

senses.zh_definition: 镉的化学符号，规范写作 Cd；镉的原子序数为 48。
senses.en_definition: The chemical symbol Cd for cadmium, the element with atomic number 48.
senses.ms_definition: Simbol kimia bagi kadmium.
senses.nuances: 此义对应输入包的 Kamus Dewan 释义。Cd 是符号，词性 noun 仅表示其名词性指称功能；必须保留 C 大写、d 小写，不能与光盘 CD 混用。参见 [DBP：Cd 与 CD](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=250808&keyword=cd) 和 [英国皇家化学学会：Cadmium](https://periodic-table.rsc.org/element/48/cadmium)。

senses.zh_definition: 光盘；英语 compact disc 的缩写，指用于储存声音或其他数字数据的光学圆盘，规范写作 CD。
senses.en_definition: A compact disc: an optical disc used to store recorded sound or other digital data.
senses.ms_definition: Singkatan bagi compact disc, iaitu cakera padat.
senses.nuances: 日常媒体和电脑语境通常指此义，规范写作全大写 CD，常按英语字母名称读作 /siː diː/。此义与化学符号 Cd 不同，不应因为输入经过小写化而混为一义。参见 [DBP：Cd 与 CD](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=250808&keyword=cd)。

etymology.historical_story: Cd and CD have separate histories. Cadmium was identified in 1817 and named after cadmia, a mineral material associated with zinc. Its chemical symbol is Cd. CD instead abbreviates English compact disc. Lowercasing both expressions hides a distinction that scientific reports and everyday references to recorded music depend on. [英国皇家化学学会：Cadmium](https://periodic-table.rsc.org/element/48/cadmium)；[DBP：Cd 与 CD](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=250808&keyword=cd)。
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 听到“西—迪”先想到 CD 光盘；看到 Cd 的小写 d，就切换到化学元素“镉”。大小写帮助分义。

etymology.historical_story: Catherine belongs to the European name family associated with Greek Aikaterine, whose original meaning remains uncertain. Medieval devotion to Saint Catherine helped spread the name across languages. Its familiar association with Greek katharos, meaning pure, developed later and should not be treated as its established original meaning. See the [Dictionary of Medieval Names](https://dmnes.org/name/Katherine).

etymology.historical_story: For the biblical name, Cain represents Hebrew Qayin. Genesis connects the name with Eve's statement about acquiring a son, creating a wordplay rather than settling its historical derivation. Scholars have also discussed a possible connection with metalworking. These competing explanations should remain tentative, and they cannot automatically explain every modern surname spelled Cain. [BYU Religious Studies Center：Cain and Abel](https://rsc.byu.edu/creation-sinai/cain-abel-genesis-4-moses-5)

etymology.historical_story: The familiar Scottish surname Campbell is associated with Gaelic Caimbeul, traditionally understood as combining cam, crooked, and beul, mouth. A descriptive byname thus became an inherited family name. This historical explanation concerns the surname's background, not a modern bearer's appearance or character, and it is not a Malay morphological analysis. See [Clan Campbell Society](https://www.ccsna.org/clan-campbell-history).

etymology.historical_story: Charlotte developed in French as a feminine diminutive related to Charles and later spread into other naming traditions. English also uses charlotte for a moulded dessert, but the dessert's precise naming history is uncertain. The shared spelling therefore connects several reference types without establishing that every use has the same immediate origin. [Historical reference](https://www.etymonline.com/word/Charlotte).

etymology.historical_story: Chang reflects the Hokkien name for the rice dumpling called zongzi in Mandarin. In Malaysia, the food became part of Baba and Nyonya culinary heritage, with Nyonya versions incorporating distinctive seasonings and sometimes butterfly-pea colouring. Its association with the Dragon Boat Festival accompanies a broader story of Chinese food traditions being maintained and adapted within local communities. [Linguistic study](https://journals.mmupress.com/index.php/jclc/article/download/1483/714/15747), [JKKN](https://pemetaanbudaya.jkkn.gov.my/senibudaya/detail/965)

etymology.historical_story: Cheung illustrates how a Chinese surname can enter Malay sentences without becoming a Malay common noun. The Cantonese dictionary identifies Cheung as a usual romanization of 張, pronounced zoeng1. The written surname and its romanized form belong to different writing systems. However, the spelling alone does not securely identify every bearer's Chinese character, so this packet cannot support a single definitive family history. [Cantonese dictionary](https://cantowords.com/dictionary/%E5%BC%B5)

etymology.historical_story: Cuai belongs to a Malay word family that distinguishes a quality from an action: cuai describes carelessness, kecuaian names the condition, and mencuaikan means neglecting something. Dictionaries also record a less familiar sense, unimportant or worthless. These meanings are attested together, but their historical relationship should not be treated as an established story of semantic change.

etymology.historical_story: Caramu illustrates how Malay attaches a shortened personal pronoun to a noun. Cara supplies the idea of a way or method, while -mu, the shortened form of kamu, identifies whose way it is. The same grammatical relationship appears in bukumu and rumahmu, making this word part of a productive pattern rather than an isolated expression.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: cara＝方法，mu＝kamu 的短形式：caramu＝你的方法。与 caraku 我的方法对照记忆。

etymology.historical_story: Cobalah combines Indonesian coba with the particle -lah. Malaysian Malay uses the parallel form cubalah, built on cuba. DBP's spelling guide explicitly contrasts cuba with coba. This small vowel difference is a useful reminder that closely related Malay and Indonesian expressions can share a function while following different national spelling conventions. [Source: DBP spelling guide](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/ejaan.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把两种写法配对记：印尼语 coba → cobalah；马来西亚马来语 cuba → cubalah。共同的 -lah 像一句“试试看吧”。

word_family.gloss: 分支；较大整体的一部分

senses.zh_definition: 组织、协会、公司或机构所属的分支单位，亦指其分行、分店或分处。
senses.en_definition: A branch of an organization, association, company, or institution.
senses.ms_definition: Bahagian daripada pertubuhan, persatuan, syarikat atau institusi yang lebih besar.
senses.nuances: 可指组织架构中的分支，也可指其办公或营业地点。总部通常称 ibu pejabat；子公司称 anak syarikat，两者不能与 cawangan 随意互换。释义依据：[DBP：cawang / cawangan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=34488&keyword=cawang)。

senses.zh_definition: 较大整体所分出的支部或支流；河流语境中可指流入较大河流的小河。
senses.en_definition: A branch or offshoot of a larger whole; a tributary in a river context.
senses.ms_definition: Cabang atau bahagian daripada sesuatu yang lebih besar; dalam konteks sungai, anak sungai yang mengalir ke sungai besar.
senses.nuances: 这是较广义的分支义，现代日常使用以机构义更突出。指树枝通常用 dahan 或 ranting；明确指支流时，anak sungai 更直接。河流义见：[DBP《Kamus Pelajar》cawang](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=34488&keyword=cawang)。

collocations.en: a tributary of the main river

etymology.historical_story: Cawangan is transparently related to cawang, a branch or part of something larger, through the noun-forming suffix -an. Its organizational meaning carries the image of a larger body dividing into smaller units. DBP records both the institutional sense and a broader branch sense, while its learner's dictionary also identifies a river tributary. No speculative foreign origin is needed. [DBP dictionary](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=34488&keyword=cawang).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读 ca-wa-ngan 时，想象总部向外“岔”出一个网点：一个整体，多个 cawangan；ng 连成一个鼻音。

senses.zh_definition: 不诚实、不正直，或为谋取利益而欺骗、违反公平原则的。
senses.en_definition: Dishonest or deceitful, especially through cheating or unfair conduct.
senses.ms_definition: Tidak jujur atau tidak ikhlas, serta sanggup menipu atau melanggar keadilan demi kepentingan sendiri.
senses.nuances: 常见于 berlaku curang 和 bermain curang，指舞弊或不公平行为；这里不一定涉及感情关系。berlaku curang 中 curang 仍是形容词。[DBP：curang I](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=curang)

senses.zh_definition: 对配偶、未婚伴侣或恋人不忠，尤其指与他人发展违反伴侣承诺的感情关系。
senses.en_definition: Unfaithful to a spouse or romantic partner by becoming romantically or sexually involved with someone else.
senses.ms_definition: Tidak setia kepada suami, isteri, tunang atau pasangan dengan menjalinkan hubungan cinta atau hubungan sulit dengan orang lain.
senses.nuances: 常以 curang terhadap pasangan 表示对伴侣不忠。单说 dia curang 时，具体是作弊还是感情不忠须看语境；谈论情侣时通常理解为后者。[DBP：curang I](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=curang)

senses.zh_definition: 深沟；峡谷。为罕见的同形异义词。
senses.en_definition: A ravine or deep chasm; a rare homonym.
senses.ms_definition: Jurang, iaitu lurah atau rekahan tanah yang dalam.
senses.nuances: DBP 另列 curang II，释为 jurang。此义与不诚实、不忠的 curang I 分立；现代日常表达通常用 jurang。以下是说明性搭配，不应视为现代高频搭配。[DBP：curang II](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=curang)

etymology.historical_story: Curang connects two familiar moral concerns: honesty in dealings and loyalty in relationships. Malay dictionaries place both under the same everyday adjective, while listing a separate, uncommon noun meaning a ravine. This dictionary history offers a useful lesson: identical spellings need not share an origin or meaning. Learn the moral senses together, but keep the geographical homonym separate.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 curang 想成两张被破坏的承诺：比赛要公平，感情要忠诚。破坏前者是作弊，破坏后者是不忠。

morphology.pattern_note: chu 在相关历史材料中对应现代 cu；ch 表示现代马来文 c 所代表的塞擦音 /tʃ/，不是 c 加独立的 h。相关亲属称谓可按 /tʃu/ 理解，但输入未提供词目级读音，因此不填入 headword.ipa。

word_family.gloss: 相关亲属称谓的现代拼写
兄弟姐妹中最年幼的；相关称谓的来源

senses.zh_definition: 在有文献记载的马来亲属称谓中，指排行最小者的称呼成分；对应现代拼写 cu，常与 pak 或 mak 连用，称父母一辈中排行最小的男性或女性亲属。
senses.en_definition: A historically attested spelling corresponding to cu, a kinship designation associated with the youngest sibling, especially in terms for a parent's youngest brother or sister.
senses.ms_definition: Varian ejaan yang tercatat dalam kajian istilah kekeluargaan bagi cu, iaitu panggilan yang berkaitan dengan anak bongsu, khususnya dalam panggilan pak cu dan mak cu.
senses.nuances: 输入未提供 DBP 释义，不能把 chu 标为已核实的官方标准词目。此处仅收录研究文献支持的亲属称谓用法；马来文释义为编辑性概括，并非 DBP 原文。该解释不适用于所有人名或地名中的 Chu。以下为亲属称谓组合，不宣称其旧拼写具有已验证的高频率。[马来亲属称谓研究](https://brill.com/view/journals/bki/130/1/article-p44_3.pdf)；[DBP 关于 cu 等家庭称谓的说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=cu)。

collocations.zh: 父母一辈中排行最小的叔舅辈男性；现代拼写 Pak Cu
collocations.en: a parent's youngest brother; modern spelling Pak Cu

collocations.zh: 父母一辈中排行最小的姑姨辈女性；现代拼写 Mak Cu
collocations.en: a parent's youngest sister; modern spelling Mak Cu

etymology.historical_story: Malay family address often identifies relatives by sibling order rather than personal name alone. A study of Malay kinship terminology records chu alongside su as shortened forms associated with bungsu, now commonly written bongsu. In this historical spelling, ch corresponds to modern c. The evidence supports this particular kinship use, without establishing every occurrence of Chu as the same word.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Chu 连到现代 Cu，再连到 bongsu“老幺”；Pak Cu、Mak Cu 就是叔舅辈、姑姨辈中的老幺称呼。

morphology.pattern_note: 英语整词，在马来语混合表达中保留英语读音；cl 表示 /kl/，ay 表示 /eɪ/，不能按马来语 c 的 /tʃ/ 读音拼读。以下词族属于英语，并非马来语派生词。

senses.zh_definition: 黏土；由细小矿物颗粒构成、湿润时具有可塑性，可用于制陶和制砖的天然土质材料。
senses.en_definition: Fine-grained natural earth that is plastic when wet and hardens when fired.
senses.ms_definition: Kata bahasa Inggeris yang bermaksud tanah liat, iaitu bahan tanah berbutir halus yang mudah dibentuk apabila basah dan menjadi keras apabila dibakar.
senses.nuances: 这是英语词形；马来语规范对应词为 tanah liat，部分专业语境也用 lempung。下列含 clay 的搭配属于术语对照或语码混用。status 按指定模板保留为 official，不代表 clay 已获确认为马来语规范词；本条马来语释义为编写释义。[DBP 术语对照](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=115704&keyword=tanah+liat+)

senses.zh_definition: 造型黏土；供手工塑形使用的可塑材料，包括某些并非天然黏土的合成材料。
senses.en_definition: A pliable modelling material, including synthetic materials that resemble natural clay.
senses.ms_definition: Bahan mudah dibentuk untuk menghasilkan model atau hasil kraf, termasuk bahan sintetik yang menyerupai tanah liat.
senses.nuances: 手工或商品语境中的 clay 可能指天然陶土，也可能指聚合物造型材料，不能一概视为可烧制陶瓷的天然黏土。本义解释英语商品用语在马来语交流中的使用。[Merriam-Webster](https://scrabble.m-w.com/dictionary/clay)

etymology.historical_story: English clay descends from Old English clæg, a word for sticky earth. Its survival connects an everyday material with a long history of pottery and building. In Malaysian craft conversations, the English label can appear alongside tanah liat. That modern use should be distinguished from evidence that clay is an established standard Malay headword. [Oxford](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/clay)

etymology.historical_story: Corleone names a real Sicilian town, but many readers encounter it through fiction. Mario Puzo's 1969 novel The Godfather introduced the Corleone family, and the 1972 film carried that surname to international audiences. This cultural history explains its recognition in Malay discussions of cinema; it does not establish the town name's deeper linguistic origin. [Sources: Italia.it](https://www.italia.it/it/sicilia/palermo/corleone), [Penguin Random House](https://www.penguinrandomhouseretail.com/book/?isbn=9780399103421), [Paramount](https://www.paramount.com/movies/the-godfather).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: Corleone 先抓住开头的 /k/：keluarga Corleone 是电影中的“柯里昂家族”，bandar Corleone 是现实中的“科尔莱奥内镇”。

morphology.pattern_note: 单音节词；c 读 /tʃ/，词尾 /p/ 常不除阻。名词 cop I 与动词 cop II 是同形词，不应据此认定词源相同。未列未经核实的派生词。

senses.zh_definition: 一种用于挖掘泥土的工具；吉打方言词。
senses.en_definition: A digging implement used for working soil; a Kedah dialect word.
senses.ms_definition: Sejenis alat untuk menggali tanah, dalam penggunaan dialek Kedah.
senses.nuances: 原始资料中的 Kd 表示吉打方言，并不表示全国通行的普通词。这里指农具，不能直接译为印章。释义依据：[DBP PRPM：cop](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=15740&keyword=cop)。以下搭配为释义性示例，不代表已取得频率统计。

collocations.zh: 使用 cop 挖土工具

senses.zh_definition: 一种用于剥除椰子纤维外皮的工具，通常具有尖锐的工作端；方言词。
senses.en_definition: An implement used to remove the fibrous husk of a coconut.
senses.ms_definition: Sejenis alat untuk menanggalkan sabut kelapa.
senses.nuances: 这里的 mengupas kelapa 指剥椰衣，不是刮取椰肉。Kamus Dewan 标注为吉打用语；DBP 的柔佛方言词汇资料也记录了这一名称。参见：[DBP PRPM：cop](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=15740&keyword=cop)。

collocations.en: the pointed blade of a coconut husking implement

senses.zh_definition: 用嘴吹气，尤指吹蜡烛或煤油灯；吉打方言词。
senses.en_definition: To blow with the mouth, especially at a candle or an oil lamp; a Kedah dialect word.
senses.ms_definition: Meniup atau menghembus dengan mulut, misalnya pada lilin atau pelita minyak tanah.
senses.nuances: 这是 DBP 另列的 cop II，与工具义分属不同词条。全国通行的表达宜用 meniup；若明确表示吹灭，可用 meniup sehingga padam。参见：[DBP PRPM：cop](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=15740&keyword=cop)。

etymology.historical_story: Research on Thai loans in Malay connects the agricultural noun cop with Thai จอบ, a digging tool. The study describes related forms across northern and eastern Malay dialects and a widening of meaning to coconut husking implements. This proposed history concerns the tool noun; it does not establish the origin of the separate blowing verb. [Study in Jurnal Melayu](https://ejournal.ukm.my/jmelayu/article/download/80714/16486).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把短促的 cop 想成工具落地的一声：一下挖土，一下剥椰衣。声音联想仅用于记忆，不是词源解释。

headword.verification_note: 可核实为南亚姓氏，通常写作 Chaudhary；未核实为 DBP 正式收录的马来语普通词，因此不能标为 official。音标仅为印地语参考读音，不代表统一的马来语读音；音节及爪夷文沿用词包中的空值。[姓名与读音资料](https://surnames.behindthename.com/name/chaudhary)

etymology.historical_story: Chaudhary illustrates how an occupational or social title can become a family name. Naming references connect it with a South Asian title traditionally interpreted as 'holder of four' and list its use across several languages. Related spellings reflect different naming traditions; in modern Malay text, the practical task is to preserve each person's own spelling. [Name history](https://surnames.behindthename.com/name/chaudhary)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Chaudhary 整体记作名牌上的姓氏；看到 Encik Chaudhary，就读作“Chaudhary 先生”。不把拼写拆成马来语词缀。

morphology.pattern_note: celah 是独立词根；c 读 /t͡ʃ/，e 读央元音 /ə/。派生 mencelah 时使用 men-，词首 c 保留。

senses.zh_definition: 两个物体或相邻部分之间的空隙、缝隙或狭窄开口。
senses.en_definition: A gap, narrow opening, or intervening space between objects or adjacent parts.
senses.ms_definition: Ruang terbuka atau renggang di antara dua benda atau bahagian yang berdekatan.
senses.nuances: 侧重物体之间的间隙，不必意味着物体破裂；描述裂纹本身通常用 retak。具体义及延伸义参见 [DBP：celah](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=206468&keyword=celah)。

senses.zh_definition: 插话说；在别人讲话时插入一句话，常用作引述对话的提示语。
senses.en_definition: To interject or interrupt with a remark, especially as a dialogue-reporting verb.
senses.ms_definition: Menyampuk percakapan orang dengan sesuatu ujaran, khususnya sebagai pengiring petikan dialog.
senses.nuances: DBP 以 sampuk、插入的话语解释此义；在“……，celah Amir”这类叙述结构中，本条按实际句法功能标为动词。完整陈述动作时通常用 mencelah。

senses.zh_definition: 两项事务或两个时段之间可利用的空当、空闲时间。
senses.en_definition: A free interval between activities; a spare moment.
senses.ms_definition: Masa yang terluang di antara dua pekerjaan, urusan atau waktu.
senses.nuances: 把空间上的空隙用于时间。没有上下文时，masa lapang 或 kelapangan 通常更直接；celah 常见于强调忙碌中抽空的表达。

senses.zh_definition: 抽象处境中可容身、介入或行动的空间；引申为机会或可利用的缺口。
senses.en_definition: Figurative room or an opening within a situation, sometimes offering an opportunity.
senses.ms_definition: Ruang secara kiasan dalam sesuatu keadaan yang memungkinkan tindakan atau memberikan peluang.
senses.nuances: 具体含义由上下文决定，可指机会、活动空间或制度缺口。涉及法律时，“漏洞”的明确正式表达通常是 kelompangan undang-undang。

etymology.historical_story: The meanings recorded for celah follow an everyday image: something fits between two things. A physical gap becomes a spare interval between tasks, an opening within a difficult situation, or a moment for another voice to enter a conversation. Malay narrative also uses celah to introduce an interjected remark. These connected senses offer a semantic history without establishing a particular ancient source.

etymology.historical_story: Christine is a French form of Christina and also occurs in several other European naming traditions. Gaston Leroux gave the name to Christine Daaé in his 1910 novel The Phantom of the Opera. In Malay discourse, it functions as a personal name rather than a word formed with Malay affixes. [Name history](https://www.behindthename.com/name/christine).

etymology.historical_story: The English name carmine belongs to a European vocabulary of red dyes. Collins traces its history through medieval Latin and Arabic colour terminology, while also recording French connections. Its material meaning remains memorable: a brilliant pigment obtained from cochineal insects. Malay uses the adapted spelling karmin, connecting the international colour term with local spelling conventions. [Collins](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/us/dictionary/english/carmine), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=karmin)

etymology.historical_story: Cetakan brings printing and moulding together through one transparent Malay formation: cetak plus the noun-forming suffix -an. The supplied Kamus Dewan entry records printed products, moulds, and figuratively something already shaped. These meanings share the idea of a form made tangible. This account explains the modern formation without asserting an unverified deeper origin for cetak.

senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga Cohen yang lazim ditemukan dalam kalangan keluarga Yahudi; bukan kata nama am bahasa Melayu.
senses.nuances: 本义属于专有名词，受给定词性选项限制记为 noun。正文中保留大写 Cohen；以下为姓名的常见句法组合。不能仅凭姓氏推断持有者的宗教信仰或祭司身份。[Ancestry：Cohen surname](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/Cohen)；[Chabad：Cohen](https://www.chabad.org/library/article_cdo/aid/5061756/jewish/What-Does-the-Jewish-Last-Name-Cohen-Mean.htm)。

etymology.historical_story: The familiar Jewish surname Cohen comes from Hebrew kohen, meaning priest. It recalls a hereditary religious role traditionally associated with Aaron's descendants. Family names and religious status do not always coincide: someone named Cohen may lack a priestly family tradition, while a kohen may bear another surname. [Chabad](https://www.chabad.org/library/article_cdo/aid/5061756/jewish/What-Does-the-Jewish-Last-Name-Cohen-Mean.htm).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: Cohen 大写先想到“科恩这个姓”；kohen 出现在宗教说明中，再想到“祭司家系”。两种拼写有关联，身份不能直接画等号。

etymology.historical_story: Cakar connects an animal's claw with the mark it leaves and tools shaped for a similar action. Malay also uses cakar ayam for both untidy handwriting and a shredded-root snack. These established expressions make the claw image culturally memorable, although the dictionary meanings alone do not establish when each expression first arose. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=cakar)

etymology.historical_story: Crawly is an English formation from crawl and the adjective suffix -y. Collins dates it to 1855–1860. Its meanings connect the movement of small creatures with the uncomfortable sensation that such movement can evoke on human skin. English also uses the noun for a small crawling creature. This history does not establish it as a Malay loanword. [Collins：crawly](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/crawly)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住英语 crawl＝爬，再加 -y：想象小虫爬过皮肤，既记住“爬行的”，也记住“让人发毛的”。

morphology.pattern_note: 作为英语整词记忆，不拆成马来语词缀。此处 IPA 为英语读音，字母 c 读 /k/；马来语拼写 kobra 可按 /ko.bra/ 读。输入未提供 Jawi，不补造 cobra 的官方 Jawi。

senses.ms_definition: Padanan bagi perkataan bahasa Inggeris cobra ialah ular tedung, iaitu ular berbisa yang dapat mengembangkan bahagian tengkuknya.

etymology.historical_story: English cobra comes from Portuguese cobra de capelo, meaning a snake with a hood. The image describes the expanded neck that makes these snakes immediately recognizable. Portuguese cobra itself means snake more generally, while English narrowed the borrowed word to hooded venomous snakes. See [the etymological account](https://www.etymonline.com/pt/word/cobra). This history does not establish cobra as an official Malay spelling.

etymology.historical_story: The country takes its name from Lake Chad, linking a national name to an important regional body of water. Historical accounts connect the lake name with expressions meaning water or a large expanse of water. Scholars differ over the precise source language and older spellings, so the familiar lake connection is firmer than a detailed linguistic reconstruction. [Zagórski: Chad toponymy](https://ptafr.org.pl/wp-content/uploads/2016/11/African-Studies-PawlakRubinkowskaWill-kor1.pdf)

etymology.historical_story: Christopher derives from Greek Christophoros, associated with bearing Christ. Oxford's Lexicon of Greek Personal Names explains that the expression began as a Christian epithet before becoming a personal name. This religious history concerns the name's origin; it does not determine the beliefs, ethnicity, or identity of any present-day bearer. [Oxford LGPN: Christopher](https://www.lgpn.ox.ac.uk/article/christopher)

etymology.historical_story: English cape brings together two histories. The geographical word comes through French from Latin caput, meaning head: a headland projects like a head into the sea. The clothing word comes through French from Late Latin cappa, a cloak. These histories explain English meanings; they do not establish cape as an official Malay headword. [Etymological account](https://www.etymonline.com/word/cape).

etymology.historical_story: Cakera comes from Sanskrit cakra, meaning wheel or discus. Its circular image connects several Malay meanings: a turning wheel, a sharp-edged weapon, an athlete's discus, and a computer disc. Remembering that shared shape makes the move from classical objects to modern storage technology easy to understand. [Sanskrit borrowing](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/cakera).

etymology.historical_story: For the English place name, Chester preserves a connection with Britain's Roman military landscape. The local visitor authority links names containing chester, cester, or caster with Roman forts and identifies Chester with the fortress of Deva. This background concerns the English city name; it does not establish that the supplied lowercase token is an official Malay lexical item. [Visit Chester & Cheshire: Roman Chester Trail](https://visitcheshire.com/directory/roman-chester-trail)

senses.zh_definition: 恰吉：恐怖片《鬼娃回魂》系列中的杀人人偶角色名称；本条采用这一已知专名义，原始语料中的具体指称仍待上下文确认。
senses.en_definition: Chucky, the murderous doll character associated with the Child's Play horror franchise.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas watak patung pembunuh dalam francais filem seram Child's Play.
senses.nuances: 属于专有名词，并非“恐怖人偶”的马来语通名。影片官方资料支持此角色义，但不能证明输入语料必定指该角色，也不能据此宣称获得 DBP 普通词条认证。搭配是自然的专名短语，频率未经统计。[角色官方资料](https://www.universalpicturesathome.com/movies/chucky-7-movie-collection)

cerita 在这里口语指电影。

etymology.historical_story: Chucky belongs to film history rather than Malay word formation. The character appeared in the 1988 horror film Child's Play, whose premise turns a child's doll into a killer. In Malay discussion, the name identifies the character without requiring a Malay derivation. Its recognizable cultural reference does not establish it as a Malay common noun. [Official film listing](https://www.syfy.com/movies/childs-play)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Chucky 的读音 /ˈtʃʌki/ 与“恰吉鬼娃”的形象绑定；整词记作角色名。

morphology.pattern_note: 原包未提供音节字段；读作 cé.tak，e 为 /e/，词尾 k 在马来西亚常见读音中实现为喉塞音 /ʔ/。meN- 接 c 时成为 men-，保留 c：mencetak。

senses.zh_definition: 印在纸张、布料等表面上的文字、图案或印记；也用于表示印刷这一制作方式。
senses.en_definition: An impression of letters, marks, or designs on paper or fabric; printing as a method of production.
senses.ms_definition: Cap berupa tanda, huruf atau gambar pada kertas, kain dan sebagainya.
senses.nuances: 名词义常出现在 media cetak、mesin cetak 等固定组合中。media cetak 指纸本印刷媒体，与电子媒体相区别；mesin cetak 通常指印刷设备，桌面打印机一般称 pencetak。

senses.zh_definition: 使糕点等材料形成特定形状的模具。
senses.en_definition: A mould used to give cakes or other materials a particular shape.
senses.ms_definition: Acuan untuk membentuk kuih atau benda lain; cetakan.
senses.nuances: 此义较具传统工艺和烹饪色彩。现代日常表达中 acuan kuih 更直接、常用；这里的 cetak 不是纸张打印。

senses.zh_definition: 将文字或图像印到纸张、布料等材料上；打印或印刷。
senses.en_definition: To reproduce text or images on paper, fabric, or another surface by printing.
senses.ms_definition: Menghasilkan tulisan atau gambar pada sesuatu permukaan melalui proses mencetak.
senses.nuances: cetak 可用于命令句、界面按钮和口语，如 Cetak dokumen ini。正式主动陈述通常用 mencetak；带第一、第二人称施事的被动结构也可用原形，如 dokumen yang saya cetak。mencetak gol 的比喻义应在该派生词下另行处理。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报

je 对应 sahaja，表示“只、就”。

messages.ms_spoken: Amir, boleh tolong cetak borang ni? Saya dah hantar kat WhatsApp.

messages.en: Sure. You only need two copies, right?

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 单说 Cetak ini! 容易显得像命令。向同事或店员请求时，可用 Tolong cetak…、Sila cetak… 或 Boleh tolong cetak…?；对长辈或客户避免随意使用 kau。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 在打印店可直接说明份数、纸张尺寸、彩色或黑白及是否双面。传统糕点语境中的 cetak 指模具，脱离语境时用 acuan kuih 更容易理解。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 单说 Cetak ini! 容易显得像命令。向同事或店员请求时，可用 Tolong cetak…、Sila cetak… 或 Boleh tolong cetak…?；对长辈或客户避免随意使用 kau。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 在打印店可直接说明份数、纸张尺寸、彩色或黑白及是否双面。传统糕点语境中的 cetak 指模具，脱离语境时用 acuan kuih 更容易理解。

etymology.historical_story: Malay cetak connects two familiar material practices: making impressions on paper or cloth and shaping food in a mould. This shared vocabulary also appears in the proverb bagaimana cetak begitu kuihnya, which compares a child's behaviour with a parent's. The cultural connection is documented; a particular ultimate borrowing source is not established here. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=cetak)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 cetak 想成“印一下，留下样”：纸上留下字样，模具留下形状。cé 读 /t͡ʃe/，不要读成含 /ə/ 的音节。

morphology.pattern_note: 英语单音节词，ee 表示 /iː/；复数 creeks 的词尾 -s 在 /k/ 后读 /s/。不适用马来语词缀规则。

word_family.gloss: 多条小溪；多个狭长水湾
溪边；由 creek 与 side 构成的英语复合词

senses.zh_definition: 小溪或狭窄的小河，主要见于北美、澳大利亚及新西兰英语。
senses.en_definition: A small river or stream, especially in North American, Australian, and New Zealand English.
senses.ms_definition: Sungai kecil atau aliran air semula jadi yang sempit.
senses.nuances: 马来语通常可译为 anak sungai 或 sungai kecil；不能仅凭 creek 就断定它必然是某条大河的支流。

senses.zh_definition: 海水等伸入陆地形成的狭长水湾或水汊，主要见于英国英语。
senses.en_definition: A narrow inlet extending inland from the sea or another body of water.
senses.ms_definition: Cabang perairan yang sempit dan menganjur masuk ke daratan dari laut atau perairan lain.
senses.nuances: 此义不能一律译作淡水小溪；应根据地貌选择 teluk kecil、alur pasang surut 等表达。区域义项参考：[Oxford: creek](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/creek_1)。

dual_scenarios.context: 新闻 / 地理说明
dual_scenarios.ms: Dalam laporan mengenai kawasan pedalaman Australia itu, istilah "creek" merujuk kepada sungai kecil yang mengalir melalui tapak kajian.
dual_scenarios.zh: 在这份关于澳大利亚内陆地区的报告中，creek 指流经考察地点的一条小河。
dual_scenarios.en: In the report on inland Australia, "creek" refers to a small river flowing through the study site.

dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Pada peta ini terdapat perkataan "creek". Adakah perkataan itu merujuk kepada anak sungai?

dual_scenarios.en: This map says "creek". Does that mean a stream?

ni 对应 ini
ke 用于口语疑问

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 词本身没有特殊礼貌色彩；与不熟悉英语地理用语的人交流时，可补充 anak sungai 等马来语说明。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 翻译地理描述须核对地区及地貌；正式地名中的 Creek 应遵循该地名的核定写法。大写 Creek 另可指北美原住民族，不属于这里的小写地理义。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 词本身没有特殊礼貌色彩；与不熟悉英语地理用语的人交流时，可补充 anak sungai 等马来语说明。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 翻译地理描述须核对地区及地貌；正式地名中的 Creek 应遵循该地名的核定写法。大写 Creek 另可指北美原住民族，不属于这里的小写地理义。

etymology.historical_story: Creek is recorded in Middle English forms such as creke and crike. Its history is associated with words for a nook or bend, although the precise borrowing route is uncertain. The geographical contrast survives today: British English commonly uses it for an inlet, while several other English varieties use it for a stream. [Oxford: creek](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/creek_1).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 /kriːk/ 中拉长的 /iː/ 想成细长水线：可联想小溪，也要留意英国英语的狭长水湾义。

morphology.pattern_note: 英语整词，在马来西亚马来语会话中可用于语码转换，无马来语词缀。原包音节字段 sso 并非有效音节标注，仅按要求保留；所列为非卷舌英语读音，通常一个音节。爪夷文未提供。

senses.zh_definition: 清楚的；容易听清、看清或理解的。
senses.en_definition: Easy to hear, see, or understand.
senses.ms_definition: Jelas didengar, dilihat atau difahami.
senses.nuances: 这是英语词在马来语口语中的使用；规范马来语通常用 jelas。此处马来语释义为编写释义，不是 DBP 对 clear 的官方释义。[Clear：词义及用法](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/clear)

senses.zh_definition: 透明或清澈的；没有明显浑浊或遮蔽的。
senses.en_definition: Transparent or free from cloudiness.
senses.ms_definition: Jernih atau lut sinar; tidak keruh.
senses.nuances: 用于马来语会话中的英语插入词；液体通常对应 jernih，透明材料通常对应 lut sinar。清澈不等于可安全饮用。[Clear：透明义](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/clear)

senses.zh_definition: 清空、移除或腾出；使某处不再有物品、障碍或待处理内容。
senses.en_definition: To empty something or remove its contents or obstructions.
senses.ms_definition: Mengosongkan sesuatu atau mengalihkan benda yang memenuhi atau menghalangnya.
senses.nuances: 口语中常直接置于宾语前；规范马来语依对象选用 kosongkan、alihkan 或 padamkan。此用法不能机械替换成 jelas。[Clear：动词义](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/clear)

senses.zh_definition: 结清债务或欠款。
senses.en_definition: To pay off a debt or outstanding amount.
senses.ms_definition: Melunaskan hutang atau menjelaskan bayaran yang tertunggak.
senses.nuances: 属于英语动词在马来语口语中的使用；正式文件宜用 melunaskan hutang 或 menjelaskan tunggakan。[Clear：偿清义](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/clear)

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Dalam laporan rasmi, perkataan Inggeris 'clear' hendaklah digantikan dengan padanan bahasa Melayu yang sesuai mengikut konteks.
dual_scenarios.zh: 在正式报告中，应根据语境以适当的马来语对应词替换英语词 clear。
dual_scenarios.en: In an official report, the English word 'clear' should be replaced with an appropriate Malay equivalent for the context.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Suara kau tak clear lah, cuba cakap sekali lagi.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Suara kamu tidak jelas. Cuba ulang apa yang kamu katakan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 你那边声音听不清，再说一遍吧。
dual_scenarios.en: I can't hear you clearly. Could you say that again?
spoken_features: clear 是英语插入词，对应 jelas。
tak 是 tidak 的口语形式。
lah 是表达语气的口语助词；kau 适用于熟人之间。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Suara kau tak clear lah. Kau kat mana sekarang?
messages.ms_standard: Suara kamu tidak jelas. Di manakah kamu sekarang?
messages.zh: 你那边声音听不清。你现在在哪儿？
messages.en: I can't hear you clearly. Where are you?

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku kat luar. Sekejap, aku nak masuk dalam dulu.
messages.ms_standard: Saya berada di luar. Tunggu sebentar, saya hendak masuk ke dalam dahulu.
messages.zh: 我在外面。等一下，我先进去。
messages.en: I'm outside. Hang on, let me go inside.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 与熟悉英语的朋友或同事交谈时可理解；面对不熟悉英语的人，使用 jelas、kosongkan 或 lunaskan 更易沟通。询问理解情况时，Sudah jelas? 比生硬的 Clear? 更完整。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于非正式语码转换。此处 official 仅沿用所要求的数据状态，不表示 clear 已获确认为规范马来语词条；正式马来语须按语境选择对应词。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 与熟悉英语的朋友或同事交谈时可理解；面对不熟悉英语的人，使用 jelas、kosongkan 或 lunaskan 更易沟通。询问理解情况时，Sudah jelas? 比生硬的 Clear? 更完整。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于非正式语码转换。此处 official 仅沿用所要求的数据状态，不表示 clear 已获确认为规范马来语词条；正式马来语须按语境选择对应词。

etymology.historical_story: English clear came through Middle English and French from Latin clarus, associated with brightness and clarity. Its meanings connect transparent materials, distinct sounds, and understandable ideas. The verb also developed senses involving removal and freedom from obstacles. In Malay conversation, these meanings depend on context because different standard Malay equivalents are needed. [Dictionary.com：clear](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/clear)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把眼前的雾清开：画面 clear，声音 clear，意思也 clear；作动词时则把东西清走或把欠款清掉。

headword.status_scope: official 指该英语词头见于 DBP《英语—马来语词典》，不表示 castle 已获确认为标准马来语词头。输入未提供马来语音节或 Jawi，故保留 null。

morphology.pattern_note: 按英语词根处理，不作马来语词缀切分。t 不发音；所列 IPA 为英式读音，美式通常为 /ˈkæs.əl/。castling 加 -ing 时去掉词尾不发音的 e。以下词族形式均属英语。[Cambridge：castle 发音](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/pronunciation/english/castle)

word_family.gloss: 王车易位；英语动词的 -ing 形式

senses.zh_definition: 城堡；供君主或贵族居住，并设有防御设施的大型建筑或建筑群。
senses.en_definition: A fortified residence or group of buildings, especially one associated with medieval rulers or nobles.
senses.ms_definition: Padanan rasmi DBP bagi kata nama Inggeris ini ialah kastil atau istana kota.
senses.nuances: 这是英语义项。标准马来语可用 kastil、istana kota 或按具体建筑性质使用 kubu kota；不能仅因 castle 出现在 DBP 双语词典中，就把它认定为马来语借词。[DBP：castle](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=castle)

senses.zh_definition: 国际象棋中的车；rook 的非正式英语称呼。
senses.en_definition: An informal name for a rook in chess.
senses.ms_definition: Padanan DBP bagi kata nama Inggeris ini dalam permainan catur ialah tir.
senses.nuances: 英语棋类术语中的非正式名称，不能与作为动作的 castle（王车易位）混淆。这里的马来语搭配使用 DBP 对应词 tir。[DBP：castle](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=castle)

senses.zh_definition: 在国际象棋中进行王车易位，使王与同侧的一枚车按规则在同一回合完成特定移动。
senses.en_definition: To make the special chess move involving the king and a rook, known as castling.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa Inggeris, melakukan gerakan khas catur yang melibatkan raja dan satu tir dalam satu giliran.
senses.nuances: 此为英语动词义；本栏马来语定义是解释性释义，并非声称 DBP 收录了同形马来语动词。易位须满足棋规条件，不是任意交换王和车的位置。[Cambridge：castle](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/castle)

etymology.historical_story: DBP's encyclopedic material connects castle with Latin castellum, meaning a fort. The medieval building combined a lord's residence with military protection, helping explain the Malay equivalent istana kota. Crucially, DBP presents castle as an English headword: an official bilingual dictionary can document a foreign word without making its spelling standard Malay. [DBP: castle](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=castle)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 英式读音近“卡—瑟尔”，t 不发音。脑中画一座被城墙围住的宫殿：castle → istana kota；棋盘上则联想到外形像城楼的车。

etymology.historical_story: English cause entered Middle English through Anglo-French, ultimately from Latin causa, a word covering reasons, motives and legal proceedings. Its history helps connect a cause of an event with a cause defended in court or public life. The English verb also has French and Latin ancestry; this history does not establish cause as a Malay borrowing. [Merriam-Webster: cause](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/cause)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 cause → effect 记成“原因 → 结果”：名词 cause 对应 punca，动词 cause 对应 menyebabkan；别按马来语读成两个音节。

etymology.historical_story: Carson illustrates how a surname can become a personal name and then appear unchanged in Malay conversation. Its surname history includes Scottish and northern Irish associations, but its origin is not settled. A tempting split into familiar English pieces would therefore promise more certainty than the evidence supports. It remains a name, not a Malay derivation. See [FamilySearch](https://www.familysearch.org/en/surname?surname=carson).

etymology.historical_story: English crazy belongs to the family of craze, whose older meanings concerned breaking or cracking. Its later uses extended to mental disturbance and then to exaggerated enthusiasm or unusual situations. In Malay conversation, it functions as an English insertion rather than a transparently Malay derivation. [Oxford University Press: word history](https://blog.oup.com/2021/07/outlandish-but-not-crazy/)

etymology.historical_story: Cuma is commonly traced to Tamil cummā, a word associated with being idle or doing something without a particular purpose. In Malay, cuma expresses restriction: only or merely. Adding the Malay particle -lah creates cumalah. Related forms such as percuma carry the distinct meanings free of charge and in vain. etymology.historical_story: The useful story here is grammatical rather than a speculative ancient origin. Malay comel describes endearing attractiveness, while attached -nya can turn that description into an exclamation. In another construction, it names the quality itself. The same spelling therefore supports both immediate admiration and a more reflective description of cuteness. See [DBP](https://dewanbahasa.jendeladbp.my/2022/03/16/2777/).

etymology.historical_story: Campakkan is transparently formed from campak and the Malay suffix -kan. Its everyday image is a hand sending an object away. That same image supports emotional language about casting someone aside. Campak also names measles in a separate dictionary entry; that homonym should not be treated as the source of this verb.

etymology.historical_story: Cinta is commonly traced to Sanskrit cintā, associated with thought, care and anxiety. Malay preserves an older sorrow-related sense alongside its familiar meanings of love and affection. Cintamu adds the shortened pronoun mu, making the feeling yours; it is a transparent grammatical formation rather than a separately borrowed word. etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: cin-ta-mu：先抓住 cinta“爱”，再把 mu 接回 kamu“你”——“爱＋你的”就是“你的爱”。

senses.nuances: 日常语境中的 cicak 通常译为“壁虎”，不宜一律泛译为所有“蜥蜴”。它不是昆虫，也不只对应单一物种。MyBIS 将 Hemidactylus frenatus 列为 cicak 的一种对应物；cicak kubin 等复合名称需整体理解，其比喻义不能直接移给单独的 cicak。参见 [MyBIS：Hemidactylus frenatus](https://www.mybis.gov.my/sp/9886)。

etymology.historical_story: Cicak is not merely a household word: it has also entered scientific naming. In 2016, researchers named a Penang Hill gecko Hemiphyllodactylus cicak and explicitly explained that the species epithet came from the Malay word for lizard. This documents a local animal name travelling into international taxonomy, without establishing the deeper historical origin of the Malay word itself. See the [original species description](https://zenodo.org/records/6055121).

etymology.historical_story: English center traces through French and Latin to Greek kentron, associated with a sharp point and the pivot used in drawing a circle. The geometric image later supported meanings involving concentrated attention and activity. DBP identifies center as the American spelling of centre and supplies Malay equivalents through its bilingual resources. [Dictionary.com: center](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/center)

morphology.pattern_note: -nya 在此通常是第三人称领属附着语，表示“他／她的”，不标示性别；词根不发生音变，ny 读 /ɲ/。按字段要求归入 suffix，但它并非一般派生后缀。数据包的 چينتا 对应词根 cinta，未包含 -nya；完整形式可写作 چينتاڽ。

senses.zh_definition: 他／她对亲人、国家、理想或事物的深厚爱意与热爱。

etymology.historical_story: Cinta is traced to Sanskrit cintā, associated with thought, concern, and attention. Its Malay meanings extend across affection, romantic love, longing, and, in older literature, sorrow. This history helps explain why an apparently familiar love word can describe distress in classical texts. Cintanya adds the Malay enclitic -nya to that inherited lexical base. [IIUM discussion](https://irep.iium.edu.my/81688/1/Cinta%20dalam%20islam%20Satu%20Kupasan.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: cinta 是“爱”，-nya 是“他／她的”：把爱装进他／她的心里，就是 cintanya。

headword.validation_note: 英语情态助动词，不能标为正式马来语词头。以下提供英语词义及马来语对应表达；排名沿用输入，不代表已验证的马来语词频。[Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/could)

morphology.pattern_note: 按输入将 could 作为独立检索形式保留；英语语法上，它与 can 构成不规则变化关系，并非马来语词根。字母 l 不发音，非重读时常读 /kəd/。

word_family.gloss: 能；可以；与 could 对应的英语情态动词
could not 的缩写：不能；不可能

senses.zh_definition: 表示过去具有某种能力或获准做某事：当时能、当时可以。
senses.en_definition: Expressing ability or permission in the past.
senses.ms_definition: Kata bantu ragam bahasa Inggeris yang menyatakan kebolehan atau kebenaran pada masa lalu; padanannya termasuk dahulu boleh dan dahulu dibenarkan.
senses.nuances: 这是英语情态助动词的用法；以下 ms 搭配是马来语对应表达。过去的一般能力常用 could；某次实际成功通常用 was/were able to 或 managed to。[British Council](https://learnenglish.britishcouncil.org/free-resources/grammar/english-grammar-reference/can-could)

senses.zh_definition: 表示现在或将来存在某种可能性：可能、也许会。
senses.en_definition: Expressing a possibility in the present or future.
senses.ms_definition: Kata bantu ragam bahasa Inggeris yang menyatakan kemungkinan; padanannya ialah mungkin atau boleh jadi.
senses.nuances: 此义没有过去时间含义，也不保证事情会发生。马来语通常用 mungkin，而非机械地一律译为 boleh。

senses.zh_definition: 用于较委婉地请求帮助、征求许可或提出建议。
senses.en_definition: Used to make a polite request, ask permission, or suggest an action.
senses.ms_definition: Kata bantu ragam bahasa Inggeris untuk meminta bantuan atau izin dengan sopan, atau mengemukakan cadangan.
senses.nuances: Could you…? 通常是请求，不是在询问对方过去的能力；马来语可用 Bolehkah…?、Boleh…? 或请托表达。You could… 则常表示建议。

senses.zh_definition: 表示假设条件下能够做某事或可能出现某种结果。
senses.en_definition: Expressing ability or possibility under an imagined condition.
senses.ms_definition: Kata bantu ragam bahasa Inggeris yang menyatakan kebolehan atau kemungkinan dalam keadaan andaian.
senses.nuances: 常与 if 条件句搭配。马来语一般通过 jika、sekiranya、kalau 和 boleh 或 dapat 表达，不需要为 could 设置独立的过去时词形。

collocations.en: could go if there were time

senses.zh_definition: 与 have 和过去分词连用，表示对过去的可能性作推测，或表示本来有机会做到某事。
senses.en_definition: With have and a past participle, expressing past possibility or an unrealized opportunity.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam binaan could have diikuti bentuk past participle, menyatakan kemungkinan tentang masa lalu atau peluang yang tidak diambil.
senses.nuances: Could have 不一定表示事情没有发生：推测义保留不确定性；反事实语境才表示本可发生而未发生。应根据上下文区分。

etymology.historical_story: English could descends from Old English cūþe, the past tense of cunnan, meaning to know how or be able. Its silent l was added later by analogy with would and should. The spelling therefore preserves a historical comparison with neighbouring modal verbs rather than an extra sound. [Etymonline](https://www.etymonline.com/word/could)

senses.zh_definition: 某个宗教或群体所持的信仰体系、教义或基本信念。

senses.ms_definition: Sistem kepercayaan agama atau akidah yang dipegang oleh seseorang atau sesuatu kelompok.
senses.nuances: 以下 ms 搭配为马来语对应表达。creed 可指宗教信仰体系，不一定是具体的一篇信经；也不能在所有语境中与 race 或 nationality 混为一谈。

senses.zh_definition: 正式概述宗教基本教义的信仰声明，尤指基督教信经。

senses.nuances: 基督教礼仪中的 creed 常译作信经，马来语可用 pengakuan iman。虽然某些双语词典列有 syahadat，跨宗教翻译仍须采用相关宗教群体实际使用的术语。

senses.zh_definition: 个人或团体奉行的一套原则、政治主张或人生信条。
senses.en_definition: A set of guiding principles or convictions, especially political or personal ones.
senses.ms_definition: Himpunan prinsip, fahaman atau pegangan yang menjadi panduan seseorang atau sesuatu kumpulan.
senses.nuances: 这是非宗教引申义，通常比 opinion 更稳定、更具指导性。马来语宜按语境译为 fahaman、pegangan 或 prinsip，而非一律译为 akidah。

etymology.historical_story: English creed traces through Old English creda to Latin credo, meaning 'I believe'. That opening declaration became a name for a formal statement of Christian faith. The meaning later widened to beliefs and guiding principles beyond religion, which explains why modern English can speak of both a religious creed and a political creed. [Etymonline](https://www.etymonline.com/word/creed)

etymology.historical_story: Chloe comes from Greek khlóē, referring to a young green shoot. The word was also an epithet of Demeter, connecting the name with fresh vegetation and agriculture. The medieval names dictionary records Cloe in the Wycliffite Bible of 1395, illustrating its presence in English biblical naming long before modern usage. See [Dictionary of Medieval Names: Chloe](https://dmnes.org/name/Chloe).

etymology.historical_story: Corporation carries an old image of people forming one body. English received the word through Anglo-French and Latin traditions; Latin corporare meant to form into a body and was related to corpus, body. That image helps explain an organization acting as one entity. Malay expresses the relevant institutional meaning through syarikat or perbadanan, depending on context. [Word history](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/corporation); [DBP equivalents](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=corporation).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 corporation 想成许多人组成一个能统一行动的组织：商业语境想 syarikat，公共机构语境再判断是否用 perbadanan。

etymology.historical_story: Candy belongs to the vocabulary that travelled with sugar. English received forms associated with crystallized sugar through French, with earlier links to Arabic and an Indic term for a piece or fragment. Its later everyday meaning broadened to sweets. The history concerns the English word; the ordinary Malay equivalent is gula-gula. [Oxford word origin](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.co.uk/us/definition/english/candy)

senses.zh_definition: 用于刺、穿或固定东西的尖细器具，如针、签或发簪。
senses.en_definition: A pointed implement used for piercing, threading or fastening.
senses.ms_definition: Benda berujung tajam untuk menusuk, merangkai atau menyemat sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 词典本义为器具；具体指称依搭配确定。不能把所有针状物都无区别地称为 cucuk。[DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=cucuk)

collocations.en: a hairpin for securing a bun
a cord threaded through an animal's nose

senses.zh_definition: 串：计算用竹签、细棍或绳等穿起来的物品的量词。
senses.en_definition: A classifier for items threaded onto a skewer, stick or similar support.
senses.ms_definition: Penjodoh bilangan bagi barang yang dirangkaikan pada lidi, tali atau bahan seumpamanya.
senses.nuances: 这里的词类按给定标签归入 noun，实际功能是量词；secucuk 表示一串。不是所有长条状物品都适用。

senses.zh_definition: 针剂注射；打针。
senses.en_definition: An injection or jab.
senses.ms_definition: Suntikan untuk memasukkan ubat atau bahan lain ke dalam badan.
senses.nuances: 日常医疗交流常用，正式记录一般用 suntikan。单说 cucuk 不一定指疫苗，也可能指其他注射。

senses.zh_definition: 用尖物刺、扎、戳或刺穿；也指用刀刃等捅刺。
senses.en_definition: To prick, poke, pierce or stab with a pointed object.
senses.ms_definition: Menusuk atau menembusi sesuatu dengan benda tajam.
senses.nuances: 裸词根常见于口语及命令句；正式主动陈述通常用 mencucuk。动作是否造成严重伤害取决于工具和语境。

senses.zh_definition: 给人或动物注射药物等；打针。
senses.en_definition: To administer an injection.
senses.ms_definition: Menyuntik ubat atau bahan lain ke dalam badan.
senses.nuances: 口语可说 cucuk vaksin；正式表达可用 menyuntik vaksin 或 memberikan suntikan vaksin。

senses.zh_definition: 通过穿刺把材料串连、缀合或固定起来。
senses.en_definition: To join, thread or fasten materials by piercing them.
senses.ms_definition: Merangkaikan atau menyematkan bahan dengan menusukkannya.
senses.nuances: 强调通过穿刺进行连接。传统制作语境可用 mencucuk atap；把某物插入另一物时常用 mencucukkan。

senses.zh_definition: 挑唆、煽动或挑拨，使人愤怒或发生争执。
senses.en_definition: To incite, provoke or stir someone up against another person.
senses.ms_definition: Menghasut atau membangkitkan kemarahan seseorang.
senses.nuances: 属于贬义比喻用法；正式或较完整的表达可见 mencucuk、mencucuk-cucuk。不是中性的劝说。

senses.zh_definition: 气味或感受如尖物般强烈刺激、刺痛或令人难受。
senses.en_definition: To assail the senses or emotions with a piercing or painful effect.
senses.ms_definition: Memberikan kesan yang kuat atau menyakitkan pada deria atau perasaan.
senses.nuances: 常以 mencucuk 出现在比喻搭配中，必须整体理解；mencucuk hidung 可描写强烈气味，mencucuk hati 可指伤心或刺痛感情。

collocations.en: a smell that assails the nostrils

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Setiap pek makanan mengandungi sepuluh cucuk sate ayam untuk peserta program.
dual_scenarios.zh: 每份供活动参与者享用的餐包内有十串鸡肉沙爹。
dual_scenarios.en: Each meal pack contains ten skewers of chicken satay for programme participants.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Aku nak beli sepuluh cucuk sate ayam je.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saya hendak membeli sepuluh cucuk sate ayam sahaja.
dual_scenarios.zh: 我就买十串鸡肉沙爹。
dual_scenarios.en: I just want ten skewers of chicken satay.
spoken_features: nak 对应 hendak，je 对应 sahaja。
beli 在口语中省略 meN- 前缀。
cucuk 在此为量词，表示串。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku dah sampai kat gerai sate. Kau nak berapa cucuk?
messages.ms_standard: Saya sudah sampai di gerai sate. Berapa cucuk sate yang kamu mahu?
messages.zh: 我到沙爹摊了。你要几串？
messages.en: I'm at the satay stall. How many skewers do you want?

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Sepuluh cucuk sate ayam je. Kuah kacang lebih sikit, ya.
messages.ms_standard: Saya mahu sepuluh cucuk sate ayam sahaja. Tolong berikan sedikit kuah kacang tambahan.
messages.zh: 十串鸡肉的就行。花生酱麻烦多给一点。
messages.en: Just ten chicken skewers, please. A little extra peanut sauce too.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 点餐时可说 Sepuluh cucuk sate ayam, ya。医疗场合对陌生人使用医生、护士称谓及较完整的句子更合适。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 点餐、针刺和注射语境常见。对人使用挑唆义带有指责；seperti kerbau dicucuk hidung 比喻盲目听从，直接用于评价他人容易冒犯。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 点餐时可说 Sepuluh cucuk sate ayam, ya。医疗场合对陌生人使用医生、护士称谓及较完整的句子更合适。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 点餐、针刺和注射语境常见。对人使用挑唆义带有指责；seperti kerbau dicucuk hidung 比喻盲目听从，直接用于评价他人容易冒犯。

etymology.historical_story: Cucuk connects everyday practices through the image of a pointed object entering something. The dictionary includes piercing tools, skewered portions and injections, while related verbs extend to provocation and piercing sensations. Traditional thatch making supplies another recorded use. These cultural connections explain the meaning network without requiring an unverified ancient origin story. [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=cucuk)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读 cu-cuk 时，想象竹签连续两下戳进沙爹肉：先记住刺入，再联想到一串和打一针。

headword.lexical_status: English form used in code-switching; standard Malay electronic term: cip
headword.data_note: official 沿用所要求的条目状态标签，不表示 chip 是规范马来语拼写。sst 为输入原值，不是有效音节划分；英语 chip 为单音节。所列义项供辨识英语夹用，不等同于 DBP 对 chip 的马来语义项认定。

morphology.pattern_note: 英语整词，不能按马来语词缀拆解；ch 表示 /tʃ/。电子义的规范马来语形式是 cip。以下词族属于英语。

word_family.gloss: 芯片组；英语 chip + set 的复合词

senses.zh_definition: 芯片：承载集成电子电路的小块半导体材料或相应器件。
senses.en_definition: A small semiconductor device containing an integrated electronic circuit.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa Inggeris, komponen semikonduktor kecil yang mengandungi litar bersepadu; istilah bahasa Melayunya ialah cip.
senses.nuances: 马来西亚科技交流可能保留英语 chip；规范马来语应写 cip。并非所有芯片都是处理器。[DBP：cip](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=cip)

senses.zh_definition: 食品中的小薄片、小碎块；具体形态取决于食物和英语地区用法。
senses.en_definition: A small piece or thin slice of food; in the plural, also fried potato pieces.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa Inggeris, kepingan atau cebisan kecil makanan; chips juga boleh merujuk kepada kentang goreng atau kerepek kentang mengikut ragam bahasa.
senses.nuances: chocolate chip 是巧克力小粒；potato chips 在美式英语通常指薯片，英式 chips 通常指薯条。不要将电子义的 cip 不加判断地套用到所有食物名称。

senses.zh_definition: 游戏中用来表示金额、分值或投注额的小圆片；筹码。
senses.en_definition: A small counter representing money, points, or a stake in a game.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa Inggeris, kepingan kecil yang digunakan sebagai tanda nilai wang, mata atau pertaruhan dalam permainan.
senses.nuances: 可见于扑克、赌场或桌游语境；具体是否涉及赌博取决于玩法，不能仅凭 chip 一词判断。

senses.zh_definition: 从较大物体上切下、敲下或脱落的小碎片。
senses.en_definition: A small fragment cut, broken, or knocked off a larger object.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa Inggeris, serpihan kecil yang terpotong, pecah atau tertanggal daripada sesuatu benda.
senses.nuances: 马来语通常根据材料使用 serpihan、serpih 或 tatal；不能因为英语都用 chip 就统一译为 cip。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Komponen yang dilabelkan sebagai 'chip' dalam manual bahasa Inggeris itu ialah cip memori yang perlu diganti.
dual_scenarios.zh: 英文手册中标为“chip”的部件，是需要更换的存储芯片。
dual_scenarios.en: The component labelled 'chip' in the English manual is the memory chip that needs replacing.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Chip telefon ni rosak ke? Patutlah tak boleh hidup.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah cip telefon ini rosak? Tidak hairanlah telefon ini tidak dapat dihidupkan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 这手机的芯片坏了吗？难怪开不了机。
dual_scenarios.en: Is the chip in this phone faulty? No wonder it won't turn on.
spoken_features: chip 是英语词形的语码转换；标准句改为 cip
ni 对应 ini，tak 对应 tidak
ke 是口语疑问标记

messages.speaker: Amir (顾客)
messages.ms_spoken: Telefon ni tak boleh hidup. Chip dia rosak ke?
messages.ms_standard: Telefon ini tidak dapat dihidupkan. Adakah cipnya rosak?
messages.zh: 这手机开不了机。是芯片坏了吗？
messages.en: This phone won't turn on. Could the chip be faulty?

messages.speaker: Mei (维修员)
messages.ms_spoken: Belum tahu lagi. Nak periksa bateri dulu lah.
messages.ms_standard: Puncanya belum diketahui. Saya hendak memeriksa baterinya dahulu.
messages.zh: 还不知道原因。我先检查一下电池。
messages.en: We don't know yet. I'll check the battery first.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 科技交流中夹用 chip 通常不涉及礼貌问题；面对不熟悉英语术语的听众，可说 cip，并说明其用途。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 正式马来语报告使用 cip。食品义先确认是薯片、薯条还是巧克力小粒；筹码义涉及赌博时，应留意在场者的宗教及个人立场，避免默认人人参与。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 科技交流中夹用 chip 通常不涉及礼貌问题；面对不熟悉英语术语的听众，可说 cip，并说明其用途。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 正式马来语报告使用 cip。食品义先确认是薯片、薯条还是巧克力小粒；筹码义涉及赌博时，应留意在场者的宗教及个人立场，避免默认人人参与。

etymology.historical_story: English chip goes back to Old English cipp, a small piece of material. The image of a little piece helps connect fragments, food pieces, and gaming counters. Electronics later gave the word another familiar application. Malay uses the adapted spelling cip for the electronic device, while English chip remains visible in mixed-language conversation. [Etymology source](https://www.etymonline.com/word/chip)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: chip 的共同画面是“一小片”：木头碎片、巧克力小粒、电子芯片。规范马来语电子义写 cip，读音相近。

morphology.pattern_note: 英语单音节整词，口语中直接嵌入马来语句子，不作马来语词缀拆分。音标采用英语源词读法；资料包未提供音节划分和爪夷文，保留 null。英语派生词不自动视为马来语词族。

senses.zh_definition: 现金；用于直接付款的纸币和硬币。
senses.en_definition: Money in the form of banknotes and coins.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam percakapan yang bercampur bahasa Inggeris, wang dalam bentuk wang kertas dan duit syiling; wang tunai.
senses.nuances: 零售付款时通常与刷卡、银行转账或电子钱包相对，标准马来语用 wang tunai。英语财务术语中的 cash 有时涵盖银行存款等项目，须按完整术语理解；不能把所有出现的 cash 都限定为手持纸币。官方双语用例可参见 [Bank Negara Malaysia](https://www.bnm.gov.my/survey-on-usage-of-cash-and-cheques)。

senses.zh_definition: 以现金方式付款；在房屋、车辆等购买语境中，也指一次付清、不采用贷款或分期付款。
senses.en_definition: In cash; in major purchases, in full without financing or instalments.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam ungkapan percakapan seperti bayar cash atau beli cash, secara tunai; bagi pembelian tertentu, dengan menjelaskan harga sepenuhnya tanpa pinjaman atau ansuran.
senses.nuances: 这是英语 cash 在马来语口语中充当付款方式状语的用法。买房时说 beli cash 通常强调没有贷款，不一定使用实体钞票。正式文本宜明确写 secara tunai、bayaran penuh 或 tanpa pembiayaan，以免混淆付款媒介与付款安排。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 职场汇报；审核付款告示用语
dual_scenarios.ms: Perkataan 'cash' pada notis pembayaran hendaklah digantikan dengan 'tunai' dalam versi bahasa Melayu.
dual_scenarios.zh: 付款告示的马来语版本应将“cash”改为“tunai”。
dual_scenarios.en: The word 'cash' on the payment notice should be replaced with 'tunai' in the Malay version.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 朋友出门购物前确认付款方式
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Bawa cash sikit, kedai tu tak terima kad.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Bawalah sedikit wang tunai kerana kedai itu tidak menerima bayaran menggunakan kad.
dual_scenarios.zh: 带点现金，那家店不收卡。
dual_scenarios.en: Bring some cash; that shop doesn't take cards.
spoken_features: cash 是英语语码转换，标准对应 wang tunai。
sikit、tu、tak 分别对应 sedikit、itu、tidak。
口语可直接并列两句，标准书面语可用 kerana 明示因果。

messages.speaker: Mei Ling (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku tak bawa cash lah. Kedai tu boleh bayar guna QR tak?
messages.ms_standard: Saya tidak membawa wang tunai. Adakah kedai itu menerima pembayaran melalui kod QR?
messages.zh: 我没带现金啦。那家店能扫码付款吗？
messages.en: I haven't got any cash. Does that shop take QR payments?

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Tak boleh, cash je. Aku bayarkan dulu, nanti kau transfer.
messages.ms_standard: Tidak boleh, kedai itu hanya menerima wang tunai. Saya akan membayarkan dahulu; kamu boleh memindahkan wang kepada saya kemudian.
messages.zh: 不能，只收现金。我先帮你付，之后你转给我。
messages.en: No, it's cash only. I'll cover you first; you can transfer me the money later.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 向店员询问可说 Boleh bayar secara tunai? 或 Boleh bayar guna QR?。没带现金时先确认可用方式，再请求同行者垫付。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: cash 适合日常交易和聊天；正式收据、合同及公文使用 tunai 等明确用语。对方说没有 cash，可能只是没带纸币，不宜据此判断其经济状况。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 向店员询问可说 Boleh bayar secara tunai? 或 Boleh bayar guna QR?。没带现金时先确认可用方式，再请求同行者垫付。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: cash 适合日常交易和聊天；正式收据、合同及公文使用 tunai 等明确用语。对方说没有 cash，可能只是没带纸币，不宜据此判断其经济状况。

etymology.historical_story: English cash developed through French and Italian words for a money box, ultimately connected with Latin capsa, meaning a box or case. The name of the container came to denote the money associated with it. Malaysian speakers use the English word in payment conversations, while standard Malay uses tunai. This origin is recorded by [Dictionary.com](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/cash).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: cash /kæʃ/：想象钞票从钱包里“唰”地抽出来，马上联想到现金。买大件时再问一句：说的是付款方式，还是全款付清？

morphology.pattern_note: 此处采用安汶马来语的整词分析；c 表示 /tʃ/，末尾 e 按所据词典读 /e/。未核实派生词，不把形近的 cele 当作派生形式。

senses.zh_definition: 安汶马来语：马鲁古妇女传统服装内穿的衣物。
senses.en_definition: In Ambon Malay, an undergarment worn with traditional women's clothing of Maluku.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa Melayu Ambon, pakaian dalam yang dipakai bersama pakaian tradisional wanita Maluku.
senses.nuances: 原始数据未给释义，不能据排名认定其为马来西亚规范词。本条采用印度尼西亚马鲁古语言局《安汶马来语—印度尼西亚语双语词典》2022 年版第 23 页所收的区域义，参见 [官方词典](https://pustakabbpm.kemendikdasmen.go.id/index.php?bid=2268&fid=42&p=fstream-pdf)。该来源未证明这就是原数据所指的词义。马来语释义为标准马来语转述；下列为教学组合，未核实为高频搭配。

collocations.zh: 马鲁古妇女的传统内衣

dual_scenarios.context: 文化展览 / 服饰说明；以马来西亚标准马来语介绍区域词
dual_scenarios.ms: Dalam bahasa Melayu Ambon, cole merujuk kepada pakaian dalam yang dipakai bersama pakaian tradisional wanita Maluku.
dual_scenarios.zh: 在安汶马来语中，cole 指搭配马鲁古妇女传统服装穿着的内衣。
dual_scenarios.en: In Ambon Malay, cole denotes an undergarment worn with traditional women's clothing of Maluku.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 马来西亚朋友讨论马鲁古服饰；区域名词嵌入马来西亚口语
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Cole tu pakaian dalam untuk baju tradisional wanita Maluku, kan?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Cole ialah pakaian dalam yang dipakai bersama pakaian tradisional wanita Maluku, bukan?
dual_scenarios.zh: Cole 就是搭配马鲁古妇女传统服装穿的内衣，对吧？
dual_scenarios.en: Cole is the undergarment worn with traditional Maluku women's clothing, right?
spoken_features: tu 是 itu 的口语形式。
kan 用于寻求确认。
dah 是 sudah 的口语形式。
对话采用马来西亚口语，不能作为安汶方言原生用例。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku dah baca penerangan tu. Cole ni pakaian dalam, kan?
messages.ms_standard: Saya sudah membaca penerangan itu. Cole ini ialah pakaian dalam, bukan?
messages.zh: 我看过说明了。Cole 是内衣，对吧？
messages.en: I've read the description. Cole is an undergarment, right?

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Ya, untuk pakaian tradisional wanita Maluku. Nak tengok gambarnya?
messages.ms_standard: Ya, pakaian dalam itu dipakai bersama pakaian tradisional wanita Maluku. Mahukah kamu melihat gambarnya?
messages.zh: 对，是搭配马鲁古妇女传统服装穿的。要看看图片吗？
messages.en: Yes, it's worn with traditional Maluku women's clothing. Want to see a picture?

etymology.historical_story: Cole is documented in the Maluku language office's 2022 Ambon Malay dictionary as an undergarment associated with women's traditional clothing. The same dictionary separately records cele as traditional clothing. This distinction offers a useful cultural picture: a named garment can belong to an ensemble without naming the entire outfit. The source does not establish cole's ultimate etymology.

etymology.historical_story: As a personal name, Colin has more than one historical route. One comes through French pet forms of Nicolas; another is associated with Gaelic Cailean. Shared spelling does not establish which history belongs to an individual bearer. Neither history supplies a Malay common-word meaning, and the lowercase corpus token alone cannot establish that a person's name was intended. [Sources: Etymonline](https://www.etymonline.com/word/Colin), [Behind the Name](https://www.behindthename.com/name/colin-1).

etymology.historical_story: County entered English through French forms connected with the territory or jurisdiction of a count. The older Latin background involves comitatus, associated with a count's office. A modern county therefore carries a trace of aristocratic administration in its name, even where its present institutions are elected and its boundaries serve contemporary local government. [Source: Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/county).

etymology.historical_story: Cepatnya illustrates the expressive flexibility of Malay word endings. A speaker can use cepat to describe speed, then add -nya to express amazement: Cepatnya! The same written form can help name the rapidity of an event. Everyday reactions to arrivals, finished work and passing time therefore share a form whose interpretation depends on its sentence. [Sources: DBP on cepat](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=cepatan), [DBP on -nya](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=tugas+nya)

etymology.historical_story: Carian is formed within Malay from cari and the noun-forming suffix -an. Its dictionary meaning points to something sought, while carian bujang preserves an established association with property acquired before marriage. In digital usage, the same form serves information retrieval through expressions such as enjin carian, linking familiar word formation with modern technology. [DBP dictionary](https://prpmv1.dbp.gov.my/Search.aspx?k=pencarian), [DBP digital usage](https://dewanbahasa.jendeladbp.my/2022/01/25/2371/)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: cari 是“找”；加 -an 得到名词 carian。看见 enjin carian 就想“负责帮你找资料的引擎”。

etymology.historical_story: The spelling ching occurs in descriptions of Southeast Asian musical instruments. Cambodian documentation also uses chhing for small bronze finger cymbals. This establishes a musical referent, but does not establish when or how the spelling entered Malay. Without a Malay historical citation, its borrowing route and earliest Malay use remain unresolved.

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries distinguish the emotional cry cis from a separate homonym preserved in senapang cis. The emotional word can itself become a verb: mengeciskan means to direct contempt at someone. This illustrates how a brief exclamation can enter ordinary word formation. The available evidence does not establish a particular donor language or first historical occurrence.

etymology.historical_story: Caleb comes from the Hebrew biblical naming tradition. Its best-known early bearer appears among the scouts sent into Canaan. The name is commonly connected with Hebrew kelev, meaning dog, although its precise interpretation remains debated. Its historical associations explain the name’s background; they do not give it an ordinary Malay lexical meaning. [Source: Behind the Name](https://www.behindthename.com/name/caleb).

etymology.historical_story: Crewe tells a story of a place transformed by railways. The station opened in 1837, taking its name from the area near Crewe Hall. A railway settlement then grew around it and adopted the station's name. This explains the modern town's identity; it does not establish the deeper linguistic origin of the name. Source: [Crewe Town Council heritage resource](https://www.crewetowncouncil.gov.uk/wp-content/uploads/2024/07/FINAL-Migration-to-Crewe-KS2-and-KS3-compressed.pdf).

etymology.historical_story: Cameron Highlands takes its name from William Cameron, a government surveyor associated with an expedition through the Titiwangsa Range in 1885. In Malaysian conversation, the full geographical name can be shortened to Cameron when the destination is clear. [District council history](https://mdcameron.gov.my/en/visitors/cameron-background)

etymology.historical_story: English club first referred to a heavy stick. Its association meaning developed in the seventeenth century, apparently through the idea of people gathering into a compact group. Malay adopted the association word as kelab. This history helps distinguish the English spelling seen in mixed conversation from the established Malay form used in ordinary formal writing. [Etymology](https://www.etymonline.com/word/club), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=kelab)

etymology.historical_story: Conlon illustrates how a surname can enter a Malay text without becoming a Malay vocabulary word. The Irish surname index associates this spelling with several Irish forms, rather than a single uncontested origin. Its appearance therefore preserves a person's name, not a transferable everyday meaning. Learning it as an intact name avoids inventing a Malay root or misleading literal translation. [Surname index](https://www.duchas.ie/en/surnames?SearchText=Conlon).

senses.zh_definition: 将原本分开的资料、业务或单位整合成一个整体的；合并的。

senses.zh_definition: 将集团内母公司及子公司的财务资料作为一个经济整体编制的；合并财务口径的。

senses.ms_definition: Berkaitan dengan maklumat kewangan syarikat induk dan subsidiarinya yang dipersembahkan sebagai satu entiti ekonomi.
senses.nuances: 会计用法对应 disatukan；consolidated financial statements 对应 penyata kewangan disatukan，不能简单理解为把几份文件放在一起。这里的马来语解释为释义转述，术语对应依据：[DBP 财务术语表](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=74812&keyword=statement)。

senses.zh_definition: 经加强而变得更稳固、更牢靠的；得到巩固的。

etymology.historical_story: Consolidated is an English participial form of consolidate, whose ancestry reaches Latin consolidare, meaning to make firm. The underlying image joins togetherness with solidity. That image explains both modern meanings: separate elements can become one whole, while a position or achievement can become more secure. Neither meaning requires a Malay morphological analysis. See [Collins word origin](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/consolidate).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住熟悉的 solid：零散东西合成一块更扎实的整体，就能记住合并与巩固两层意思。

morphology.pattern_note: -ku 是 aku 的附着形式，此处表示“我的”，并非派生新词的普通后缀；按模板记为 suffix。拼写连写，词根不变。输入包的 jawi 仅为词根 cara 的写法；syllables 未提供，保留 null，实际可分为 ca.ra.ku。

etymology.historical_story: Caraku has two historical layers: cara is traced to Sanskrit ācāra, meaning conduct or customary practice, while -ku is the Malay bound form associated with aku. The finished expression remains transparent to present-day speakers: it means my way. Its personal voice suits conversation, reflective prose, and lyrics, whereas official correspondence generally favours cara saya. [Etymology reference](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/cara#Malay).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: cara＝方法，-ku＝我的：把“方法”贴上“我”的标签，就得到 caraku。

etymology.historical_story: English chance came through Old French cheance, associated with how events fall out. Its ancestry reaches Latin cadere, meaning to fall, with a historical connection to falling dice. The image connects uncertainty, fortune and opportunity. In Malay conversation, using the English word represents language mixing; it does not itself establish official Malay lexical status. [Académie française](https://www.dictionnaire-academie.fr/article/A9C1567)

etymology.historical_story: Cho reflects Japanese chō, associated with 調, a musical mode or tonal organization. Its cultural background includes gagaku, Japan’s court music, whose surviving tōgaku modes belong to the ryo and ritsu classes. Malay preserves the specialist spelling cho in DBP’s music terminology. The term connects Malay music scholarship with an East Asian tradition of classifying melodic structures. [Japan Arts Council: Gagaku modes](https://www2.ntj.jac.go.jp/dglib/contents/learn/edc22/en/category/kangen/on1.html)

etymology.historical_story: Clara comes from a Latin feminine form associated with brightness and renown. It developed into a personal name in early Christian usage, and Saint Clare of Assisi became an important bearer in its cultural history. Related forms include French Claire and Italian Chiara. In Malay, Clara remains a personal name rather than an adjective. Source: [Real Academia Galega](https://academia.gal/nomes/-/nome/Clara).

etymology.historical_story: English crap developed from older words associated with chaff, scraps, and discarded material. Its later meanings include bodily waste and worthless talk. The familiar story connecting its origin to plumber Thomas Crapper is mistaken: the word existed independently of his surname. Its earlier linguistic ancestry remains partly uncertain. [Online Etymology Dictionary](https://www.etymonline.com/word/crap)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 想到“把废话和废物丢掉”：crap 可指胡扯、垃圾货或粪便。记义时同时记住它的粗俗语气。

morphology.pattern_note: 整词作为独立专名记忆，无马来语词缀变化；不可拆成 camel 与其他成分解释。

senses.zh_definition: 卡梅洛特；亚瑟王传说中亚瑟王的宫廷所在地或王都。
senses.en_definition: The legendary city or court associated with King Arthur and his knights.
senses.ms_definition: Kota atau pusat istana Raja Arthur dalam legenda kesateriaannya.
senses.nuances: 专有名词，规范正文大写。属于文学传说，不能直接当作已确定位置的历史城市。本条马来语释义为编写释义，并非 DBP 引文。依据：[罗切斯特大学 Camelot Project](https://d.lib.rochester.edu/camelot/text/frequently-asked-questions.html)。

senses.zh_definition: 借指理想化的社会、宫廷或政治黄金时代；在美国历史叙述中也用来指肯尼迪总统时期。
senses.en_definition: An idealized place or golden age, especially the Kennedy presidency in American historical discourse.
senses.ms_definition: Kiasan bagi tempat atau zaman yang diidealkan, khususnya zaman kepresidenan John F. Kennedy dalam wacana sejarah Amerika.
senses.nuances: 这是依赖英美文化背景的借喻，并非马来语中普遍通用的“黄金时代”同义词。首次使用宜说明所指。依据：[罗切斯特大学关于现代 Camelot 隐喻的说明](https://d.lib.rochester.edu/camelot/text/frequently-asked-questions.html)。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 词本身没有敬语或贬义色彩；向不熟悉欧洲文学的马来西亚读者介绍时，可补充 kota legenda Raja Arthur。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合文学、影视和历史评论。用来形容现实政府或领袖时带有理想化评价，应交代比较背景。

etymology.historical_story: Camelot first appears by name in Chrétien de Troyes's twelfth-century Lancelot. Later romances developed it into Arthur's principal court, although writers disagreed about its location. Its literary prestige eventually made the name a metaphor for ideal leadership and a lost golden age, including the remembered Kennedy presidency. [Source: University of Rochester](https://d.lib.rochester.edu/camelot/text/frequently-asked-questions.html).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 听到 Camelot，就想象亚瑟王宫廷里的圆桌；把整段读音与“传说中的理想王都”绑定，不拆字猜词源。

etymology.historical_story: Chanel began as Gabrielle Chanel's family name before becoming a fashion-house name. In 1910 she opened Chanel Modes, a Paris hat boutique whose designs attracted actresses. Clothing and couture followed, turning a personal surname into an international brand. The name remains a proper noun rather than a general word for luxury. [Source: CHANEL history](https://www.chanel.com/au/about-chanel/the-house-of-chanel/1910/).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: Chanel 对应“香奈儿”，想象香水瓶上的品牌名；法语 ch 读 /ʃ/，不要按英语 channel 的 /tʃ/ 起音来读。

morphology.pattern_note: 基本词，不拆分词缀；字母 c 读 /tʃ/。派生 mencalarkan 时，meN- 在 c 前实现为 men-，c 保留。

etymology.historical_story: Calar is a Malay root naming the visible line left by a sharp object. Its word family moves from a physical mark to figurative damage: tercalar can describe a harmed reputation. The connection is easy to picture because a surface and a public image can both lose their former smoothness. No specific ancient borrowing is asserted here.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 calar pada cat：车漆 cat 上多了一道 calar。calar 是“那道痕”，tercalar 是“已经被刮伤”。

etymology.historical_story: The Ohio city takes its name from Moses Cleaveland, who led the surveying party associated with its establishment in 1796. The modern spelling, Cleveland, differs from his surname. In Malay, the name is retained as a proper noun rather than translated, so its historical origin does not create a Malay root-and-affix structure. Source: [City of Cleveland](https://www.clevelandohio.gov/explore/about-cleveland/history-facts).

etymology.historical_story: Chennai is associated with the older settlement name Chennapattanam. One historical account connects that name with Chennappa Nayak, whose family was involved in the land grant preceding the English settlement around Fort St George. Nearby Madraspatnam later merged with this settlement. The city's names therefore preserve overlapping local and colonial histories rather than a Malay derivational pattern. [Chennai District history](https://chennai.nic.in/history/).

etymology.historical_story: Cita in its mental and emotional senses comes from Sanskrit citta, associated with thought and the mind. That background helps connect feelings, ideas, and aspirations within one Malay word. Modern learners often encounter it through cita-cita and cita rasa. The cloth meaning is a separate homonym and should be learned independently. [梵语借词研究](https://sealang.net/archives/nusa/pdf/nusa-v19-p1-38.pdf), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=cita)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: c读“ch”：把ci-ta联想成“期待”，心里期待的就是cita；反复挂在心上的目标就是cita-cita。花布义另记kain cita。

senses.zh_definition: 爱挑毛病、抱怨或唠叨的；对许多细节都不满意的。
senses.en_definition: Fussy or fault-finding, often complaining or nagging about details.
senses.ms_definition: Banyak bercakap kerana ada sahaja yang tidak kena; suka berleter, mencela atau bersungut.
senses.nuances: 通常带负面评价，既可指爱唠叨，也可指要求多、难以取悦。cerewet tentang makanan 指对吃的挑剔，不一定表示说话多；不能把单纯健谈的人一概称为 cerewet。

senses.zh_definition: 工序繁琐、细节多而费事的。

senses.ms_definition: Berselok-belok dan memerlukan banyak kerja kecil yang rumit atau menyusahkan.
senses.nuances: 用于工作、程序或制作过程，评价的是操作麻烦，而非人的性格。正式报告可按语境改用 rumit 或 memerlukan penelitian yang tinggi；后者只强调需要细致，不含同等程度的抱怨。

etymology.historical_story: The supplied dictionary evidence does not establish a deeper historical origin for cerewet. Its two senses nevertheless offer a memorable cultural connection: a person can find fault with every little detail, while a task can demand attention to countless little details. Malay therefore uses the same adjective for troublesome fussiness in people and fiddly complexity in work.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ce-ré-wét 的三拍想成“这也嫌、那也嫌、还要念”：形容人是挑剔唠叨，形容事情是细节繁琐。

etymology.historical_story: English channel came through Old French chanel from Latin canalis, a watercourse or pipe. Its physical image later supported meanings involving the passage of information and broadcast signals. In Malaysian mixed-language conversation, that same image remains useful for television services and online publishing spaces. Standard Malay generally expresses these meanings with saluran. See [Etymonline](https://www.etymonline.com/word/channel).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 channel 想成一条输送信息的“水道”：节目沿它传来，就是频道；消息沿它传递，就是渠道。

etymology.historical_story: The spelling suggests an English formation combining chrono-, associated with time, and sphere, suggesting a ball or domain. This is a structural interpretation, not a verified account of one original coinage. Different fictional settings reuse the name: Red Alert names a teleportation device, while Dota 2 names a Faceless Void ability. Neither establishes an official Malay dictionary entry. [Red Alert manual](https://www.bestoldgames.net/download/games/command-and-conquer-red-alert/command-and-conquer-red-alert-dos-manual.pdf); [Dota 2](https://www.dota2.com/hero/facelessvoid).

etymology.historical_story: English coach ultimately comes from the Hungarian place name Kocs, associated with carriage making. The word travelled through European languages before entering English as a vehicle name. Its later teaching sense is traditionally explained through the image of a tutor carrying a student through an examination, much as a carriage carries passengers. [Etymological account](https://www.etymonline.com/word/coach)

etymology.historical_story: The deeper etymology of cendawan is not securely established in the references consulted. Its cultural history is easier to trace through Malay proverbs: mushrooms evoke rapid abundance, and their pale appearance also supplies traditional comparisons. These expressions show how familiar observations of fungi became a vocabulary for describing human appearance and social change. [Proverb source](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=cendawan).

etymology.historical_story: English case brings together separate histories. The situation or legal matter sense comes through French from Latin casus, associated with happening or falling. The container sense comes through French from Latin capsa, a box. Malay kes corresponds to the former group; protective containers instead need words such as bekas or sarung. [Collins dictionary](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/case)
