etymology.historical_story: English cheese continues Old English forms such as cēse, ultimately connected through Germanic borrowing with Latin cāseus. In Malaysian conversation, the English word can appear inside a Malay sentence, while keju supplies the standard Malay equivalent. The pairing is a useful reminder that shared food references do not require identical spellings across languages. [English etymology](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/cheese); [DBP equivalence](https://dewanbahasa.jendeladbp.my/2024/05/03/13225/).

etymology.historical_story: English cipher ultimately comes from Arabic ṣifr, meaning empty or zero, through medieval European forms. A word associated with numerical notation later developed a connection with secret writing. Its modern technical sense concerns encryption systems. Malay terminology uses sifer for this concept, while the original English spelling often appears alongside it in bilingual technical material. [Word history](https://www.etymonline.com/word/cipher).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 cipher 读成“赛弗”，想象一封信被换成看不懂的符号；马来语技术词记作 sifer。

etymology.historical_story: English chief reached Middle English through Anglo-French chief or chef, ultimately from Latin caput, meaning head. The body metaphor helps connect a group's leader with the highest office and the most important matter. Malay normally expresses these meanings with ketua or utama; encountering chief in conversation does not itself establish a naturalized Malay word. [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/chief)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读 /tʃiːf/，把 chief 想成站在队伍最前面的负责人：用于人是“首领”，用于职位是“首席”，用于事情是“主要”。

senses.en_definition: Remote computing resources and services accessed over a network, especially the internet; the cloud.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam penggunaan istilah Inggeris, sumber dan perkhidmatan pengkomputeran jarak jauh yang dicapai melalui rangkaian, khususnya Internet; padanan bahasa Melayunya ialah awan.
senses.nuances: 此处记录英语技术词在马来语交流中的混用，不认定 cloud 为规范马来语词。正式马来文使用 awan、pengkomputeran awan 或 storan awan。status 按指定格式保留为 official，不代表 DBP 已认可 cloud 为马来语词头。马来文释义为编辑说明，并非 DBP 对 cloud 的直接释义。英语本义“云”对应 awan；本条不将英语的全部义项列为马来语义项。术语依据见 [DBP：pengkomputeran awan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=pengkomputeran)。

etymology.historical_story: The computing use of cloud draws on network diagrams in which a cloud shape represents the internet while leaving its internal infrastructure unspecified. Malay expresses the same metaphor with awan. DBP explains this diagrammatic connection in its account of pengkomputeran awan. When speakers retain English cloud in Malay conversation, they carry that technical metaphor across languages without translating the word.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: cloud /klaʊd/ 就是英语“云”：把远端服务器画成一朵云，文件传过去就是存入云端；规范马来语对应 awan。

etymology.historical_story: The supplied dictionary does not establish the origin of conor. Its documented interest lies in fish naming: one local name can cover more than one scientific identification. Malaysian fisheries guides use the fuller name conor curut for Saurida tumbil. This shows why a market name and a biological species name need not have identical boundaries. [LKIM](https://www.lkim.gov.my/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/Buku-Ikan-Ikan-Komersial-Di-Malaysia.pdf)

etymology.historical_story: Carlton belongs to a family of English place names associated with settlements of free peasants. Historical explanations connect ceorl or Scandinavian karl with tūn, meaning a settlement or estate. These place names also supplied surnames. This background explains the name's formation, but cannot identify which person, place, or organization the supplied token denotes. See [Carlton Parish Council](https://www.carltonpc.co.uk/files/Carlton%20Place%20Names.pdf).

etymology.historical_story: Cebisan belongs to the Malay word family built around cebis, a small scrap or fragment. The suffix -an names the resulting piece. Its everyday imagery is easy to picture: torn paper or leftover cloth. In reflective writing, the same image extends to memories and life stories, presenting an incomplete recollection as something preserved from a larger whole.

etymology.historical_story: The compound brings together cita and rasa, linking inclination with sensory experience. Its dictionary meanings range from food flavour to personal preference, allowing the same expression to describe a dish, a wardrobe or a television programme. This connection offers a useful cultural bridge between tasting something and finding it personally appealing. Standard Malaysian spelling keeps the two words separate. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=cita+rasa)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 rasa“感觉、味道”：舌头喜欢的是风味，心里喜欢的是品味；两种意思都用 cita rasa。

etymology.historical_story: Cowok is associated with colloquial Indonesian rather than formal Malaysian address. Uri Tadmor’s Indonesian vocabulary in the World Loanword Database analyses it as a back-formation from céwék, meaning woman, while treating cowok itself as morphologically unanalysable. Kamus Dewan records both the young-man and boyfriend senses, preserving its conversational character. [Sources: WOLD](https://wold.clld.org/word/71261839426667229), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=cowok).

etymology.historical_story: English creasy combines crease with the adjective-forming suffix -y. Collins dates this formation to 1855–1860. This English history does not establish a Malay borrowing, and the packet supplies no contextual evidence identifying its original occurrence. [Collins](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/creasy)

etymology.historical_story: As a drink name, Coke became a registered Coca-Cola trademark in 1945. English also has lowercase coke meaning an industrial fuel or, in slang, cocaine. These meanings must be distinguished by context rather than merged into one origin story. In Malay ordering conversations, the capitalized brand name identifies the beverage. [Brand history](https://www.coca-colacompany.com/about-us/history/the-asa-candler-era); [English senses](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/coke).

etymology.historical_story: Kamus Dewan records cal as a colloquial clothing word and explains it through selendang, mafela, sal, syal, and cala. This places it within vocabulary for wrapping or draping cloth around the body. The available evidence does not establish its borrowing route or earliest use, so a specific foreign origin cannot responsibly be assigned. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274404&keyword=cal)

etymology.historical_story: Chandramukhi is associated with Sanskrit Candramukhī, conventionally interpreted as a woman whose face resembles the moon. The image connects a name with a poetic comparison rather than a literal description. Its appearance in a Malay text may identify a person or fictional character; it does not establish a Malay common noun. Reference: [Candramukhī dictionary material](https://www.wisdomlib.org/definition/candramukhi).

etymology.historical_story: English chick developed as a shortened form of chicken, according to Oxford’s etymological note. Its literal meaning concerns a young bird, while a separate informal use refers to a young woman. When the word appears inside a Malay conversation, it may simply represent English code-switching; that appearance alone does not establish an official Malay borrowing. [Source: Oxford Learner’s Dictionaries](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/definition/english/chick?q=chick).

etymology.historical_story: Celana carries a trace of clothing exchange across the Indian Ocean. Research on port communities connects it with Kannada or Tulu callaṇa, meaning short breeches. Garments and their names travelled together through maritime contact. In Malay, the borrowed word became an independent noun and acquired the regular derivative bercelana, meaning to wear trousers. [Research](https://doi.org/10.1017/S0165115318000645).

etymology.historical_story: English crore comes from Hindi karoṛ, ultimately based on Sanskrit koṭi, meaning ten million. It preserves a South Asian way of naming large quantities alongside lakh, meaning one hundred thousand. For Malaysian readers encountering Indian news or film earnings, the cultural bridge is numerical: translate the counting unit before interpreting the amount or its currency. [Reference: Oxford Learner's Dictionaries](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/crore)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 /krɔːr/ 记成整块声音，再牢绑定“千万”：1 crore = 10 million；先记单位，别把它当货币。

etymology.historical_story: Cincang is linked in Kamus Dewan to cencang, a word for repeated chopping with a blade. Its cultural reach extends beyond the kitchen: the proverb air dicencang, tiada putus pictures water that cannot be severed, expressing how family ties survive quarrels. This is a documented cultural association, rather than proof of a particular ancient origin. See [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=244840&keyword=cencang).

etymology.historical_story: Cewek illustrates how closely related language communities can share vocabulary while assigning it different registers. Kamus Dewan records an Indonesian-marked colloquial meaning, a young woman, alongside the girlfriend meaning. For Malaysian learners, that contrast matters more than a speculative ancient origin: a word encountered in Indonesian dialogue may be understood locally yet still sound informal. The cited entry does not establish an earlier derivation. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=teman+wanita)

morphology.pattern_note: 词根无词缀；meN- 遇 c 通常变为 men-，保留 c，形成 mencekik。词尾 k 常读作喉塞音 [ʔ]；部分马来西亚口音将末音节读作 [keʔ]。

etymology.historical_story: Cekik offers a vivid example of bodily experience shaping Malay metaphor. Its literal image is a throat held so tightly that breathing becomes difficult. The same word family describes poverty and exploitation as pressures that leave people struggling for air. The established expression mencekik darah turns that image into a forceful criticism of oppressive charges or demands.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 cekik 末尾突然收住的 [ʔ] 当作“气被卡住”的声音提示：掐住脖子，再联想到价格压得人喘不过气。

etymology.historical_story: The English machine name developed through a visual comparison with the crane bird: a lifting machine's projecting arm suggested a long neck. That connection belongs to English word history. For Malaysian Malay, the useful distinction is between English crane in mixed conversation and kren in standard terminology. [Word-origin reference](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/crane_1).

etymology.historical_story: Christina developed from Christiana, the Latin feminine form associated with Christian. Related spellings travelled across European languages, including Cristina and Kristina. In a Malay sentence, Christina functions simply as someone's name, with its spelling normally preserved. Its historical religious association does not establish the beliefs of a present-day bearer. See [Behind the Name](https://www.behindthename.com/name/christina).

etymology.historical_story: Christmas preserves an old religious expression inside an everyday holiday name. It developed through Middle English from Old English Crīstes mæsse, referring to Christ's Mass or festival. Its modern meaning also extends to the surrounding festive season. Malay uses the adapted spelling Krismas, while English Christmas remains recognizable in bilingual greetings, advertising, and conversation. [American Heritage](https://ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=christmas); [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=382696&keyword=krismas)

etymology.historical_story: Chile is a geographical name whose deeper origin remains disputed. Proposed explanations connect it with Indigenous languages, local place names, or a bird's call. Spanish usage carried the name into international circulation. For Malay learners, it is best remembered as a complete country name rather than assigned a single, supposedly certain ancient meaning. etymology.historical_story: English cutler came through Middle English cuteler from Old French coutelier, related to coutel, meaning knife. Medieval Yorkshire records connect the occupation with knife production and, in some cases, retailing. The occupational label also became a surname. This is an English word history; its appearance in an English–Malay dictionary does not establish Malay borrowing. [American Heritage](https://www.ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=Cutler), [Yorkshire Historical Dictionary](https://yorkshiredictionary.york.ac.uk/words/cutler)

etymology.historical_story: Cotys illustrates why a word list needs its original context. A museum publication discusses a coin issued in the name of a Bosporan ruler called Cotys, while the Natural History Museum records cotys within a butterfly's scientific name. These attestations establish different uses of the spelling, but neither establishes a Malay common noun or the intended source of this token. [Historical source](https://doi.org/10.52800/ajst.1.17.a5); [taxonomic source](https://www.nhm.ac.uk/our-science/data/lepindex/detail?taxonno=195072)

etymology.historical_story: The available dictionary evidence does not establish catat's deeper historical origin. Its recorded word family nevertheless reveals a useful semantic journey: writing produces catatan, the person recording becomes a pencatat, and an event may remain tercatat. The same verb also describes making history or registering a victory, connecting ordinary notes with publicly remembered achievements. etymology.historical_story: English canyon comes from Spanish cañón. Its deeper ancestry is less certain: dictionary explanations connect it either with a word for a tube or with a word related to a street or passage. Malay uses the adapted spelling kanyon alongside ngarai, while the English spelling remains familiar in international geographical names. [American Heritage Dictionary](https://www.ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=canyon), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=ngarai)

etymology.historical_story: The English bird name canary comes through French and Spanish expressions linking the bird to the Canary Islands. Its familiar yellow domestic forms also supplied a colour name. For a Malay learner, the important distinction is between that English spelling and burung kenari, the Malay equivalent recorded in DBP's English–Malay dictionary. [Etymonline](https://www.etymonline.com/word/canary), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=kenari)

etymology.historical_story: English colonel ultimately comes from Italian colonnello, associated with a column of soldiers. French transmission introduced an r-containing form, while later spelling reflected the Italian ancestry. English consequently retained a pronunciation resembling kernel. Malay uses the distinct spelling kolonel, so the English spelling and pronunciation should be learned separately. [Merriam-Webster](https://scrabble.m-w.com/dictionary/colonel)

etymology.historical_story: Cristiano mempunyai hubungan sejarah dengan bentuk Latin Christianus, yang bermaksud Kristian. Penjelasan onomastik yang dipetik oleh Ciberdúvidas turut menyebut kemungkinan perantaraan bahasa Itali, tetapi menandainya sebagai persoalan. Apabila digunakan dalam ayat Melayu, nama ini tetap merujuk kepada individu. Makna sejarahnya tidak boleh dijadikan bukti agama seseorang yang menyandang nama tersebut. etymology.historical_story: Walter Scott introduced Cedric as a character name in Ivanhoe, published in 1819. It apparently reshapes the older name Cerdic, although the underlying meaning is uncertain. Frances Hodgson Burnett later used Cedric for the young hero of Little Lord Fauntleroy. Its literary history is clearer than the confident translations sometimes attached to it. [Behind the Name](https://www.behindthename.com/name/cedric)

etymology.historical_story: Older Malay spelling used ch where modern spelling commonly uses c. This makes a connection between chet and cet plausible in an exclamation, but not certain without a sentence. A separate documented form, Chet., occurs in older book records as an abbreviation for chetakan. These possibilities require different interpretations and should remain distinct.

etymology.historical_story: Cadillac began as an automobile company in 1902. Its name honours Antoine de la Mothe Cadillac, associated with the founding of Detroit. The name therefore carries a person's identity into automotive history. In Malay, it remains a brand name rather than a word built from local roots. [Source: GM Heritage](https://www.gm.com/heritage).

etymology.historical_story: Cassie is an English familiar form associated with Cassandra and other names beginning with Cass-. etymology.historical_story: Kamus Dewan records car as a Kelantan regional word and explains it through limbah and pelimbahan. Its documented meaning concerns a place where dirty water is discharged. This preserves a local term for a practical feature of domestic surroundings. The dictionary evidence does not establish its deeper origin, so a connection with English car or another similar-looking word should not be assumed.

etymology.historical_story: Costa comes from Latin and retains the anatomical meaning of rib in scientific English. Its meaning also extends to structures that resemble ribs, including a leaf midrib and an insect wing vein. This physical resemblance connects several specialist uses, while Malay translation distinguishes the anatomical tulang rusuk from the structures described in other biological fields. [Merriam-Webster: costa](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/costa)

senses.zh_definition: 器物末端分出的叉、齿或叉状部分。

senses.zh_definition: 从主要道路、河道或铁路分出的支路、岔道或分支河道。
senses.en_definition: A branch of a road, river, railway, or similar route.
senses.ms_definition: Laluan atau alur yang berpisah daripada jalan, sungai atau landasan utama.
senses.nuances: cabang 指分出的路线或河道；要明确表示交汇点或岔口，可用 persimpangan 或 percabangan。河流语境不宜一律译成“支流”，须判断水流方向。

senses.zh_definition: 机构、企业或组织所属的分支单位。

senses.zh_definition: 学科、知识领域或分类体系中的分支。
senses.en_definition: A subdivision of a field of knowledge or a classification.
senses.ms_definition: Bidang kecil atau pecahan dalam ilmu, rumpun bahasa atau pengelasan lain.
senses.nuances: 用于学科和分类体系，延续“一个主体分出多个部分”的形象。

senses.zh_definition: 社会中的某一阶层或群体。
senses.en_definition: A social group or stratum.
senses.ms_definition: Golongan atau lapisan masyarakat.
senses.nuances: 属于较少见、带旧式叙述色彩的用法；现代通常说 golongan 或 lapisan。上述机构、学科及社会分层义参见 [DBP：cabang](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=cabang)。

etymology.historical_story: English chapman descends from Old English cēapman, combining a word for trade with man. Historical records document merchants and dealers described this way, and the occupational label also became the surname Chapman. These English developments explain two possible interpretations of the input, but they do not establish its adoption as a standard Malay word.

etymology.historical_story: Cathy belongs to a family of English personal names associated with Catherine and Katherine. Their history leads back to Greek Aikaterine, whose ultimate origin is uncertain. etymology.historical_story: Cale illustrates how regional bird names preserve local vocabulary alongside more widely recognised names. A Riau Malay dictionary uses it for a murai, while Natuna's Bunguran Barat district profile identifies it as murai batu. These records document regional usage rather than a proven ancient origin. Its earlier history, source language, and route of transmission remain unverified.

etymology.historical_story: Clayton is an English habitational surname associated with several places bearing that name. Its historical elements are Old English clǣg, meaning clay, and tūn, meaning an enclosure or settlement. A landscape description thus became a place name and subsequently a family name. This history does not identify the particular Clayton intended in an isolated corpus token. [Dictionary of American Family Names](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/clayton)

senses.en_definition: Caesarean delivery, as attested in Indonesian expressions such as bedah cesar; not verified as a standard Malaysian Malay headword.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam penggunaan bahasa Indonesia tertentu, khususnya frasa bedah cesar, merujuk kepada kelahiran melalui pembedahan; bentuk ini belum disahkan sebagai kata masukan baku bahasa Melayu Malaysia.
senses.nuances: 这是有语境限制的释义，不能替代缺失的原始语料。印尼研究文献确有 bedah cesar；DBP 所列马来语对应表达为 pembedahan Caesarean。没有足够证据将该输入标为 official，也不能将它自动改成 sesar。[印尼研究文献](https://download.garuda.kemdikbud.go.id/article.php?article=3483744&title=Keefektifan+Ketoprofen+Dan+Ketorolak+Sebagai+Analgesik+Pada+Pasien+Pasca+Bedah+Cesar&val=30394)、[DBP 对应术语](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=313048&keyword=section)。

senses.zh_definition: 为航海或航空导航而编制的专用地图；海图或航空图。

senses.ms_definition: Peta yang disediakan untuk membantu pelayaran atau penerbangan.
senses.nuances: 这是导航专用义，不泛指所有地图；一般地图通常称 peta。释义依据 [DBP：carta](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=carta)。

senses.zh_definition: 以图形、表格或示意图有系统地呈现资料的图表；也用于表示歌曲等项目的排名榜。
senses.en_definition: An organized display of information using a graph, table or diagram; also, a ranked listing.
senses.ms_definition: Helaian yang memberikan maklumat dalam bentuk graf, jadual atau gambar rajah.
senses.nuances: carta 是较广的上位词，可表示组织结构、流程、数据或排名；graf 更侧重数据关系，jadual 更侧重行列排列。音乐语境中的 carta 可指排行榜。核心图表义依据 [DBP：carta](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=carta)。

etymology.historical_story: A useful cultural story lies in carta's two established domains: navigating physical space and organizing information. DBP records both navigational maps and displays of business, organizational or other data. The same word therefore connects a sailor's chart with an office diagram. This semantic connection is documented; it does not establish a particular borrowing route. [DBP：carta](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=carta)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 carta 和英语 chart 连起来记：航海时看“航图”，汇报时看“图表”；开头 c 要读成“ch”。

morphology.pattern_note: 在马来语语境中作为英语整词借用，不分析为马来语词缀。英语历史构词为 cybernetic 与 organism 的拼缀；cy- 和 -borg 不是这里可自由套用的马来语词缀。

senses.zh_definition: 赛博格；将生物体与维持、恢复或增强其功能的人工机械或电子部件整合而成的有机体。
senses.en_definition: An organism whose biological functions are maintained, restored, or enhanced by integrated artificial components.
senses.ms_definition: Organisma yang fungsi biologinya dikekalkan, dipulihkan atau dipertingkat melalui penggabungan komponen mekanikal atau elektronik dengan tubuhnya.
senses.nuances: 常见于科幻及人机融合讨论；纯机械机器人不自动属于 cyborg。此处马来语释义为编辑性释义，输入包没有提供 DBP 定义。status 按指定模板保留，不构成 DBP 正式核定的证据。IPA 采用英语英式读音，参见 [Cambridge：cyborg](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/pronunciation/english/cyborg)。概念依据 [Clynes 与 Kline 的原文](https://faculty.uca.edu/rnovy/Clynes--Cyborgs%20and%20Space.htm)。

etymology.historical_story: Manfred E. Clynes and Nathan S. Kline introduced cyborg in their 1960 article Cyborgs and Space, blending cybernetic and organism. Their proposal concerned adapting bodily regulation to extraterrestrial environments through integrated artificial systems. The original idea emphasized automatic physiological support, rather than the spectacular metal bodies familiar from later science fiction. [Source: original article](https://faculty.uca.edu/rnovy/Clynes--Cyborgs%20and%20Space.htm).

etymology.historical_story: Cobblepot is familiar through Batman's adversary, the Penguin. etymology.historical_story: English clan comes from Scottish Gaelic clann, meaning children or offspring. The family association helps explain its use for groups identified through shared ancestry. In modern multiplayer games, the same English word also names organized player groups. That gaming sense describes cooperation and membership rather than descent; Malay translations must therefore follow the context. [Scots dictionary](https://dsl.ac.uk/entry/dost/clan), [Supercell usage](https://support.supercell.com/clash-of-clans/en/articles/joining-a-clan-3.html)

etymology.historical_story: Chelsea's place name is commonly traced to an Old English expression referring to a landing place for chalk. The riverside settlement later lent its name to other institutions and personal names. Chelsea Football Club was founded in 1905, giving this local London name an international sporting identity familiar far beyond the district itself. [Local history](https://www.inchelsea.co.uk/heritage); [club history](https://www.chelseafc.com/en/history).

etymology.historical_story: In Malaysia, a familiar roadside fruit called buah ceri may belong to Muntingia calabura, a tropical American species, rather than the Prunus trees producing supermarket cherries. This shared name offers a useful cultural lesson: everyday fruit names can cross botanical boundaries. English cherry in conversation therefore needs context, while standard Malay uses ceri. [MyBIS botanical account](https://www.mybis.gov.my/art/193).

etymology.historical_story: Craig belongs to a Scottish naming tradition associated with rocky landscapes. The Scots word craig, related to Gaelic creag, denotes a crag or cliff and appears in numerous place names. That background helps explain the personal name, but its landscape association is historical: in a Malay sentence, Craig ordinarily identifies a person. [University of Glasgow glossary](https://swap.nesc.gla.ac.uk/database/?page=2&search=&view=list)

etymology.historical_story: Colorado comes from a Spanish word meaning reddish or colored red. The United States Geological Survey records that Congress chose the territorial name in 1861, probably after the Colorado River. Malay retains the geographical name as a whole, so its Spanish meaning does not become a Malay adjective. [USGS: State of Colorado](https://edits.nationalmap.gov/apps/gaz-domestic/public/gaz-record/1779779)

etymology.historical_story: English corps comes from French corps, meaning a body or organized group, ultimately from Latin corpus, ‘body’. The image is collective: many people function as one body. English retains the French spelling, including silent final letters in the singular. In standard Malay, the corresponding military term is kor. [Sources: Merriam-Webster](https://scrabble.m-w.com/dictionary/corps), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=kor).

senses.zh_definition: 肤浅的；指知识、认识或思考缺乏深度。

senses.nuances: 由空间上的浅引申为认识上的不深入，通常带批评意味。pengetahuan cetek 不等于完全无知；也不宜直接译为愚蠢。参见 [DBP：cetek](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=cetek)。

etymology.historical_story: Cetek connects physical depth with intellectual depth. A river can be cetek because its water is shallow; knowledge can be cetek because understanding does not go far beneath the surface. Both meanings are recorded by DBP. etymology.historical_story: Neil Gaiman explained that Coraline came to him when he mistyped Caroline and kept the unexpected result. He later discovered earlier uses of Coraline, including a Victorian song, so he had not invented the name itself. His English character's name ends like wine, while other bearers may use an ending like een. [Gaiman's account](https://journal.neilgaiman.com/2003/06/death-coraline-and-oh-whats-word-for.asp).

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 姓名通常写作Cornelius。不能仅凭姓名推断一个人的国籍、族群或宗教。本条status沿用指定输出格式，不表示该姓名是DBP认证的马来语普通词。

etymology.historical_story: Cornelius began as the name of a Roman gens, or extended family, before becoming a personal name in later naming traditions. Christian usage helped carry it across languages. Its often-repeated connection with Latin cornu, meaning horn, is possible rather than certain. In Malay discourse, it identifies a person rather than conveying a literal horn-related meaning. [Onomastic reference](https://nvb.meertens.knaw.nl/verklaring/naam/Corn%C3%A9lis)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把Cornelius当作名牌上的完整姓名来记：看到Encik Cornelius，就想到“科尼利厄斯先生”，不要拆成马来语词根。

morphology.pattern_note: -lah 是附着于前词的强调语气助词，并非派生后缀；此处 suffix 仅表示后接位置。词根读音不变。资料包的爪夷文 چريتا 仅对应 cerita，未包含 -lah，按输入保留。

senses.zh_definition: 讲讲吧；说来听听。用于邀请、鼓励或催促对方叙述事情。
senses.en_definition: Tell me or us; go ahead and recount something, with encouragement or emphasis.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk ajakan atau suruhan supaya seseorang mengisahkan atau memberitahukan sesuatu, dengan penegasan partikel -lah.
senses.nuances: 本条解释整个表达式的动词用法，不将 cerita 的名词义直接移植过来。语调温和时表示鼓励，语调急促时可能带催促意味。马来语释义依据词根和助词功能综合编写，并非 DBP 对 ceritalah 的逐字独立释义。参见 [DBP：cerita](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=cerita) 与 [DBP：强调助词](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=penegas)。

etymology.historical_story: Ceritalah combines cerita, a story or account, with the attached particle -lah. Malay storytelling includes cerita rakyat, narratives passed orally between generations. In conversation, the same narrative vocabulary becomes an invitation to speak: the listener encourages another person to take a turn and share an experience. [DBP: cerita](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=cerita).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 cerita 想成一个故事，再接上轻轻一声 lah：故事开口了——“讲讲吧！”

morphology.pattern_note: 整词作为独立词素记忆，不拆成虚构的 cok- 和 -mar。音节按资料包读音补为 cok.mar；音节末 k 常实现为喉塞音 [ʔ]，即 [ˈt͡ʃoʔ.mar]。词族列出基本形式及完整重叠形式，重叠不属于加词缀。

word_family.gloss: 多支权杖或战棒，完整重叠形式

senses.zh_definition: 古代用作武器的沉重战棒，棒头带有尖刺。
senses.en_definition: A heavy fighting club with a spiked head; a mace.
senses.ms_definition: Sejenis batang besar dan berat yang kepalanya dibuat berduri-duri dan digunakan sebagai senjata.
senses.nuances: 此义在《Kamus Dewan》中标为古典文学用语 sl，常见于历史叙述、古典故事或兵器说明，不是普通手杖。词义依据：[DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=cokmar+)。

senses.zh_definition: 用于国会、王室或大学等正式仪式、象征权威或尊荣的雕饰金属权杖。
senses.en_definition: An ornamented ceremonial mace symbolizing institutional or royal authority.
senses.ms_definition: Sejenis batang daripada logam yang berukir indah, digunakan sebagai tanda kebesaran atau kekuasaan dalam upacara tertentu.
senses.nuances: 现代马来西亚公共语境中常指仪仗权杖。国会权杖象征王权及国会权威；大学也可在毕业典礼等仪式中使用权杖。它不等于 tongkat 普通手杖，也不等于 tongkat sakti 魔杖。参见 [马来西亚国会释义](https://www.parlimen.gov.my/index.php?action=20000&id=13&lang=bm&modload=glosari)及[马来亚大学权杖介绍](https://www.parlimen.gov.my/ipms/eps/2020-08-04/ST.64.2020%20-%20ST%2064.2020.pdf)。

etymology.historical_story: The word carries both battlefield and ceremonial associations: Malay dictionaries describe a heavy fighting mace as well as an ornate emblem of authority. Malaysia's parliamentary history records that the Malay rulers presented a mace to the legislative council in 1953. This gives the modern object a specific constitutional story beyond its older weapon meaning. [Source](https://repositori.parlimen.gov.my/bitstream/123456789/1285/1/2009%20-%20PARLIMEN%2050%20TAHUN.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 cokmar 记成一根头部特别醒目的重棒：古代用于战斗，仪式中则象征权威。

etymology.historical_story: Cadar belongs to a Persian-connected family of words for cloth coverings. Crawfurd's 1852 Malay dictionary already listed chadar, marked Persian, with meanings covering a sheet, mantle, and veil. Modern Malaysian Malay retains both bedding and clothing senses. The historical record illustrates that range, but does not establish the precise route by which the word entered Malay. See [Crawfurd's dictionary](https://wallace-online.org/converted/pdf/1852_Crawfurd_WS5.2.pdf).

morphology.pattern_note: 在马来语使用中作为英语借入名称整体记忆；英语内部由 China + town 复合而成，不是马来语词缀构词。地名通常写 Chinatown；音标采用英语标准读音。数据包未提供音节与爪夷文。

senses.zh_definition: 唐人街；以华人历史聚居、商业活动及文化设施为特色的城市街区。在吉隆坡语境中，常指茨厂街及周边地区。
senses.en_definition: An urban district associated with a historic Chinese community and its businesses and cultural institutions; in Kuala Lumpur, the Petaling Street area.
senses.ms_definition: Kawasan bandar yang dikaitkan dengan penempatan bersejarah, perniagaan dan warisan masyarakat Cina; di Kuala Lumpur, nama ini lazimnya merujuk kawasan Jalan Petaling dan sekitarnya.
senses.nuances: 数据包没有提供 DBP 释义；此处马来文为编写释义，不能视为 DBP 原文。Chinatown 是英语名称，马来语说明中可用 kawasan pecinan。吉隆坡的 Chinatown 不等于所有华人居住区，也不是中国境内的城镇。[马来西亚旅游局：Petaling Street／Chinatown](https://ebrochures.malaysia.travel/en/malaysia-travel-guide/kuala-lumpur/)

etymology.historical_story: Chinatown is an English compound joining China and town, used internationally for districts associated with Chinese communities. In Kuala Lumpur, the name evokes Petaling Street and nearby heritage streets. Tourism Malaysia describes a setting of shops, restaurants, hawker stalls, clan houses and temples. This local association gives the imported name a specifically Malaysian cultural setting. [Tourism Malaysia](https://ebrochures.malaysia.travel/en/malaysia-travel-guide/kuala-lumpur/)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: China + town：把华人店铺、会馆与庙宇连成一片街区，就是 Chinatown。吉隆坡语境联想到茨厂街。

morphology.pattern_note: 英语整词，在马来语交谈中可作为语码转换成分使用；规范马来语对应形式为 kredit。数据包的 syllables 值 sst 原样保留，但不是有效音节划分；英语形式通常划为 cred.it。status 按指定格式保留，不表示该英语拼写已获认定为规范马来语。

senses.zh_definition: 信贷；获准先取得款项、商品或服务而后付款的融资或赊购安排。
senses.en_definition: An arrangement allowing money, goods, or services to be obtained with payment deferred.
senses.ms_definition: Kemudahan pinjaman atau pembelian barang dan perkhidmatan dengan pembayaran yang ditangguhkan.
senses.nuances: 此处解释英语形式在马来语语境中的用法，马来语释义为编写性释义。正式马来语使用 kredit，如 kemudahan kredit、kad kredit。金融意义及规范拼写参见 [PRPM：kredit](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=kredit)。

senses.zh_definition: 账户内可供使用的金额，尤其指预付电话、电子钱包或平台账户中的可用余额。
senses.en_definition: An amount available for use in an account, especially a prepaid service account.
senses.ms_definition: Jumlah wang atau nilai yang tersedia untuk digunakan dalam sesuatu akaun, khususnya akaun prabayar.
senses.nuances: 口语中的 credit 常指电话预付余额，并不一定是借来的钱。正式马来语使用 kredit、baki kredit 或 baki prabayar。规范词义参见 [PRPM：kredit](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=kredit)。

etymology.historical_story: English credit ultimately comes from Latin credere, meaning to believe or entrust, through Italian and French. Trust connects its financial and social meanings: a lender trusts repayment, while an audience acknowledges a contributor. Malay uses the adapted spelling kredit; the spelling credit remains English when inserted into Malay conversation. Sources: [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/credit), [PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=kredit).

senses.nuances: 这是 cium 加 -lah 构成的语用形式，不是新增的独立词义。语气可以温柔、劝说或催促，取决于语调和关系；-lah 不保证句子一定礼貌。马来语中的亲昵动作也可能涉及鼻子轻触并吸闻头部或面颊。[DBP：cium](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=cium)

etymology.historical_story: The story of ciumlah is grammatical rather than a separate borrowing history: cium combines with the attached particle -lah. The root covers both smelling and kissing, senses that meet in affectionate gestures involving the nose, cheeks, and head. The particle shapes the speaker's invitation or insistence without creating a new lexical root. [DBP: cium](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=cium)

senses.zh_definition: 冷的；温度较低的；人感到冷的。标准马来语通常对应 sejuk，特定语境可用 dingin。
senses.en_definition: Having a low temperature, or feeling a lack of warmth.
senses.ms_definition: Kata bahasa Inggeris yang bermaksud sejuk atau berasa sejuk.
senses.nuances: 属于英语释义及马来语对译，不是 DBP 马来语词条释义。以下 ms 搭配提供标准马来语表达；英语对应形式见 en。参见 [Oxford：cold](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/cold_1)。

senses.zh_definition: 态度冷淡的；缺乏友善、亲切或情感温度的。
senses.en_definition: Unfriendly or showing little affection or emotion.
senses.ms_definition: Tidak mesra atau tidak menunjukkan kemesraan dan perasaan; dingin.
senses.nuances: 描述人际态度时通常译为 dingin 或 tidak mesra，不能机械套用温度义。参见 [Cambridge：cold 的人际态度义](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/cold?q=cold_1)。

senses.zh_definition: 寒冷；冷空气或低温环境。英语中通常为不可数名词。
senses.en_definition: Low temperature or cold weather, considered as a condition.
senses.ms_definition: Keadaan atau cuaca yang sejuk; kesejukan.
senses.nuances: 英语 the cold 表示寒冷环境，与 a cold“感冒”不同；此义的马来语表达须按句法选择 kesejukan、cuaca sejuk 等。

senses.zh_definition: 普通感冒；标准马来语通常对应 selesema。
senses.en_definition: A common respiratory infection typically causing a runny nose, sneezing, or a sore throat.
senses.ms_definition: Selesema biasa, iaitu jangkitan saluran pernafasan yang lazimnya menyebabkan hidung berair atau bersin.
senses.nuances: 英语通常说 a cold、have a cold 或 catch a cold。此义不是“身体觉得冷”，也不能把普通感冒与 influenza 当作同一种疾病。英语搭配参见 [Oxford：疾病用语与搭配](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/disease)。

etymology.historical_story: English cold continues Old English cald and belongs to the Germanic family, with relatives such as German kalt. In Malaysian conversation, it may enter an otherwise Malay sentence through code-switching. Its translation depends on meaning: sejuk for temperature, dingin for an unfriendly manner, and selesema for the illness. [Oxford word origin](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/cold_1).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: cold 看语境分三路：水冷用 sejuk，态度冷用 dingin，a cold 感冒用 selesema。

etymology.historical_story: Clinton belongs to English naming history rather than Malay derivational morphology. One documented account connects the surname with Glinton, formerly Clinton, in England. Its final element represents Old English tūn, meaning a settlement or farm; the first element remains uncertain in that account. This history does not identify which person or place an isolated corpus token denotes. [Etymonline](https://www.etymonline.com/word/Clinton)

etymology.historical_story: Cokelat belongs to the international family of chocolate words, with Dutch identified as its borrowing source in Indonesian lexicographic research. Its spelling also reveals a regional distinction: Indonesian retains the middle vowel, while Malaysian standard Malay uses coklat. The shared food name extends naturally to a drink, individual sweets, and the familiar brown colour.

etymology.historical_story: Crystal ultimately reflects Greek krystallos, meaning ice and rock crystal. The historical image linked clear quartz with permanently frozen water. Modern scientific usage instead concerns ordered internal structure, while commercial usage also includes fine glass. For Malay learners, these separate traditions explain why the English label may require either hablur or kristal in translation. [词源](https://www.etymonline.com/word/crystal)、[国际晶体学年资料](https://www.iycr2014.org/__data/assets/pdf_file/0006/88287/IYCr2014-02_008_etoiles_monde_inf_UK33_A0_Mini.pdf)。

etymology.historical_story: Carolina belongs to the name family associated with Carolus, the Latin form of Charles. The same connection appears in American place names: North Carolina's cultural agency traces the territorial name to Charles I's 1629 Carolana grant. In Malay, these names retain their identifying function rather than acquiring a new everyday lexical meaning. Sources: [name history](https://www.behindthename.com/name/carolina), [territorial history](https://www.dncr.nc.gov/blog/2016/10/30/originally-carolana-king-charles-i).

etymology.historical_story: In Spanish, cien is the shortened form associated with ciento, used in expressions such as cien libros, meaning one hundred books. That grammatical history belongs to Spanish, not Malay. Without an original sentence, identifying this familiar foreign form cannot establish what the packet’s token denotes or justify treating it as an official Malay word. etymology.historical_story: English change entered the language through French during the Middle English period. Its history connects alteration with exchange, helping explain why the same word can describe a revised plan, replacement clothing, or money returned after payment. In a Malay conversation, its appearance may reflect switching languages rather than an established Malay borrowing. Sources: [OED](https://doi.org/10.1093/OED/5725214838), [Oxford](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/change_1).

etymology.historical_story: Claudia is the feminine counterpart of Latin Claudius, a name associated with ancient Roman families. Its deeper history is sometimes connected with Latin claudus, meaning lame, but that connection is uncertain. In present-day use, Claudia identifies a person; its historical associations do not describe the bearer’s appearance, character, or abilities. [Source](https://www.etymonline.com/word/Claudia).

etymology.historical_story: Chitti, also written Chetti or Chitty, is a community name associated with Tamil trading ancestry. In Melaka, descendants of South Indian traders and local women developed a distinctive Peranakan identity. Their heritage combines local language and customs with Hindu traditions, making the name a marker of community history rather than occupation alone. [JKKN cultural account](https://pemetaanbudaya.jkkn.gov.my/en/senibudaya/detail/956).

etymology.historical_story: Conan belongs to the history of personal names rather than Malay affixation. Patrick Woulfe’s 1923 reference records the Irish form Conán and its use by several Irish saints. Modern fictional characters also bear Conan. These histories explain possible name contexts, but the lowercase packet alone cannot establish which person, character, or naming tradition supplied this occurrence. [Woulfe: Conán](https://www.libraryireland.com/names/men/conan-conan.php)

etymology.historical_story: Codex comes from Latin vocabulary associated with a block of wood and, subsequently, a book. Its history recalls the transition from writing rolls to books assembled from leaves. Malay uses the adapted spelling kodeks for this manuscript form, preserving the connection with the international vocabulary of book history. [DBP: kodeks](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=kodeks), [British Library](https://www.bl.uk/stories/blogs/posts/the-beginnings-of-the-codex).

etymology.historical_story: The English bird name entered Middle English through Old French cucu and imitates the bird's call. That sound association makes the word especially memorable in cuckoo clocks, where a mechanical bird announces the hour. In Malaysian material, however, the same spelling may instead identify the CUCKOO brand; context must determine the intended reference. [Oxford word origin](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/cuckoo_1)

etymology.historical_story: Calcutta preserves an older English rendering associated with the local name Kalikata. The city developed around settlements including Kalikata, Sutanuti, and Govindapur. Its official English name changed to Kolkata in 2001, reflecting Bengali pronunciation. The deeper derivation remains uncertain, so explanations involving the goddess Kali should be presented as proposals rather than established fact. [City history](https://www.kmrc.in/overview.php), [Getty place-name record](https://www.getty.edu/vow/TGNFullDisplay?english=Y&find=&nation=&place=&subjectid=7030776).

etymology.historical_story: English command reached its modern form through French, with an earlier Latin history involving entrusting and ordering. Its authority-related meaning later supplied a natural metaphor for computing: a user issues an instruction and a machine executes it. Malaysian technical conversation may retain the English word, while Malay documentation normally uses arahan. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=command)

senses.zh_definition: 感染疾病。

senses.ms_definition: Dijangkiti sesuatu penyakit.
senses.nuances: 这是感染义；不是说疾病像物体一样被接住。马来语通常用 dijangkiti 或 menghidap。

senses.zh_definition: 撞见或发现某人正在做某事，常指不当行为。
senses.en_definition: To discover someone doing something, often something improper.
senses.ms_definition: Mendapati seseorang sedang melakukan sesuatu, terutama perbuatan yang tidak wajar.
senses.nuances: 常见结构为 catch someone doing something；英语过去式为 caught。

collocations.zh: 发现某人正在作弊或骗人

collocations.ms: menangkap seseorang ketika sedang melakukan kesalahan

senses.zh_definition: 吸引并留住注意力；使人突然受到某种影响。
senses.en_definition: To attract attention or affect someone unexpectedly.
senses.ms_definition: Menarik perhatian atau memberikan kesan secara tidak disangka-sangka.
senses.nuances: catch someone's eye 是吸引目光；catch someone by surprise 是使人措手不及，二者不是实际抓取。

senses.zh_definition: 钩住、卡住或扣合；也指材料开始着火。
senses.en_definition: To snag, become engaged or fastened, or begin to burn.
senses.ms_definition: Tersangkut, tercantum atau terkancing; juga mula terbakar.
senses.nuances: 具体意思由搭配决定；catch fire 是固定搭配。门锁能否 catch，指能否扣合。

senses.zh_definition: 抽空观看、收听或短暂获得某种活动体验。
senses.en_definition: To manage to watch, hear, or briefly obtain an experience.
senses.ms_definition: Berkesempatan menonton, mendengar, atau memperoleh sesuatu untuk seketika.
senses.nuances: 常见于非正式英语，如 catch a film、catch some sleep；不能逐字译为 menangkap。

senses.zh_definition: 接住的动作；捕获物或一次捕获的数量。
senses.en_definition: An act of catching, or something caught and its quantity.
senses.ms_definition: Perbuatan menyambut atau menangkap; sesuatu atau sejumlah hasil yang ditangkap.
senses.nuances: 体育报道中可指一次接球，渔业语境中可指渔获。马来语对应词随场景变化。

senses.zh_definition: 表面有利的安排中隐藏的条件、难处或不利之处。
senses.en_definition: A concealed disadvantage or condition in an apparently attractive offer.
senses.ms_definition: Syarat atau kelemahan tersembunyi dalam tawaran yang kelihatan menguntungkan.
senses.nuances: What's the catch? 是询问暗藏什么条件，不必然指欺诈。

senses.zh_definition: 用于扣住门、窗或其他部件的小扣件。
senses.en_definition: A small fastening device that holds something closed or in position.
senses.ms_definition: Pengancing kecil untuk menahan pintu, tingkap atau bahagian lain pada kedudukannya.
senses.nuances: 是硬件名词，不能与表示渔获的 tangkapan 混译。

senses.zh_definition: 被认为是理想恋爱或婚配对象的人。
senses.en_definition: A person considered a desirable romantic partner.
senses.ms_definition: Seseorang yang dianggap calon pasangan yang sangat baik.
senses.nuances: 非正式英语评价语；直接用来评价当事人可能显得把人当成条件清单。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报：渔业报告译审
dual_scenarios.ms: Dalam laporan perikanan ini, perkataan Inggeris 'catch' diterjemahkan sebagai 'hasil tangkapan'.
dual_scenarios.zh: 在这份渔业报告中，英语词“catch”译为“渔获”。
dual_scenarios.en: In this fisheries report, the English word 'catch' is translated as 'hasil tangkapan'.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流：说明没听清
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Aku tak catch apa kau cakap tadi lah. Boleh ulang?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saya tidak dapat mendengar dengan jelas apa yang awak katakan tadi. Bolehkah awak mengulanginya?
dual_scenarios.zh: 你刚才说什么我没听清，能再说一次吗？
dual_scenarios.en: I didn't catch what you said. Could you say it again?
spoken_features: catch 是英语插入语，整句属于语码混用。
tak 对应 tidak，cakap 对应较正式的 berkata。
lah 表达语气；aku、kau 适合熟悉的同辈。

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku tak catch apa kau cakap tadi lah. Boleh ulang?
messages.ms_standard: Saya tidak dapat mendengar dengan jelas apa yang awak katakan tadi. Bolehkah awak mengulanginya?
messages.zh: 刚才没听清你说啥，能再说一遍吗？
messages.en: I didn't catch that. Could you say it again?

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku cakap kita jumpa kat stesen pukul enam je.
messages.ms_standard: Saya mengatakan bahawa kita akan berjumpa di stesen pada pukul enam.
messages.zh: 我就说咱们六点在车站见。
messages.en: I just said we're meeting at the station at six.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 熟悉且都懂英语的朋友之间可混用 catch。对客户、长辈或语言背景不明的人，说 Saya kurang jelas 或 Boleh ulang? 更容易理解。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 正式马来文应按语义选择 menangkap、menyambut、memahami、hasil tangkapan 等。英语引用可保留 catch，并清楚标示其语言身份。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 熟悉且都懂英语的朋友之间可混用 catch。对客户、长辈或语言背景不明的人，说 Saya kurang jelas 或 Boleh ulang? 更容易理解。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 正式马来文应按语义选择 menangkap、menyambut、memahami、hasil tangkapan 等。英语引用可保留 catch，并清楚标示其语言身份。

etymology.historical_story: Catch entered Middle English through Anglo-French forms connected with hunting. Its deeper ancestry includes Latin capere, meaning to take. The physical idea of seizing provides a useful bridge to modern expressions about receiving a ball, understanding speech, or attracting attention. This is English word history, not evidence of a Malay root. [Merriam-Webster: catch](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/catch)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 catch 想成“抓到”：手抓到球、耳朵抓到话、眼睛抓到画面。遇到具体搭配，再选择对应的马来语。

morphology.pattern_note: 英语整词，在马来西亚口语中常用于语码混用，不作马来语词缀拆分。输入音节值 sst 按要求保留，但不是有效音节划分；英语原词有两个音节。IPA 标示英语读法，本地口音可能不同。没有据此可确认的规范马来语派生词族。

senses.zh_definition: 盖住；用某物覆盖、遮挡或保护物体。
senses.en_definition: To put something over an object to conceal or protect it.
senses.ms_definition: Menutup atau melindungi sesuatu dengan meletakkan bahan atau benda lain di atasnya.
senses.nuances: 属于英语混用；规范马来语按语境用 menutup、menutupi 或 melindungi。以下马来语释义为编写释义，不冒称 DBP 马来语词条原文；PRPM 将 cover 列在英语词典栏目。[DBP 英马词典](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=cover)

collocations.en: cover the table with a cloth

senses.zh_definition: 临时代班；替别人承担工作或职责。
senses.en_definition: To temporarily perform another person's work or duties.
senses.ms_definition: Mengambil alih tugas seseorang untuk sementara waktu.
senses.nuances: 同事间很常见，通常表示协助代班，不必然表示永久接任。正式写作用 menggantikan、mengambil alih tugas 或 bertugas bagi pihak seseorang。

collocations.zh: 替朋友或同事顶班做事
collocations.en: cover a friend's or colleague's work

senses.zh_definition: 支付、承担费用；金额足以抵付某项开支。
senses.en_definition: To pay for an expense or provide enough money to meet it.
senses.ms_definition: Membayar atau menanggung sesuatu perbelanjaan, atau mencukupi untuk membayarnya.
senses.nuances: cover dulu 常指先垫付，不自动表示请客；是否需要还钱应结合上下文判断。规范表达为 membayar、menanggung kos 或 mendahulukan bayaran。

senses.zh_definition: 涵盖某个范围、项目或内容；保险保障某种风险或费用。
senses.en_definition: To include a subject, item, or risk within a particular scope.
senses.ms_definition: Merangkumi sesuatu perkara, bidang atau risiko dalam skop tertentu.
senses.nuances: 课程内容用 merangkumi 或 meliputi；保险语境用 melindungi、memberikan perlindungan 或 menanggung，须按实际含义选择。

senses.zh_definition: 掩饰或隐瞒失误、秘密、尴尬等；替别人打掩护。
senses.en_definition: To conceal a mistake, secret, or embarrassment, or shield someone from exposure.
senses.ms_definition: Menyembunyikan kesalahan, rahsia atau keadaan yang memalukan, atau melindungi seseorang daripada diketahui perbuatannya.
senses.nuances: cover line 是马来西亚口语表达，常指掩饰失言或尴尬。cover seseorang 也可能只是代班，不能脱离语境一概理解为包庇。

collocations.en: save face after a slip or awkward moment

senses.zh_definition: 采访、报道某项活动或事件。
senses.en_definition: To report on an event for the media.
senses.ms_definition: Membuat liputan tentang sesuatu acara atau peristiwa.
senses.nuances: 常见于媒体工作者之间的非正式交流；正式报道和任务说明宜用 membuat liputan 或 meliput。

senses.zh_definition: 封面、外罩或保护套。
senses.en_definition: An outer covering, protective case, or book or magazine cover.
senses.ms_definition: Bahagian luar atau sarung yang menutup dan melindungi sesuatu benda.
senses.nuances: 具体译词取决于物件：书刊封面用 kulit 或 kulit hadapan，手机保护套用 sarung telefon。不是所有 cover 都能译成 penutup。

senses.zh_definition: 由其他表演者重新演唱或演奏的歌曲版本；翻唱或翻奏作品。
senses.en_definition: A new performance or recording of a song previously performed by another artist.
senses.ms_definition: Persembahan atau rakaman semula lagu yang pernah dipersembahkan oleh penyanyi atau pemuzik lain.
senses.nuances: 音乐及社交媒体语境常见。buat cover 表示制作或表演翻唱版本；规范叙述可用 nyanyian semula、rakaman semula 或 versi nyanyian semula。

collocations.en: make a cover of a song

collocations.zh: 原声乐器伴奏的翻唱版本

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Dalam dokumen rasmi, perkataan 'cover' hendaklah digantikan dengan padanan bahasa Melayu yang sesuai dengan konteks.
dual_scenarios.zh: 在正式文件中，应根据语境，用适当的马来语对应词替换 cover。
dual_scenarios.en: In official documents, the word 'cover' should be replaced with a Malay equivalent appropriate to the context.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Esok aku nak pergi klinik. Boleh cover syif aku kejap tak?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Esok saya hendak pergi ke klinik. Bolehkah kamu menggantikan saya bertugas untuk sementara waktu?
dual_scenarios.zh: 我明天要去诊所，你能帮我顶一会儿班吗？
dual_scenarios.en: I need to go to the clinic tomorrow. Could you cover my shift for a little while?
spoken_features: nak 是 hendak 的口语形式。
kejap 是 sekejap 的口语形式。
boleh ... tak 构成口语是非问句。
cover 是英语与马来语混用；aku 适用于熟人关系。

messages.speaker: Farah (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Esok aku nak pergi klinik. Boleh cover syif aku kejap tak?
messages.ms_standard: Esok saya hendak pergi ke klinik. Bolehkah kamu menggantikan saya bertugas untuk sementara waktu?
messages.zh: 我明天要去诊所，你能帮我顶一会儿班吗？
messages.en: I need to go to the clinic tomorrow. Could you cover my shift for a little while?

messages.speaker: Amir (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Boleh je. Aku dah semak jadual, esok pagi aku lapang.
messages.ms_standard: Boleh. Saya sudah menyemak jadual dan saya mempunyai masa lapang esok pagi.
messages.zh: 可以啊。我看过排班了，明早我有空。
messages.en: Sure. I've checked my schedule, and I'm free tomorrow morning.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 熟人和同事间用 cover 通常自然；面对客户、上级或正式文件，应选择具体的马来语对应词。请求代班时用 Boleh tolong ...? 比直接命令更客气。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 涉及金钱时应说明是请客、垫付还是报销；涉及工作时应明确代班时段。正式场景中的例句以引述方式使用英语词，不将其当作已经确认的规范马来语词条。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 熟人和同事间用 cover 通常自然；面对客户、上级或正式文件，应选择具体的马来语对应词。请求代班时用 Boleh tolong ...? 比直接命令更客气。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 涉及金钱时应说明是请客、垫付还是报销；涉及工作时应明确代班时段。正式场景中的例句以引述方式使用英语词，不将其当作已经确认的规范马来语词条。

etymology.historical_story: English cover reached Middle English through French forms such as covrir, ultimately from Latin cooperire, meaning to cover completely. The physical idea of placing something over another object helps connect its later senses of protection and concealment. Malaysian conversational use also draws on English senses involving expenses, temporary duties, and music. [Dictionary.com](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/cover)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 cover 想成一把罩下来的伞：罩住东西、罩住费用，也能替同事撑住工作；具体含义看后面的对象。

morphology.pattern_note: 外语专名，整词记忆，不按马来语词缀拆分。正文通常大写为 Columbia；所列 IPA 为常见英语读法。未确认马来语派生词族，故保留空数组。

senses.zh_definition: 哥伦比亚：用于机构、地名或品牌等的英语专名；具体所指须由完整名称和上下文确定。
senses.en_definition: A proper name used for institutions, places, and brands, whose referent depends on context.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas bagi institusi, tempat atau jenama tertentu; rujukannya ditentukan oleh nama penuh dan konteks penggunaannya.
senses.nuances: 此为专名说明，不是已核实的 DBP 普通词释义。单独的 columbia 无法唯一确定实体；下列例句选用哥伦比亚大学这一明确所指。Columbia University 的历史及名称见[大学官方介绍](https://www.columbia.edu/content/university-history)。不要与南美国家 Colombia 混写。status 的 official 为指定数据标签，不表示 DBP 收录认证。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Universiti kami akan mengadakan seminar bersama penyelidik dari Universiti Columbia.
dual_scenarios.zh: 本校将与哥伦比亚大学的研究人员联合举办研讨会。
dual_scenarios.en: Our university will hold a seminar jointly with researchers from Columbia University.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Awak dah mohon masuk Universiti Columbia ke?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah awak sudah memohon untuk memasuki Universiti Columbia?
dual_scenarios.zh: 你已经申请哥伦比亚大学了吗？
dual_scenarios.en: Have you applied to Columbia University yet?
spoken_features: dah 对应标准语 sudah。
句末 ke 是非正式的是非问句标记。
mohon masuk 在口语中省略 untuk。

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Awak dah mohon masuk Universiti Columbia ke?
messages.ms_standard: Adakah awak sudah memohon untuk memasuki Universiti Columbia?
messages.zh: 你已经申请哥伦比亚大学了吗？
messages.en: Have you applied to Columbia University yet?

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Belum lagi, nak semak dokumen dulu.
messages.ms_standard: Belum lagi. Saya mahu menyemak dokumen terlebih dahulu.
messages.zh: 还没，想先检查一下材料。
messages.en: Not yet. I want to check my documents first.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 正式介绍学校或机构时，第一次出现应写完整名称，后文才在所指明确时简称 Columbia。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 保留专名大写。不能仅凭该词判断是在谈大学、地点还是品牌，也不应自动替换成国家名 Colombia。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 正式介绍学校或机构时，第一次出现应写完整名称，后文才在所指明确时简称 Columbia。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 保留专名大写。不能仅凭该词判断是在谈大学、地点还是品牌，也不应自动替换成国家名 Colombia。

etymology.historical_story: One documented example of this name is Columbia University. Founded as King's College in 1754, the institution reopened in 1784 as Columbia College after the American Revolution. Its official history explains that the new name emphasized a connection to the American continent. This institutional history does not identify every occurrence of Columbia in an unspecified corpus. [Source: Columbia University](https://www.columbia.edu/content/university-history).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Columbia 的 u 和 University 的 u 连起来，帮助记住大学名称；这是拼写记忆法，不是词源解释。

morphology.pattern_note: 英语整词借用，不作马来语词缀拆分。IPA 为英语标准读音；输入包未提供音节划分及爪夷文，保留 null。英语 crashed、crashing 不作为马来语派生词列入词族。

senses.zh_definition: 崩溃；电脑、软件或系统因故障突然停止正常运行。
senses.en_definition: Of a computer, program, or system: to stop functioning unexpectedly because of a fault.
senses.ms_definition: Berhenti berfungsi secara tiba-tiba akibat kerosakan atau ralat pada komputer, perisian atau sistem.
senses.nuances: 马来语科技口语中的英语借用。规范技术语可用 ranap；正式报告应说明故障对象及症状。崩溃不必然等于设备永久损坏，也不等于单纯运行缓慢。马来语定义为释义性改写。[DBP 科技词典](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=155028&keyword=crash)

senses.zh_definition: 系统崩溃事件；软件或电脑突然无法正常运行的一次故障。
senses.en_definition: An unexpected failure that stops a computer or program from functioning normally.
senses.ms_definition: Kejadian apabila komputer atau atur cara tiba-tiba gagal berfungsi dengan betul.
senses.nuances: 指故障事件，而上一义指发生故障这一动作。马来语技术交流可见 mengalami crash；正式用语可依对象写 ranap sistem 或 kegagalan aplikasi。[DBP 科技词典](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=155028&keyword=crash)

senses.zh_definition: 撞击；车辆猛烈相撞或撞上物体；飞机失事坠毁。
senses.en_definition: Of a vehicle or aircraft: to collide violently or suffer a destructive accident.
senses.ms_definition: Berlanggar dengan kuat atau mengalami kemalangan yang merosakkan kenderaan atau pesawat.
senses.nuances: 此为英语交通义在混合口语中的使用。规范马来语须按情境选择 berlanggar、terbabas 或 terhempas；这些词不能不分事故类型地互换。[Collins Dictionary](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/crash)

senses.zh_definition: 严重碰撞事故；车祸或飞机失事。
senses.en_definition: A violent collision or serious accident involving a vehicle or aircraft.
senses.ms_definition: Kemalangan yang melibatkan perlanggaran kuat atau terhempasnya pesawat.
senses.nuances: 在英语短语或混合口语中出现；正式马来语通常按具体事件用 kemalangan、perlanggaran 或 nahas。该义不表示所有轻微擦碰。[Collins Dictionary](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/crash)

senses.zh_definition: 暴跌；市场或价格在短时间内急剧下跌。
senses.en_definition: Of a market or prices: to fall suddenly and severely.
senses.ms_definition: Jatuh secara mendadak dan besar, khususnya tentang pasaran atau harga.
senses.nuances: 英语金融义的借用，程度强于普通下跌。规范马来语可用 merudum 或 menjunam，并以数据说明跌幅；不能仅凭短期小幅波动就称为 crash。[Collins Dictionary](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/crash)

etymology.historical_story: English crash has a history extending into Middle English, with senses involving breaking and violent impact. Its meanings also cover sudden financial collapse and computer failure. These meanings share the image of something functioning and then failing abruptly. In Malay technical conversation, the English form appears alongside the established Malay computing term ranap. [Collins Dictionary](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/crash) [DBP 科技词典](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=155028&keyword=crash)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 /kræʃ/ 想成猛烈撞击的“咔嚓”声：车撞了、程序崩了、市场垮了，都抓住“突然、严重地失去正常状态”。这是联想记忆，不是汉语词源。

etymology.historical_story: Personal names can enter a Malay text without becoming Malay vocabulary. Carrillo is documented as a surname, including in the Peruvian football federation's listing for André Carrillo. That evidence supports a possible name interpretation, but neither identifies this packet's intended referent nor establishes the surname's historical derivation. Original corpus context is needed before assigning a definitive entry.

etymology.historical_story: Conrad comes from an Old High German personal name combining elements meaning bold and counsel. The name travelled across European naming traditions and appears in English as both a given name and a surname. In a Malay sentence, it identifies a person; its historical components do not function as ordinary Malay words. [Etymological reference](https://www.etymonline.com/word/Conrad)

etymology.historical_story: DBP traces Malay komander to English commander, formed from command and the agent suffix -er. The English word therefore supplies the historical source, while Malay uses an adapted spelling. Remembering that distinction helps explain why an English label may appear in conversation but a Malay report normally uses komander.

etymology.historical_story: Corp. shortens the English word corporation. That longer word ultimately belongs to the Latin family of corpus, meaning body: an organization can be imagined as people forming one collective body. In Malaysian Malay texts, the abbreviation can remain inside an institution’s name, as in SME Corp. Malaysia. Its appearance there does not establish a separate Malay root. Sources: [Cambridge University Press](https://assets.cambridge.org/97810094/29177/excerpt/9781009429177_excerpt.pdf), [Malaysian Parliament](https://www.parlimen.gov.my/ipms/eps/2023-10-12/ST.179.2023%20-%20ST179.2023.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 Corp.，就把它展开成 corporation，想象一群人组成一个企业整体；缩略读音末尾的 /p/ 要保留。

etymology.historical_story: Several histories meet in this spelling. The furniture wheel and sugar sprinkler belong with caster, a formation from cast. English castor also has an older history connected with beavers, while castor oil names oil from Ricinus communis. Malaysian sugar labels preserve castor alongside caster and kastor, so context matters more than spelling alone. [Caster etymology](https://www.etymonline.com/word/caster), [Castor etymology](https://www.etymonline.com/word/castor)

etymology.historical_story: Cullen illustrates how one spelling can conceal several family histories. Irish examples may represent Gaelic names connected with a young hound or with holly. Scottish examples can derive from the place Cullen, while some English examples have another geographical source. A bearer's particular ancestry therefore cannot be recovered from the modern surname alone. [Dictionary of American Family Names](https://www.ancestry.co.uk/last-name-meaning/cullen)

etymology.historical_story: CSI compresses the English phrase crime scene investigation into three spoken letter names. Its use in Malaysia includes forensic science outreach: Universiti Putra Malaysia uses the label for an activity involving simulated crime solving and evidence analysis. This documents one local application of the initialism, while leaving other possible expansions dependent on context. [UPM](https://www.kjs.upm.edu.my/pendaftaran/english/diy-science-workshop-dsw/crime-scene-investigation-csi)

etymology.historical_story: Cairan is transparently formed from cair with the noun-forming suffix -an. Its dictionary meanings connect the result of making something liquid with the broader category of liquid substances. This is a useful example of overlapping Malay formations: cairan and cecair can share a referent, while cair names the relevant property. No speculative ancient origin is needed to explain the formation. [PRPM: cairan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=cairan)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: cair 是“液态、融化”，加 -an 后把性质变成可指认的东西：融化后流出来的那一份，就是 cairan。

senses.ms_definition: Paip atau pembuluh tempat asap keluar, misalnya pada kapal, kereta api atau kilang; serombong.
senses.nuances: 强调排烟功能，不泛指所有管道；与 serombong 近义。词义依据 [DBP《Kamus Dewan》](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=382696&keyword=cerobong)，此处马来文释义为展开缩写后的表述。

etymology.historical_story: A chimney gives this word a memorable cultural setting: smoke leaves a factory, locomotive, or ship through a dedicated passage. Malay dictionaries also record serombong as a synonym. They separately list cerobong as a kind of head covering, without establishing a shared origin. The available evidence does not justify a precise borrowing history. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=382696&keyword=cerobong)

etymology.historical_story: Older Malay dictionaries printed ch where modern spelling uses c, so chanda belongs to an earlier writing convention. Wilkinson recorded several distinct uses, including joking, indifference in a fixed expression, a boat fitting, and a compartmented box. These meanings should be distinguished rather than woven into one speculative origin story. [Historical dictionary](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/9/94/An_abridged_Malay-English_dictionary_%28romanized%29_%28IA_afu7967.0001.001.umich.edu%29.pdf)

morphology.pattern_note: 这是单位符号的组合，不是马来语词缀构词。读作完整单位名 sentimeter；所列 IPA 对应这一读法。输入中的 is_root 表示未作词缀分析，不表示 cm 是普通词根。

senses.zh_definition: 厘米的国际单位符号；一厘米等于百分之一米或十毫米。
senses.en_definition: The unit symbol for centimetre, equal to one hundredth of a metre.
senses.ms_definition: Simbol bagi sentimeter, iaitu unit panjang yang bersamaan dengan 0.01 meter atau 10 milimeter.
senses.nuances: cm 是符号，此处按其所代表的单位名归入名词。两个字母均须小写；数字与符号之间留空格，如 15 cm。符号不加复数词尾。DBP 明确列出这一用法：[PRPM：sentimeter](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=7120&keyword=sentimeter)。

senses.zh_definition: 输入释义所指的 Cm：化学元素锔的符号，原子序数为96；首字母必须大写。

senses.nuances: 本义保留输入资料的化学指向，但规范符号是 Cm，不能写成 cm；两者不是同一符号的可互换写法。下列搭配均保留正确大小写。[英国皇家化学学会：Curium](https://periodic-table.rsc.org/element/96/Curium)。

etymology.historical_story: The symbol cm belongs to the international metric tradition rather than Malay affixation. An 1879 international metrology resolution already listed cm for centimetre. Malay uses the name sentimeter while retaining the shared symbol. Capitalisation carries meaning: changing c to C produces Cm, the chemical symbol for curium, rather than a different spelling of the same unit. [BIPM resolution](https://doi.org/10.59161/CIPM1879RESF).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象米尺被分成100格：每小格是1 cm。小写 cm 量长度，大写开头的 Cm 才是锔。

etymology.historical_story: Chimera reaches English through Latin from Greek khimaira, a word meaning a female goat and naming the legendary composite monster. That combination of animal features supplied a powerful image for later meanings: an impossible fantasy and, in biology, an organism containing genetically different tissues. Malay biotechnology terminology uses the adapted spelling kimera for the biological concept. [Word origin](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/chimera), [Malay terminology](https://prpmv1.dbp.gov.my/Search.aspx?k=berlainan%3B).

etymology.historical_story: Carmichael began as a place name in Lanarkshire, Scotland, before becoming a surname. Its historical elements connect a Brittonic word for a fort with the personal name Michael. The name therefore preserves a landscape association rather than a Malay meaning. These historical elements are not productive Malay affixes. [Source: Sabhal Mòr Ostaig name guide](https://www3.smo.uhi.ac.uk/gaidhlig/faclair/cuspair/Ainmean_Pearsanta.pdf).

etymology.historical_story: English carrot travelled through Middle French carotte from Latin carota and Greek karōton. Its recorded English history reaches back to 1533. The familiar vegetable also supplied a figurative meaning: an attractive reward offered to encourage action. In Malay, the established everyday equivalent for the vegetable is lobak merah. [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/carrot), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=lobak+merah)

etymology.historical_story: Cello is a shortened form of the Italian violoncello. The longer name contains a diminutive attached to violone, a name for a large bowed string instrument. Its seemingly playful history therefore involves making a large instrument smaller in its name. Malay uses the adapted spelling selo. [Historical account](https://www.cello.org/Newsletter/Articles/celloetymology.htm).

etymology.historical_story: English catcher combines catch with the agent suffix -er, literally identifying someone or something that catches. Merriam-Webster records the word from the fifteenth century, so its general meaning predates modern baseball terminology. The sporting use narrows that broad idea to a particular player; Malay terminology supplies the equivalent penangkap. [Merriam-Webster: catcher](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/catcher); [DBP: penangkap](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=penangkap).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: catch＝接住，英语 -er＝做这件事的人：catcher 就是负责接球的捕手。

etymology.historical_story: Malay cili is recorded as a borrowing from English chili. Its familiar spelling illustrates Malay sound–letter correspondence: c represents the initial affricate heard in English chilli. In Malaysian kitchens, the word names an everyday ingredient and combines readily with labels such as padi, merah and kering to distinguish familiar culinary forms. See [Wiktionary: cili](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/cili).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 cili /t͡ʃili/ 与英语 chilli 连起来记：听到相近的声音，就想到一小碟辣椒。

morphology.formula: ∅ + cappella → cappella；马来语音乐术语使用完整形式 a cappella
morphology.pattern_note: 作为外来术语成分整体记忆，不拆成马来语词缀。所列 IPA 为意大利语源语读音，并非已核实的马来语标准音；未核实到马来语派生词，因此词族留空。

senses.zh_definition: 用于完整音乐术语 a cappella，指以无乐器伴奏的人声方式演唱，尤指合唱。
senses.en_definition: In the expression a cappella: with voices alone, without instrumental accompaniment.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam istilah a cappella, secara nyanyian tanpa iringan instrumen, khususnya nyanyian berkumpulan.
senses.nuances: 词性和释义适用于完整短语 a cappella。独立 cappella 在意大利语中指小礼拜堂，不宜直接当作马来语中表示无伴奏演唱的独立词使用。DBP 可核实的音乐术语为 a cappella；本条保留输入词头，但不据此认定独立 cappella 已获 DBP 收录。[DBP 音乐术语](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=a+cappella)

etymology.historical_story: The expression a cappella comes from Italian and evokes singing in chapel style. Its religious background survives in the name, but modern usage extends to secular choirs and popular vocal groups. The essential modern distinction is the absence of instrumental accompaniment, rather than the religious content of the song. [Oxford word origin](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/definition/english/a-cappella_1)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 a cappella 想成一座小礼拜堂里只有人声回响：没有吉他，也没有钢琴。记忆时连同前面的 a 一起记。

etymology.historical_story: Cute began in English as a shortened form of acute, referring to someone perceptive or shrewd. Its familiar meaning of attractive or endearing developed later, especially in American usage. The older cleverness sense survives in expressions such as “don't get cute,” explaining why the word can sometimes sound critical rather than affectionate. [American Heritage Dictionary: cute](https://ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=cute)

etymology.historical_story: Carney has an Irish surname history: the Dictionary of American Family Names identifies routes through Ó Cearnaigh and a shortened form of McCarney. Separately, lowercase carney is an English spelling variant of carny, meaning a travelling carnival worker. These are distinct lexical histories, so a person's surname should never be explained as an occupational label merely because the spellings match. See [surname reference](https://www.ancestry.co.uk/last-name-meaning/carney) and [Wordsmyth](https://www.wordsmyth.net/?ent_l=carny&rid=6308).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 姓氏读音可近似记作“卡尼”，把声音与具体人物绑定；大写 Carney 是姓氏，小写 carney 还可能是英语职业俗称。

etymology.historical_story: Cynthia comes through Latin from Greek Kynthia, meaning a woman associated with Mount Cynthus on Delos. In Greek mythology, the name served as an epithet of Artemis, whose birth was associated with that place. Its later use as a personal name preserves this geographical and mythological connection rather than a literal meaning of moon. [Collins](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/cynthia).

etymology.historical_story: English college developed through French and Latin collegium, a word for an organized association. Its older collective meaning survives in professional bodies and electoral colleges, while education became its most familiar setting. Malay uses the adapted spelling kolej. Remembering the original idea of a group helps explain why a college need not always be a school. [Etymology](https://www.etymonline.com/word/college), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=college)

etymology.historical_story: English coast reached Middle English through Anglo-French coste, ultimately from Latin costa, meaning a rib or side. etymology.historical_story: As a media name, CNN takes its letters from Cable News Network, launched on 1 June 1980 with round-the-clock television news. The shared spelling therefore reflects two separate naming histories rather than a single Malay word developing another meaning. etymology.historical_story: Clarke is a surname variant of Clark. Its English history connects it with a medieval term covering clerics, scholars, and writers, reflecting a society in which literacy and religious service often overlapped. Some Irish histories follow a different naming route. These origins explain the surname historically; they do not describe the occupation of a modern bearer. See [Clarke](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/clarke) and [Clark](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/Clark).

senses.zh_definition: 把一种物质加入另一种物质，或将两种以上的材料混合在一起。

senses.zh_definition: 把不同类别的事物或事务混在一起；将本应分别处理的内容混为一谈。

etymology.historical_story: Campurkan illustrates productive Malay word formation: the suffix -kan turns campur into a transitive form used to make things mix. Its dictionary meanings extend from combining ingredients to combining matters and adding numerical values. These connections provide a useful learning pathway, although they do not establish the historical order in which the meanings developed. [DBP dictionary entry](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=campur)

etymology.historical_story: The useful story here concerns spelling rather than a securely established ancient origin. DBP records cangkerang for an animal's hard shell and explicitly rejects cengkerang as the standard spelling. Its guidance also clarifies that a shell need not be empty: the term applies to the protective covering of a living animal too. [DBP guidance](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=cengkerang)

etymology.historical_story: Cambridge preserves a surprising reversal in naming. The river was originally called the Granta, and a bridge over it supplied the town's earlier name, Grantabridge. As the town's name developed into Cambridge, the river acquired Cam through back-formation. The modern place name therefore records a bridge, a river, and a later reinterpretation of their relationship. [Cambridge University Glossary](https://glossary.lib.cam.ac.uk/term/granta)

etymology.historical_story: Chai belongs to an international family of tea names ultimately associated with Chinese chá. Persian and South Asian forms connect this family across languages, while English commonly uses chai for a spiced milk tea. Urdu usage retains the broader meaning of tea. These connections describe borrowing history, not a Malay suffix added to cha. [Etymology reference](https://www.etymonline.com/word/chai); [Urdu dictionary](https://www.rekhta.org/urdudictionary?keyword=%DA%86%D8%A7%D8%A6%DB%92&lang=ur)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 从中文茶 chá 联想到 chai 的开头，再想象姜与豆蔻冒出的热气：记住它与茶有关；是否加香料，要看菜单是否写 masala。

senses.zh_definition: 用爪、指甲或手牢牢抓握的动作或力量；引申为物体接触表面的抓附力。
senses.en_definition: A firm grasp or hold, especially with claws or fingers; by extension, grip or traction.
senses.ms_definition: Pegangan atau genggaman dengan kuku atau cakar; cengkeraman.
senses.nuances: 通常比一般 pegangan 更强调牢固、抓紧或难以挣脱。轮胎、鞋底语境中的 cengkaman 表示抓地或防滑能力，是具体抓握义的延伸。[PRPM：cengkam](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=cengkam)

senses.zh_definition: 使人受压迫、受剥削或陷于痛苦而难以摆脱的控制或束缚。
senses.en_definition: Oppressive control or a harmful hold that restricts, exploits, or causes suffering.
senses.ms_definition: Kekuasaan yang menindas, memeras, menekan atau menyebabkan penderitaan.
senses.nuances: 具有明显负面色彩，可用于殖民统治、贫困或疾病等；不宜用来中性赞扬正常管理或领导能力。

etymology.historical_story: Cengkaman combines cengkam with the noun-forming suffix -an. Its physical image is a hand or claw holding something firmly. Malay extends that image to domination: colonial power, poverty, or illness can hold people in a figurative grip. The dictionary records both physical grasping and oppressive control, making the metaphor especially transparent to learners.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先想一只爪子紧紧抓住东西：cengkam 是抓，cengkaman 是那股抓握力；贫困或压迫也能把人这样牢牢困住。

morphology.formula: cetus + -kan → cetuskan；主动陈述形式：meN- + cetus + -kan → mencetuskan
morphology.pattern_note: root_word 保留输入值 cetuskan，但其词根实际为 cetus，因此 is_root 校正为 false。加 -kan 时 cetus 不变音；c 读 /tʃ/，e 读 /ə/。cetuskan 可用于祈使句及第二人称被动结构；口语也可省略主动前缀 meN-。

senses.zh_definition: 引发或激起某种事件、局面、情绪或灵感；祈使语境中表示“引发……；激发……”。
senses.en_definition: To spark, trigger or give rise to an event, situation, feeling or idea.
senses.ms_definition: Menimbulkan sesuatu keadaan, peristiwa, perasaan atau ilham dengan tiba-tiba.
senses.nuances: 可搭配积极或消极结果。普通正式主动陈述句用 mencetuskan，如 Cadangan itu mencetuskan perdebatan；祈使句可用 Cetuskan idea baharu。释义据 [DBP：cetus](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=cetus)。

senses.zh_definition: 使火花迸出；产生或迸射火星。
senses.en_definition: To produce or emit sparks.
senses.ms_definition: Mengeluarkan atau menerbitkan percikan atau bunga api.
senses.nuances: 这是与火花有关的实义，现代一般语境中不如抽象的“引发”义常见；不能据此把所有点火行为都称为 cetuskan。

etymology.historical_story: DBP records cetus as a sound associated with iron scraping stone and cetus api as a fire-lighting implement. The related verb mencetuskan covers both producing sparks and suddenly bringing about events or ideas. This gives learners a vivid bridge from a physical spark to a spark of inspiration, without claiming a documented chronology. See [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=cetus).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ce-tus 想成擦石时“嚓”的一下：火花迸出，点子或争端也随之被“引爆”；这是记忆联想。

morphology.pattern_note: 尚无可核实的标准马来语构词或读音，不能按马来语字母规则生造 IPA。电影引语中的形式须与规范爱尔兰语 cuisle、chuisle 区分。

senses.zh_definition: 外语引用形式：见于电影中的昵称短语 Mo Cuishle；不是已核实的标准马来语词。相关规范爱尔兰语名词 cuisle 有“脉搏、血管”等义，在特定短语中用于亲昵称呼。
senses.en_definition: A foreign spelling occurring in the film nickname Mo Cuishle, associated with Irish cuisle, meaning pulse or vein; not a verified standard Malay headword.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk asing yang terdapat dalam nama panggilan Mo Cuishle dalam filem; berkaitan dengan kata bahasa Ireland cuisle yang bermaksud nadi atau pembuluh darah. Tiada takrif rasmi bahasa Melayu yang dapat disahkan bagi ejaan cuishle.
senses.nuances: 词性 noun 仅对应所讨论的爱尔兰语名词，不代表已确立的马来语词性。电影形式可核实；将它与 cuisle 联系起来，是结合电影资料及爱尔兰语词典作出的判断。没有依据把 cuishle 单独定义成马来语“亲爱的”。以下是马来语讨论该拼写时的引用组合，并非已证实的高频词汇搭配。[AFI 电影资料](https://catalog.afi.com/Catalog/moviedetails/54369)；[爱尔兰语词典](https://www.teanglann.ie/en/fgb/cuisle)

etymology.historical_story: The spelling cuishle appears in the film nickname Mo Cuishle, recorded by the American Film Institute. Irish dictionaries instead list cuisle, with meanings including vein and pulse, and an affectionate expression involving the heart. This identifies a foreign cultural reference; it does not establish cuishle as a Malay borrowing.
