senses.zh_definition: 南亚计数单位 crore 的英语复数；每一 crore 等于一千万，即一百 lakh。货币语境中常指以一千万卢比为单位的金额。
senses.en_definition: Plural of crore: units of ten million, especially when expressing sums in rupees.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk jamak bahasa Inggeris bagi crore, iaitu unit bilangan bernilai sepuluh juta; dalam konteks wang, lazimnya digunakan untuk jumlah dalam rupee.
senses.nuances: 不是已核实的正式马来语词形。crore 是数量单位，本身不指定货币；两 crore 等于二千万。英语可说 crores of rupees，具体数词后也常用不变形式，如 two crore rupees。以下马来语搭配为解释性表达，未核实其语料频率。依据：[Merriam-Webster：crore](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/crore)、[Oxford：crore](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/crore)。

etymology.historical_story: English borrowed crore from Hindi and Urdu; Oxford traces its ancestry to Sanskrit koṭi. The word preserves a South Asian counting convention in which lakh and crore remain familiar large-number units. English adds the plural ending in crores, but Malay readers can translate the quantity directly: each crore represents ten million, regardless of the currency involved.

etymology.historical_story: Chopra is documented as a surname associated with Punjab, including Khatri and Sikh family traditions. The Dictionary of American Family Names describes its etymology as unexplained. Its appearance in Malay text therefore points to a person or family rather than a Malay lexical meaning. A precise ancestral story cannot responsibly be supplied. See [the surname dictionary entry](https://www.ancestry.ca/last-name-meaning/chopra).

etymology.historical_story: Cuaca belongs to the Sanskrit-derived vocabulary shared across Malay and Indonesian. The World Loanword Database connects it with Sanskrit svaccha, meaning transparent or clear, and associates the borrowing with early Indian contact. Modern Malaysian Malay uses cuaca broadly for weather, including rain and wind. Cuacanya adds the referential element -nya to this established word. [WOLD: cuaca](https://wold.clld.org/word/71261839694960202)

etymology.historical_story: The dictionary's semantic thread is separation: things can come apart, spouses can part, and a nursing child can stop breastfeeding. Malay builds a useful family around this root, including bercerai and perceraian. This shared image explains the connections among its meanings without requiring an unsupported story about a particular historical borrowing. etymology.historical_story: English caster belongs to the word family of cast, with the agent ending -er. Its established meanings include a person or thing that casts, furniture wheels, and a vehicle steering angle. Malaysian esports also uses caster for a commentator. These meanings require context; the packet does not identify which one produced its frequency ranking. See [Dictionary.com](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/caster) and [Majlis Belia Malaysia](https://belia.org.my/webinar-kerjaya-esports-pengulas-e-sukan/).

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries preserve two meanings that connect remembrance with affection: a keepsake and a beloved person. That pairing offers a cultural way to understand the word, although it does not establish which meaning developed first. Today, a small travel gift and a ceremonial presentation can both be called cenderamata, carrying the idea of someone being remembered.

etymology.historical_story: The English name chowder comes from French chaudière, meaning a kettle or its contents, ultimately connected with a Latin word for a cooking vessel. The name thus shifted from the pot to the food inside it. Modern usage includes seafood soups and similar vegetable soups, explaining the familiar name corn chowder. [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/chowder)

senses.zh_definition: 用来从孔洞、缝隙等处剔出东西的细片、小棒等工具。
senses.en_definition: A small implement used to pick or prise something out of a hole or crevice.
senses.ms_definition: Benda seperti bilah atau lidi yang digunakan untuk mengeluarkan sesuatu dari lubang.
senses.nuances: 名词义着重工具；现代日常表达也常用 pencungkil。cungkil gigi 指牙签，不是牙刷。[DBP：cungkil](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=cungkil)。

senses.zh_definition: 用工具把嵌住、黏附或藏在缝隙中的东西剔出、挖出或撬开。
senses.en_definition: To pick, dig or prise something out with an implement.
senses.ms_definition: Mengorek atau mengeluarkan sesuatu dengan alat pencungkil.
senses.nuances: 完整主动句通常用 mencungkil；cungkil 原形常见于命令句及口语。所指动作通常有探入缝隙或借力撬出的特点。

senses.zh_definition: 旧义：种痘；见于 mencungkil 等派生形式。
senses.en_definition: Historically, to inoculate against smallpox, in the derived form mencungkil.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam penggunaan lama, mencungkil bermaksud menanam cacar atau mencacar.
senses.nuances: 这是派生词保留的历史义，不是现代所有疫苗接种的通称。以下为历史释义组合，不属于现代高频搭配。[DBP：cungkil 的历史义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=cungkil)。

etymology.historical_story: The dictionary records cungkil as a picking implement and mencungkil as extracting something with it. The same physical image helps explain uncovering secrets or discovering talent: something hidden is brought out. Older entries also preserve a smallpox-inoculation sense. These records illustrate semantic range; they do not establish the word's earliest origin. [DBP entry](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=cungkil).

etymology.historical_story: Malay ring vocabulary preserves social meanings alongside physical shape. Cincin kahwin names a wedding ring, while cincin pertunangan marks an engagement. Dictionaries also record signet rings and the image of a ring paired with its gemstone. Cincinnya adds a possessor to this cultural object without specifying that person's gender. [DBP: cincin](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=cincin)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 cin-cin 的两个相同音节想成两枚圆环；末尾加 nya，就是“他／她的戒指”。记住拼写边界 cincin｜nya，两个 n 都要保留。

etymology.historical_story: Calcifer belongs to the fictional world of Howl’s Moving Castle, rather than to an established Malay word family. Malay readers encounter the name through discussion of the story and its film adaptation. Its association with a fire demon is documented, but that association alone does not establish the linguistic origin of the name. See [Disney D23](https://d23.com/a-to-z/howls-moving-castle/).

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 用于儿童表演者、参赛者或活动参与者时，通常带亲切或鼓励意味。对成年人使用，可能让人觉得被幼化或轻视。

etymology.historical_story: Cilik has a regional connection: the official Javanese–Indonesian dictionary also records cilik with the meaning 'small'. That parallel provides useful linguistic context, although it alone does not establish the exact borrowing route into Malaysian Malay. In Malay, DBP illustrates the word with child models wearing traditional clothing, linking smallness naturally with young participants. [KBJI](https://kbji.kemendikdasmen.go.id/kata/cilik), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=cilik).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ci-lik 的两个短音节联想成“小小两步”：小朋友迈步上台，就是 penyanyi cilik，小歌手。

morphology.pattern_note: 保留英语拼写，按整词记忆；末尾 e 不单独发音。音乐名词和表示亲近的形容词以 /s/ 结尾，表示关闭的动词以 /z/ 结尾。

senses.zh_definition: 【音乐术语】乐句或乐段的收束、终止，作用相当于音乐中的标点。
senses.en_definition: A musical cadence marking the ending of a phrase or passage.
senses.ms_definition: Istilah muzik bagi pengakhiran frasa atau bahagian muzik yang berfungsi sebagai penanda penutup; kadens.
senses.nuances: DBP 术语库收录此音乐义，不能据此把所有英语义都视为标准马来语义。以下搭配为音乐语境中的教学组合，不表示一般口语高频搭配。来源：[DBP 音乐术语](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=close)。

collocations.en: a cadence at the end of a phrase
the function of a cadence in music

senses.zh_definition: 【马英混用】关闭窗口、文件等；也可指结束某项事务。
senses.en_definition: In Malay-English code-switching, to shut something or bring an activity to an end.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam pertuturan bercampur bahasa Inggeris, menutup sesuatu atau menamatkan sesuatu urusan.
senses.nuances: 这是英语动词进入马来语会话的用法。正式马来语应依语境使用 tutup、menutup、tamatkan 或 menamatkan。英语动词读 /kləʊz/。来源：[Cambridge 英马词典](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english-malaysian/close)。

senses.zh_definition: 【马英混用】关系亲近、熟络的。
senses.en_definition: In Malay-English code-switching, having a close personal relationship.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam pertuturan bercampur bahasa Inggeris, rapat atau akrab dalam hubungan peribadi.
senses.nuances: 例如 kami memang close，表示彼此熟络。正式表达用 rapat 或 akrab；词本身不必然表示恋爱关系。此形容词读 /kləʊs/。英语词义参见：[Cambridge 英马词典](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english-malaysian/close)。

dual_scenarios.ms: Laporan bengkel itu menerangkan fungsi istilah close sebagai penanda pengakhiran frasa muzik.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该工作坊报告说明了 close 这一术语作为乐句结束标记的作用。
dual_scenarios.en: The workshop report explains how the term close denotes the ending of a musical phrase.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 同事交流；对应马英混用动词义
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Dah simpan fail tu? Kalau dah, close je.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Sudahkah awak menyimpan fail itu? Jika sudah, tutup sahaja fail itu.

dual_scenarios.en: Have you saved that file? If you have, just close it.

tu 是 itu 的口语形式。
je 对应 sahaja。
close 是句中的英语动词，读音以 /z/ 结尾。

messages.ms_spoken: Aku nak close fail ni. Kau dah simpan perubahan tadi?

messages.ms_standard: Sudah, tutup sahaja fail itu. Salinannya juga ada di dalam folder projek.
messages.zh: 存了，关掉吧。项目文件夹里也有副本。
messages.en: Yes, go ahead and close it. There's a copy in the project folder too.

etymology.historical_story: An English-looking word can enter Malay through different doors. DBP records close as a specialist musical term for a cadence, whereas everyday bilingual conversation can retain English close when discussing files or personal relationships. These uses belong to different registers: recognition of the musical noun does not automatically establish every English meaning as standard Malay. [Source: DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=close).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住结尾声音：关系 close、音乐 close 用 /s/；动手关闭 close 用 /z/。

morphology.pattern_note: 英语整词，在马来语夹杂英语的表达中使用，不按马来语词缀拆分；英语复数 chickens 的 -s 不属于马来语构词。

senses.zh_definition: 鸡；通常指人工饲养、供取肉或产蛋的家禽。
senses.en_definition: A domestic fowl kept for its meat or eggs.
senses.ms_definition: Kata bahasa Inggeris yang bermaksud ayam, iaitu unggas yang lazimnya diternak untuk mendapatkan daging atau telur.
senses.nuances: 属于英语词项；在标准马来语中用 ayam。以下搭配保留英语形式，用于理解菜单、标签及夹杂英语的交流。本条 status 为指定的词库记录状态，不表示 chicken 已获认定为标准马来语词。[DBP 英马对应词](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=115704&keyword=ayam)

senses.zh_definition: 鸡肉；作为食材或菜肴食用的鸡的肉。
senses.en_definition: The flesh of a chicken used as food.
senses.ms_definition: Kata bahasa Inggeris yang bermaksud daging ayam yang digunakan sebagai makanan.
senses.nuances: 英语中此义通常作不可数名词；马来语对应 daging ayam，菜名中通常直接用 ayam，如 ayam goreng。[Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/chicken)

senses.zh_definition: 胆小鬼；用来嘲笑或贬称缺乏勇气的人。
senses.en_definition: An informal, disparaging term for a coward.
senses.ms_definition: Sebutan bahasa Inggeris yang tidak formal bagi orang yang penakut atau pengecut.
senses.nuances: 这是英语口语义，可能出现在马来语夹杂英语的玩笑中；并非 ayam 的通用对应义。直接这样称呼别人可能冒犯对方。[Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/chicken)

senses.zh_definition: 胆怯的；因害怕而不敢做某事的。
senses.en_definition: Afraid or too timid to do something.
senses.ms_definition: Kata sifat bahasa Inggeris yang bermaksud takut atau tidak berani melakukan sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 限英语及夹杂英语的非正式表达。标准马来语可根据语境使用 takut、penakut 或 tidak berani。[Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/chicken)

dual_scenarios.ms: Perkataan bahasa Inggeris “chicken” pada menu itu hendaklah diterjemahkan sebagai “ayam” dalam versi bahasa Melayu.

dual_scenarios.en: The English word “chicken” on the menu should be translated as “ayam” in the Malay version.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Aku nak fried chicken je malam ni.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saya hanya mahu makan ayam goreng malam ini.

nak 对应 hendak 或 mahu；je 对应 sahaja；ni 对应 ini。
fried chicken 是嵌入马来语句子的英语食物名称。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku nak fried chicken je malam ni. Kau dah makan?
messages.ms_standard: Saya hanya mahu makan ayam goreng malam ini. Awak sudah makan?
messages.zh: 我今晚就想吃炸鸡。你吃了吗？

messages.ms_standard: Belum. Saya juga mahu dua ketul ayam goreng. Belilah di kedai yang biasa kita kunjungi itu.

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合英语菜单、商品名称和熟人间夹杂英语的交流。鸡肉名称本身不能说明食品是否符合清真要求，应依据实际食材、制作方式及相关标识判断。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 点餐时使用英语食物名称通常容易理解；正式马来语写作优先用 ayam。不要随意称陌生人、长辈或同事为 chicken。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合英语菜单、商品名称和熟人间夹杂英语的交流。鸡肉名称本身不能说明食品是否符合清真要求，应依据实际食材、制作方式及相关标识判断。

etymology.historical_story: English chicken goes back through Middle English chiken to Old English cicen, meaning a young chicken. Its modern uses include both the bird and its meat, alongside informal references to cowardice. In a Malay conversation, encountering the English spelling should therefore prompt a register check: the ordinary Malay equivalent for the bird or meat is ayam. [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/chicken)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把菜单上的 chicken 与 ayam 配成一组记：fried chicken = ayam goreng = 炸鸡；指人时则可能是在说“胆小鬼”。

morphology.pattern_note: -nya 是第三人称领属或回指成分，与前词连写；cahaya 的词形不变，ny 读 /ɲ/。数据包的 Jawi 是基词形式，完整词形为 چهايڽ。

senses.zh_definition: 它发出或反射的光；前文所指光源的光线。
senses.en_definition: The light emitted or reflected by the referenced source.
senses.ms_definition: Sinar daripada sumber yang telah disebut.
senses.nuances: -nya 通常回指太阳、灯、月亮等前文对象，不一定指人。各义项依据 [DBP：cahaya](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=107200&keyword=cahaya) 整理。

senses.zh_definition: 该物体，尤指黄金或宝石，呈现的光泽或闪光。
senses.en_definition: The lustre or sparkle of a referenced object.
senses.ms_definition: Kilauan pada benda yang telah disebut, seperti emas atau permata.
senses.nuances: 强调材质呈现的闪耀效果。宝石或金属的 cahayanya 不表示该物体必然自行发光。

senses.zh_definition: 某人面容呈现的光彩、神采或明朗气色。
senses.en_definition: The radiance or brightness of someone’s expression.
senses.ms_definition: Seri atau kejernihan pada wajah seseorang.
senses.nuances: 属于面容描写，多见于文学或带感情色彩的叙述。下列为自然描写用语，不能理解为人脸真的发光。

collocations.en: a face that has lost its radiance
a face whose radiance has returned

senses.zh_definition: 比喻某种信念、知识或真理带来的精神启迪与指引。
senses.en_definition: The spiritual or intellectual illumination something provides.
senses.ms_definition: Petunjuk atau penyuluh rohani daripada sesuatu yang telah disebut.
senses.nuances: 属于比喻义，常见于宗教、文学及励志表达；必须由上下文说明是什么带来了启迪。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Lampu baharu itu dipasang di pintu masuk kerana cahayanya dapat menerangi seluruh laluan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 入口处安装了那盏新灯，因为它的光能够照亮整条通道。
dual_scenarios.en: The new lamp was installed at the entrance because its light could illuminate the entire walkway.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Lampu ni okey, tapi cahayanya terang sangat lah.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Lampu ini baik, tetapi cahayanya terlalu terang.
dual_scenarios.zh: 这灯是不错，不过也太亮了吧。
dual_scenarios.en: This lamp’s fine, but it’s way too bright.
spoken_features: ni 是 ini 的口语形式。
terang sangat 在这里表示“太亮”。
lah 增添主观感受。
聊天中 cahayanya 也常换成 cahaya dia；本例保留目标词形。

messages.speaker: Mei (室友)
messages.ms_spoken: Lampu ni okey, tapi cahayanya terang sangat lah.
messages.ms_standard: Lampu ini baik, tetapi cahayanya terlalu terang.
messages.zh: 这灯是不错，不过也太亮了吧。
messages.en: This lamp’s fine, but it’s way too bright.

messages.speaker: Farah (室友)
messages.ms_spoken: Kalau nak, aku malapkan sikit je.
messages.ms_standard: Jika kamu mahu, saya boleh mengurangkan sedikit kecerahannya.
messages.zh: 你要的话，我调暗一点就好。
messages.en: I can dim it a little if you like.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 形容灯光时语气中性。称赞人的容光时，wajahnya berseri 通常比孤立地说 cahayanya 更清楚自然。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 可用于照明、摄影、珠宝和文学描写。宗教语境中的精神之光应按原文信仰背景理解；指上帝的领属形式在相关书写规范中通常写作 cahaya-Nya。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 形容灯光时语气中性。称赞人的容光时，wajahnya berseri 通常比孤立地说 cahayanya 更清楚自然。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 可用于照明、摄影、珠宝和文学描写。宗教语境中的精神之光应按原文信仰背景理解；指上帝的领属形式在相关书写规范中通常写作 cahaya-Nya。

etymology.historical_story: Cahaya belongs to the Sanskrit vocabulary that entered the Malay world through historical contact with India. The World Loanword Database connects it with chāya, encompassing shade, reflection, lustre, and light. In Malay, cahaya supports descriptions ranging from illumination to spiritual guidance. Adding -nya makes that light belong to, or refer back to, something already mentioned. [WOLD](https://wold.clld.org/word/71261839473147977)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 按 ca-ha-ya-nya 四拍记忆：前三拍 cahaya 是“光”，最后一拍 -nya 把光接回前文的“它”。

morphology.pattern_note: 沿用材料中的直接基础形式 cintakan，更基础的词为 cinta。-nya 在这里是第三人称附着代词，按模板归入 suffix，并非派生词缀；连接时不删音。c 读 /tʃ/，ny 读 /ɲ/。

senses.zh_definition: 爱他／她／它；对前文提到的人或事物怀有爱意。具体所指由上下文决定。
senses.en_definition: To love him, her, or it, with the referent supplied by the context.
senses.ms_definition: Mencintai orang atau sesuatu yang dirujuk oleh kata ganti nama -nya.
senses.nuances: DBP 将 cintakan 释为“cinta akan, mencintai”；完整形式 cintakannya 的释义是在此基础上结合 -nya 编写的。-nya 在这里表示爱的对象，不表示爱者，也不标示性别。规范说明文通常用 mencintainya；此形式可见于抒情表达和非正式交流。参见 [DBP：cinta](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=cinta)。

collocations.en: continue to love him or her

dual_scenarios.context: 文学评论 / 对白分析
dual_scenarios.ms: Dalam dialog tersebut, ungkapan “aku masih cintakannya” menunjukkan bahawa watak itu masih mencintai bekas pasangannya.
dual_scenarios.zh: 在这段对白中，“我仍然爱着他／她”这一表达说明，该角色仍爱着前任伴侣。
dual_scenarios.en: In the dialogue, the expression “I still love them” shows that the character remains in love with their former partner.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 朋友倾诉感情
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Aku masih cintakannya, tapi aku tak nak ganggu dia.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saya masih mencintainya, tetapi saya tidak mahu mengganggunya.
dual_scenarios.zh: 我还爱着对方，但我不想打扰人家。
dual_scenarios.en: I still love them, but I don’t want to bother them.
spoken_features: aku 用于亲近朋友之间的自称。
tak 对应 tidak，nak 对应 mahu。
cintakannya 带有抒情色彩，标准对应表达为 mencintainya。
-nya 不标示性别，英语可在性别未知时使用单数 them。

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku masih cintakannya, tapi aku tak nak ganggu dia.
messages.ms_standard: Saya masih mencintainya, tetapi saya tidak mahu mengganggunya.
messages.zh: 我还爱着对方，但我不想打扰人家。
messages.en: I still love them, but I don’t want to bother them.

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku faham. Bagi dia ruang dulu lah, jangan paksa dia balas mesej.

etymology.historical_story: English clock entered Middle English through a word associated with bells, reflecting the connection between timekeeping and audible signals. These are developments within English; their appearance in Malay conversation does not establish a separate Malay derivational history. etymology.historical_story: Cakaran makes the relationship between an action and its visible result easy to see. Its base, cakar, names a claw and also occurs in expressions connected with scratching. Adding -an produces a noun for what scratching leaves behind. The useful story here is morphological: a concrete bodily action becomes a lasting mark that someone can inspect or describe.

senses.zh_definition: 国际象棋中的将死：王受到攻击，且该方没有任何合法着法能够解除将军的局面。

etymology.historical_story: English checkmate reached its modern form through medieval French chess terminology, with roots in Persian transmitted through Arabic. The familiar explanation that the king is dead is less secure than the interpretation that the king is helpless. The word later extended beyond the chessboard to describe completely thwarting an opponent. [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/checkmate)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 /tʃek.meɪt/ 记成棋盘上的终结口令：王被将军，而且无路解围，才是 checkmate。

etymology.historical_story: Carver is transparently formed in English from carve and the suffix -er, which can name a person or an implement. The bilingual dictionary preserves both possibilities: an artisan and a meat-cutting knife. Its appearance in an English–Malay dictionary documents translation equivalents, rather than establishing adoption as a Malay word. In Malay, the corresponding choices are pengukir and pisau daging.

etymology.historical_story: Two distinct systems meet in this packet: ca names a Jawi letter, while Ca is a chemical symbol. Their similar spelling does not give them a shared origin. The element name calcium derives from Latin calx, meaning lime; Humphry Davy isolated the metal in 1808. Capitalization preserves the distinction in scientific writing. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=ca); [Royal Society of Chemistry](https://periodic-table.rsc.org/element/20).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 小写 ca 学字母，字形 چ 下有三点；大写开头 Ca 学化学，代表钙。

etymology.historical_story: English company came through French forms associated with companionship. Its deeper history connects it with Latin companion vocabulary and the idea of sharing bread. That social background helps explain why the modern English word can refer both to a business organization and to someone's welcome presence. [Source: Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/company).

etymology.historical_story: Cerun links everyday descriptions of steep land with the vocabulary of engineering. DBP records both the property of steepness and the sloping surface itself. Its relatives keep that distinction useful: bercerun describes land with slopes, while kecerunan names steepness or gradient. These sources establish usage, but do not establish a deeper historical origin. [DBP: cerun](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=132088&keyword=cerun)

etymology.historical_story: Catatkan belongs to the Malay family built around catat, the act of making a written record. Meeting minutes, attendance lists and personal reminders bring this family into everyday institutional life. The suffix -kan also supports writing something for another person, connecting an ordinary request with the social work of remembering. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=mencatatkan)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: catat 是“记”，加 -kan 后可放进请求：Tolong catatkan untuk saya——请替我记下来。

etymology.historical_story: English cook has a documented history independent of Malay. The noun comes through Old English cōc from Latin cocus, related to coquus, meaning a cook. This historical connection does not establish adoption into standard Malay. For this entry, the useful distinction is between an English word inserted into conversation and the Malay equivalents memasak and tukang masak. [Oxford: cook](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/cook_2)

etymology.historical_story: Cadang is best understood through its productive Malay family rather than an unsupported origin tale. Bercadang expresses intention, mencadangkan puts something forward, and cadangan names a proposal or reserve. These forms connect private plans with ideas offered to others. The dictionary documents these relationships, but they do not by themselves establish the root's earliest source or borrowing history.

etymology.historical_story: Catuan is transparently formed from catu with the Malay noun-forming suffix -an. DBP defines it by referring back to catu, a predetermined share of supplies. Its practical setting includes food distribution and restricted water supplies. The useful historical distinction is between the allocated share and pencatuan, the act of rationing; the consulted source does not establish an older borrowing origin. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=catu)

etymology.historical_story: Cox is an English shortening of coxswain, recorded from the middle of the nineteenth century. The shorter form names the person steering a rowing boat and also functions as a verb for doing that job. Its compact spelling belongs to English sporting vocabulary; it does not establish that the word has become a standard Malay borrowing. See [Oxford: cox](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/definition/english/cox_1).

etymology.historical_story: Carlisle preserves layers of northern Britain's linguistic history. Recorded forms include the Roman Luguvalium and later names containing the Brittonic element caer, associated with a fortified settlement. The surviving spelling reflects centuries of change rather than modern English word formation. Its deeper connection with an ancient personal or divine name has more than one interpretation. [Getty: Carlisle](https://www.getty.edu/vow/TGNFullDisplay?english=Y&find=&nation=&place=&subjectid=7010281)

etymology.historical_story: A prison room, a biological unit, an electrical unit, and a secret group share the English label cell. etymology.historical_story: Originally called Losantiville, the settlement was renamed Cincinnati in 1790 by Arthur St. Clair, governor of the Northwest Territory. The new name honoured the Society of the Cincinnati. That society took its name from the Roman figure Cincinnatus, remembered as a citizen who accepted military responsibility and then returned to civilian life. [City of Cincinnati: history](https://www.cincinnati-oh.gov/water/about/gcww-history/)

etymology.historical_story: English colt is recorded in Old English as a word for a young horse, although its deeper origin remains uncertain. Capitalized Colt also occurs as a firearms name associated with Samuel Colt. These histories do not establish a Malay borrowing: without the original sentence, the supplied lowercase token cannot reliably be assigned to either use. [Word history](https://www.etymonline.com/word/colt).

etymology.historical_story: Candice belongs to an English naming tradition and is recorded as a spelling variant of Candace. Its appearance in a Malay sentence can simply identify a person, without making it a Malay common noun. The useful cultural distinction is between a name's historical relationships and the spelling and pronunciation chosen by its bearer. [Source](https://www.behindthename.com/name/candice).

word_family.gloss: 哭泣；英语现在分词或动名词

senses.zh_definition: 哭；因悲伤、疼痛、喜悦等情绪而流泪。
senses.en_definition: To shed tears because of emotion or pain.
senses.ms_definition: Menangis akibat emosi atau kesakitan.
senses.nuances: 这是英语动词；标准马来语通常用 menangis。马来语句中出现 cry 可属于语码转换，不能据此标为正式马来语词。以下 ms 搭配提供标准马来语对应表达，en 提供含目标词的英语搭配；排名仅沿用输入资料。[英语释义：Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/cry)

senses.zh_definition: 大声喊叫；高声呼喊或说出。
senses.en_definition: To call out or utter something loudly.
senses.ms_definition: Berseru atau melaungkan sesuatu dengan kuat.
senses.nuances: 常见于英语叙事及 cry out 等结构；这个义项不要求流泪。马来语可根据语境译为 berseru、menjerit 或 melaungkan。[英语释义：Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/cry)

senses.zh_definition: 喊声、叫声或鸣叫声；也可指求助、抗议等呼声。
senses.en_definition: A loud vocal sound or an expressed appeal.
senses.ms_definition: Jeritan, laungan, bunyi haiwan atau seruan.
senses.nuances: 人类发声、动物鸣叫和比喻性的呼声须按上下文区分。英语名词复数为 cries；马来语对应词随发声者及意图变化。[英语释义：Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/cry)

senses.zh_definition: 一阵哭泣；一次哭泣的过程。
senses.en_definition: A bout of weeping.
senses.ms_definition: Satu tempoh atau episod menangis.
senses.nuances: 常见于 have a cry 等英语表达，指一次哭泣经历。a good cry 指痛快地哭一场，并非评价哭泣表现好坏。[英语释义：Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/cry)

etymology.historical_story: English cry entered Middle English through French crier, associated with calling out loudly. Its history helps explain why modern English uses the same word for shedding tears and for a shout. A cry for help may therefore concern a voice rather than tears. This is an English word history, not evidence of an established Malay borrowing. [Source: Etymonline](https://www.etymonline.com/word/cry)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 cry /kraɪ/ 和“哭出来”的声音连起来，再记两条对应：流泪用 menangis；喊叫则按情境用 berseru 或 menjerit。

etymology.historical_story: Cherevin illustrates how personal names can enter a language corpus through translated entertainment without becoming ordinary vocabulary. Paramount identifies Viktor Cherevin as Kenneth Branagh's character in the 2014 film Jack Ryan: Shadow Recruit. That establishes one cultural reference, but it does not establish the surname's historical derivation or prove which person the supplied token denotes. See [Paramount](https://www.paramount.com/movies/jack-ryan-shadow-recruit).

etymology.historical_story: DBP describes cenderahati as a counterpart to the longer-established cenderamata, associated with expressing sincerity in giving. Its cultural force lies in remembrance and appreciation, rather than the price or durability of the object. A small practical gift and a ceremonial plaque can therefore serve the same social purpose: keeping a relationship warmly remembered. [DBP usage history](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=cenderahati)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住末尾的 hati（心）：礼物不一定贵，心意留得住；cenderahati 就是表达心意的纪念品。

etymology.historical_story: Costello illustrates how surnames can cross languages without becoming ordinary vocabulary. The Dictionary of American Family Names records an Irish history through Mac Oisdealbhaigh, together with Americanized forms of Italian and South Slavic surnames. Consequently, the spelling can suggest several historical routes, but it cannot establish which route belongs to an unidentified person in a Malay text. [Source](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/costello)

etymology.historical_story: English Cyclops came through Latin from Greek Kuklōps, traditionally explained as “round-eyed.” Greek stories describe different groups of these giants: some forged weapons for gods, while Polyphemus appears in Homer’s Odyssey. The biological genus Cyclops also evokes the conspicuous central eye of these tiny aquatic animals. These are foreign and scientific uses, not evidence of Malay derivation. [Oxford](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/cyclops), [AMNH](https://www.amnh.org/explore/ology/ology-cards/282-cyclops), [TERMIUM Plus](https://www.btb.termiumplus.gc.ca/tpv2alpha/alpha-eng.html?i=&index=frr&lang=eng&srchtxt=CYCLOPS)

Similarity to Clara, Clarice or Clarissa alone cannot settle the origin of this exact occurrence. Preserve the spelling and confirm pronunciation with the bearer. etymology.historical_story: The name cactus travelled through Latin from Greek kaktos, originally a name for a prickly Mediterranean plant rather than the American plants now associated with it. Its history shows how botanical names can move between different plants. For Malay learners, the practical distinction is spelling: English cactus corresponds to standard Malay kaktus. See [Missouri Botanical Garden](https://mobot.org/mobot/latindict/keyDetail.aspx?keyWord=Cactus) and [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=kaktus).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到英语 cactus，就联想到马来语 kaktus：同一种植物，两种语言的拼写；马来语用 k，不用 c。

morphology.pattern_note: 在马来语混用语境中按英语整词处理，不把字母 c 按马来语 /tʃ/ 朗读。所列 IPA 是英语英式读音；英语内部可分析为 cut + -er，但不是马来语词缀构词。[Cambridge 发音](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/pronunciation/english/cutter)

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合熟人、文具店或工作现场中双方都理解该英语名称的交流。正式马来语清单宜按实际工具写 pemotong 或 pisau pemotong；引用商品原名时可保留 cutter。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 借用工具可说 Boleh saya pinjam…?，归还时道谢即可。与不熟悉英语名称的人交流，改说 pisau pemotong 更清楚。

etymology.historical_story: Cutter is an English word associated with cutting, and DBP's English–Malay dictionary gives pemotong for its tool sense. In a Malay conversation, retaining cutter represents English vocabulary within Malay speech. For learning purposes, treat it as a whole imported label, while using pemotong or pisau pemotong when a Malay equipment description is needed.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记英语 cut＝切，再联想 cutter＝切东西的工具；在马来语文具场景中，对应 pisau pemotong。

word_family.gloss: 多门课程；多道菜；多个路线

senses.zh_definition: 围绕某一科目或技能安排的一系列课程或培训。
senses.en_definition: An organized series of lessons or training sessions.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa Inggeris, siri pelajaran atau latihan yang disusun bagi sesuatu bidang; padanan bahasa Melayu ialah kursus.
senses.nuances: 马来语口语中可见英语 course 的混用；正式马来语采用 kursus。具体是单门课还是完整学习课程，须看院校制度。此释义不是 DBP 对 course 的官方马来语释义。参见 [Cambridge](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/course)。

senses.zh_definition: 行进的方向、航向或经过的路线。
senses.en_definition: A direction of travel or a path followed.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa Inggeris, arah pergerakan atau laluan yang dilalui oleh kapal, pesawat, sungai dan sebagainya.
senses.nuances: 对应马来语 haluan 或 laluan；不能使用课程义的 kursus。参见 [Cambridge](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/course)。

senses.zh_definition: 事情的发展过程，或为达到目的而选择的行动办法。
senses.en_definition: The progression of events, or a chosen way of acting.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa Inggeris, perjalanan sesuatu peristiwa atau cara tindakan yang dipilih.
senses.nuances: course of events 侧重过程；course of action 侧重行动方案。应依搭配翻译。参见 [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/course)。

senses.zh_definition: 一餐中分开端上的一道菜或一个用餐阶段。
senses.en_definition: A separately served part of a meal.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa Inggeris, satu bahagian hidangan yang disajikan secara berasingan dalam sesuatu jamuan.
senses.nuances: 此处 course 不是课程；main course 通常译为 hidangan utama。参见 [Cambridge](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/course)。

senses.zh_definition: 用于某项体育活动的场地或规定赛道。
senses.en_definition: An area or route used for a sporting activity.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa Inggeris, kawasan atau laluan yang digunakan untuk kegiatan atau pertandingan sukan.
senses.nuances: 具体译为 padang、litar 或 laluan；golf course 的常用马来语对应词是 padang golf。参见 [Cambridge](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/course)。

senses.zh_definition: 按计划连续进行的一轮治疗或用药疗程。
senses.en_definition: A planned series of treatments or doses.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa Inggeris, siri rawatan atau pemberian ubat yang ditetapkan untuk suatu tempoh.
senses.nuances: 这是词义说明；具体治疗安排须由医护人员确定。参见 [Cambridge](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/course)。

senses.zh_definition: 砖、石等建筑材料砌成的连续水平层。
senses.en_definition: A continuous horizontal layer of masonry.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam istilah pembinaan bahasa Inggeris, satu lapisan mendatar bata, batu atau bahan binaan yang seumpamanya.
senses.nuances: 属于建筑专业义，与课程或路线无关。参见 [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/course)。

senses.zh_definition: 迅速流过、奔流或快速穿行。
senses.en_definition: To flow or move rapidly through or over something.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa Inggeris, mengalir atau bergerak dengan deras melalui sesuatu tempat.
senses.nuances: 这是英语动词用法，常见于较正式或文学性的描述；不是马来语动词。参见 [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/course)。

senses.zh_definition: 在英语固定短语 of course 中表示“当然；自然”。
senses.en_definition: In the fixed phrase of course: naturally or certainly.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam ungkapan tetap bahasa Inggeris of course, bermaksud sudah tentu atau sememangnya.
senses.nuances: 本义属于整个短语 of course，不能把单独的 course 普遍解释为“当然”。口语也可能把 of course 缩略为 course。参见 [Cambridge](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/course)。

etymology.historical_story: English course came through Anglo-French from Latin cursus, associated with running, movement and progress. A path through space offers a useful connection to its senses involving travel and organized sequences. In Malay, however, translations must follow context: a course of lessons is kursus, while a ship follows a haluan. See [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/course).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 course 想成一条按顺序走完的路线：学习有课程，船只有航线，一餐有上菜顺序；英语词义相关，马来语译法分别选择。

morphology.pattern_note: 英语整词，在马来语混用语境中保留英语身份；c 读 /k/、s 读 /z/，不按马来语 c 的 /tʃ/ 音逐字拼读。

word_family.gloss: 堂表亲关系；英语派生词
堂表亲般的；英语形容词

senses.zh_definition: 堂兄弟姐妹或表兄弟姐妹；通常指伯叔姑舅姨的子女，不区分性别、长幼或父母一方。
senses.en_definition: A child of one's aunt or uncle; a first cousin.
senses.ms_definition: Sepupu, iaitu anak kepada bapa saudara atau ibu saudara seseorang.
senses.nuances: 这是英语词。DBP《英马词典》给出的马来语对应词为 sepupu、saudara sepupu；在标准马来语中宜用 sepupu。中文须根据实际亲属关系细分堂／表、兄／弟／姐／妹。[DBP：cousin 与 sepupu](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=sepupu)

senses.zh_definition: 较远的旁系亲属；英语中也可比喻与某人或某物有共同来源或相似关系的对象。
senses.en_definition: A more distant collateral relative, or figuratively a related person, group, or thing.
senses.ms_definition: Saudara daripada cabang keluarga yang lebih jauh; secara kiasan dalam bahasa Inggeris, orang, kumpulan atau benda yang mempunyai pertalian atau persamaan.
senses.nuances: 这是英语扩展义，不能据此认定 cousin 已成为具有全部英语义项的标准马来语词。下列搭配保留英语短语；马来语可依语境译为 saudara jauh 或具有相近来源的对象。[Merriam-Webster：cousin](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/cousin)

collocations.zh: 近亲；关系或性质相近的对象

etymology.historical_story: English cousin came through Middle English cosin and Anglo-French forms from Latin consobrinus. Its history belongs to European kinship vocabulary, rather than Malay affixation. The everyday Malay equivalent is sepupu. In a mixed Malay sentence, retaining cousin therefore represents a switch to an English family term, while the surrounding grammar can remain Malay. [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/cousin), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=sepupu)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 听成“卡怎” /ˈkʌzən/：cousin 一词包办堂表兄弟姐妹；换成标准马来语就说 sepupu。谐音仅供记忆。

headword.status_note: official 仅保留为所要求的数据状态标签，不表示 chatter 是规范马来语词。此项是英语词，以下提供马来语对应表达；音标为标准英式读音。

morphology.pattern_note: 作为英语完整词干处理，不拆成马来语词素；末尾 er 不是此词中的施事后缀。下列词族属于英语，不是马来语派生词。

word_family.gloss: 爱絮叨的人；喋喋不休者
正在絮叨；正在连续作响

senses.zh_definition: 絮叨；喋喋不休地谈论琐事。
senses.en_definition: To talk continuously or rapidly about everyday or unimportant matters.
senses.ms_definition: Berceloteh atau bercakap berterusan tentang perkara remeh.
senses.nuances: 英语不及物动词。马来语通常用 berceloteh；较中性的闲聊可用 berbual-bual。下列 ms 搭配为马来语对应表达。参见 [Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=berceloteh)。

senses.zh_definition: 闲谈；絮语；连续不断、内容轻松或琐碎的谈话。
senses.en_definition: Continuous informal talk, especially about trivial matters.
senses.ms_definition: Celoteh atau perbualan berterusan tentang perkara ringan atau remeh.
senses.nuances: 英语中通常为不可数名词。可表示亲切热闹的谈话，也可带嫌烦或轻视意味，须结合修饰语判断。马来语对应词 celoteh 见 [Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=celoteh)。

senses.zh_definition: 连续发出短促的叫声或咯咯声；尤指鸟兽鸣叫，或牙齿因寒冷、恐惧而打战。
senses.en_definition: To make rapid repeated sounds, as animals calling or teeth knocking together.
senses.ms_definition: Mengeluarkan bunyi pendek berulang-ulang, seperti burung berkicau, monyet mengerih atau gigi bergelatukan.
senses.nuances: 马来语译法随发声主体改变，不能全部译为 berceloteh。牙齿作响用 bergelatukan，鸟鸣用 berkicau，猴叫可用 mengerih。参见 [Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=berceloteh)。

senses.zh_definition: 短促而连续的声响，如鸟的啁啾声、猴叫声或牙齿打战声。
senses.en_definition: A succession of quick repeated sounds made by animals or teeth.
senses.ms_definition: Bunyi berulang-ulang, seperti kicauan burung, kerih monyet atau gelatukan gigi.
senses.nuances: 这是声音本身的名词义，与表示发声动作的动词义区别。马来语采用具体声音名称。参见 [Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=kicauan)。

senses.zh_definition: 网络上的交谈、议论或交流信息。
senses.en_definition: Discussion or communication circulating online.
senses.ms_definition: Perbualan atau pertukaran mesej dalam talian.
senses.nuances: 英语媒体语境中的延伸义，不必然指无聊闲谈。马来语应按语境写 perbualan dalam talian 或 perbincangan di media sosial。参见 [Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/chatter)。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于英语学习、翻译或明确标注的英语引用。正式马来语文本应按具体义项采用马来语对应词；不要将其与聊天动词 chat、聊天者或聊天工具名称混为一谈。

etymology.historical_story: Chatter is an English sound-imitating word recorded in Middle English. Its history links quick animal noises with rapid human speech, making the movement from birdsong to incessant talking easy to picture. Malay translates these meanings with different words, including berceloteh, berkicau and bergelatukan, rather than treating chatter as a native root. See [Etymonline](https://www.etymonline.com/word/chatter).

etymology.historical_story: Crusoe entered literary history through Daniel Defoe's Robinson Crusoe, first published in 1719. Its protagonist survives a shipwreck and builds a life on an island, making the name strongly associated with isolation and resourcefulness. That cultural association helps readers recognise the reference, but it does not make Crusoe an established Malay common noun for a castaway. [University of Reading](https://collections.reading.ac.uk/special-collections/wp-content/uploads/sites/5/2020/04/English_DSE_2016_revision.pdf)

etymology.historical_story: Cimpanzi belongs to an international family of animal names ultimately connected with African languages. The American Heritage Dictionary traces English chimpanzee through Portuguese to Vili ci-mpenzi. That history helps explain the resemblance between the names, although it does not establish the immediate route into Malay. Learn the Malay form as one borrowed unit. [American Heritage](https://www.ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=chimpanzee)

etymology.historical_story: Cagaran has a transparent Malay structure: cagar plus the noun-forming suffix -an. DBP records cagar in connection with pledged property and advance payments, alongside verbs for offering security. The related forms organize a familiar transaction: someone pledges an asset, another party accepts it, and the asset serves as security. The cited entries do not establish an earlier borrowing history.

etymology.historical_story: Cliff continues Old English clif and belongs to a Germanic word family that includes Dutch klif. Its history belongs to English, while Malay supplies equivalents such as cenuram. This distinction matters in bilingual learning: encountering cliff in an English sign or a mixed-language conversation does not by itself establish a Malay borrowing. See [Oxford](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/cliff_1).

senses.ms_definition: Bertenaga dan giat, berkenaan dengan orang, tubuh atau otak.
senses.nuances: 强调身体或思维的活力，不等同于单纯没有疾病的 sihat。义项依据 [DBP《Kamus Dewan》](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=123312&keyword=cergas)。

senses.zh_definition: 动作迅速的；行动敏捷利落的。
senses.en_definition: Quick, brisk or agile in movement.
senses.ms_definition: Pantas atau cepat dalam gerakan dan tindakan.
senses.nuances: 可在 bergerak cergas 中作方式性修饰，表示迅速行动；这里强调动作速度，而非长期保持体能。

senses.zh_definition: 积极参与活动的；组织或团体运作活跃的。
senses.en_definition: Actively involved in activities; active in an organization or undertaking.
senses.ms_definition: Banyak menjalankan kegiatan atau melibatkan diri dalam sesuatu kegiatan.
senses.nuances: 常用于社团、体育及公共事务；描述参与程度，未必涉及身体强壮。

senses.zh_definition: 证券市场交易活跃的；买卖频繁的。
senses.en_definition: Active or brisk in trading, especially of a stock market.
senses.ms_definition: Menunjukkan kegiatan jual beli saham yang banyak.
senses.nuances: 财经语境用法；交易活跃不必然表示股价上涨。现代报道也常用 aktif 或 rancak。

senses.zh_definition: 火山处于活动状态的，仍有喷出蒸气或熔岩等活动。
senses.en_definition: Active, of a volcano that still emits steam or lava.
senses.ms_definition: Masih mengeluarkan wap atau lahar, berkenaan dengan gunung berapi.
senses.nuances: 词典收录的火山用法，日常较少见；现代科普中 gunung berapi aktif 更常用。不能据此把所有技术领域的 active 都译成 cergas。

collocations.zh: 仍处于活动状态的火山

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 属于中性、正面的标准词，适合学校、健康宣传和职场语境。称赞长者时可说 Beliau masih cergas，并配合尊称。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 属于中性、正面的标准词，适合学校、健康宣传和职场语境。称赞长者时可说 Beliau masih cergas，并配合尊称。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 鼓励运动时自然得体；谈及他人的身体能力，应避免以 cergas 为标准作贬低性比较。

etymology.historical_story: The deeper origin of cergas is not established by the supplied evidence. Its documented Malay meanings connect bodily energy with brisk movement and active participation. That same idea of activity extends to share markets and volcanoes. These extensions offer a useful cultural picture: a person, an institution or even a mountain can show signs of being active.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 cer.gas 的后半段 gas 联想成“加满动力”：身体有劲、脑子灵、行动快。此为记忆联想，并非词源。

morphology.pattern_note: 英语词组的首字母缩略形式，标准书写为 CPR，通常逐个读出英文字母；不是马来语词缀派生词。is_root 沿用原包，表示本条不再作词缀切分。

senses.zh_definition: 心肺复苏：针对心搏骤停实施的急救措施，以胸外按压维持血液循环，并按适用情况配合人工呼吸。
senses.en_definition: Cardiopulmonary resuscitation: an emergency procedure for cardiac arrest using chest compressions, with rescue breaths as appropriate.
senses.ms_definition: Resusitasi kardiopulmonari, iaitu tindakan kecemasan bagi henti jantung yang menggunakan tekanan dada untuk membantu peredaran darah, dengan bantuan pernafasan mengikut keadaan.
senses.nuances: 标准形式为大写 CPR；马来语全称为 resusitasi kardiopulmonari。它指急救程序，不是疾病、药物或电击除颤的同义词。此释义为术语概述，依据 [马来西亚卫生部社区 CPR 手册](https://www2.moh.gov.my/moh/resources/Arkib/MANUAL_CPR_UNTUK_KOMUNITI_KKM.pdf) 编写。

dual_scenarios.en: I want to sign up for the CPR class at that community centre.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 面向公众或跨部门沟通时，首次出现宜写全称 resusitasi kardiopulmonari (CPR)，之后再用缩写。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于急救培训、医疗沟通和公共安全宣传。讨论真实患者时，应尊重其隐私；描述实施 CPR 不等于宣称患者已成功复苏。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 面向公众或跨部门沟通时，首次出现宜写全称 resusitasi kardiopulmonari (CPR)，之后再用缩写。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于急救培训、医疗沟通和公共安全宣传。讨论真实患者时，应尊重其隐私；描述实施 CPR 不等于宣称患者已成功复苏。

etymology.historical_story: CPR comes from the initials of the English expression cardiopulmonary resuscitation. Malaysian health communication uses the Malay term resusitasi kardiopulmonari while retaining the internationally recognisable abbreviation. This pairing lets the same short label appear in training materials, workplace notices and clinical communication, even when the surrounding explanation is in Malay. See the [Ministry of Health community manual](https://www2.moh.gov.my/moh/resources/Arkib/MANUAL_CPR_UNTUK_KOMUNITI_KKM.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: C 联想 cardiac“心脏”，P 联想 pulmonary“肺”，R 联想 resuscitation“复苏”：心＋肺＋复苏。

morphology.pattern_note: 英语来源的专名，不按马来语词缀拆分；通常读两个音节。所列音标为英语读法，实际称呼宜遵从本人发音。

senses.zh_definition: 克拉伦斯：英语来源的人名，通常用作男性名字；在马来语文本中属于专有名词。
senses.en_definition: An English-origin personal name, traditionally masculine.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas orang yang berasal daripada bahasa Inggeris, lazimnya digunakan sebagai nama lelaki.
senses.nuances: 正常拼写为 Clarence，首字母须大写；输入的小写形式不构成另一个普通词义。具体指谁须根据上下文判断，不能仅凭名字推定国籍、族群或宗教。下列组合是称谓与指称用法，并非固定熟语。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 名字保留本人使用的拼写。不要因为名字来源于英语，就推断对方的宗教、母语或身份背景。

etymology.historical_story: Clarence developed as a personal name from a British royal title associated with Clare, a town in Suffolk. Behind the Name traces the title through Latin Clarensis and records its use as a given name from the nineteenth century. In Malay writing, it identifies a person rather than contributing an ordinary lexical meaning. [Source](https://www.behindthename.com/name/clarence)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 听到近似“克拉伦斯”，先想到一个人的名字；看到 Encik Clarence，就理解为“克拉伦斯先生”。

morphology.formula: ∅ + citadel → citadel（英语整词；不作马来语词缀拆分）
morphology.pattern_note: 这是英语名词，应按英语读音理解，词首 c 读 /s/。is_root 在此表示作为整体分析，不表示它是马来语本源词。现代英语中不宜把它机械拆成具有生产力的 cit- 和 -adel。

word_family.gloss: 城堡要塞；citadel 的英语复数

senses.zh_definition: 位于城市内、附近或制高点上的坚固要塞，用于控制、保卫城市，或在受袭时提供最后的防守据点。
senses.en_definition: A fortified stronghold in or near a city, often occupying a commanding position.
senses.ms_definition: Kubu pertahanan yang kukuh di dalam atau berhampiran bandar, lazimnya di kedudukan strategik untuk mempertahankan atau menguasai bandar tersebut.
senses.nuances: 这是英语词；此处马来语释义是解释性翻译，不是声称引自 DBP 的独立马来语词条。status 按所要求的模板保留，不表示已核实其为规范马来语借词。马来语可按语境译作 kubu 或 kota pertahanan。释义及英语发音参见 [Oxford：citadel](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/citadel)。以下 ms 项明确展示混合语言用法及马来语对应表达。

collocations.ms: citadel purba（campuran bahasa; padanan: kota pertahanan purba）
tembok citadel（campuran bahasa; padanan: tembok kubu）

senses.zh_definition: 比喻某种思想、制度、权力或活动受到牢固维护、集中发展的堡垒或重镇。
senses.en_definition: A stronghold of a particular activity, institution, belief, or form of power.
senses.ms_definition: Secara kiasan, pusat atau benteng yang kuat bagi sesuatu kegiatan, institusi, fahaman atau kekuasaan.
senses.nuances: 比喻义多见于英语书面语。马来语通常依具体意思译为 benteng、pusat 或 kubu kuat，不必保留英语原词。此义参见 [Merriam-Webster：citadel](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/citadel)。

collocations.ms: citadel ilmu（campuran bahasa; padanan: pusat keilmuan）
citadel kuasa（campuran bahasa; padanan: benteng kekuasaan）

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合英语地图、历史介绍和原文引用。作为普通名词时用小写；若属于机构、作品或建筑的正式名称，应保留其规定的大小写，且不能仅凭名称推断它是一座真实要塞。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 这是中性的历史建筑用语。面对普通马来语读者，首次出现时可写 kota pertahanan，并在括号内补充英语 citadel。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合英语地图、历史介绍和原文引用。作为普通名词时用小写；若属于机构、作品或建筑的正式名称，应保留其规定的大小写，且不能仅凭名称推断它是一座真实要塞。

etymology.historical_story: English citadel came through French citadelle from Italian cittadella, a diminutive meaning a little city. The architectural image is memorable: a compact fortified place associated with the larger city around it. English later extended the word to powerful institutions and intellectual strongholds. This is the English word's history, not evidence of a Malay borrowing. [Merriam-Webster：词源](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/citadel)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 citadel 联想到 city 里面的一座“小防卫城”：城市遇袭，退入城塞。这个联想符合词源，不是现代词缀拆分。

morphology.pattern_note: 英语原形，在马来语混合口语中可整词使用；音标表示英语读音，并非已核实的马来语规范读音。以下词族成员属于英语构词，不能当作马来语派生词。

word_family.gloss: 欢呼；正在加油，英语形式
欢呼了；曾为……加油，英语过去式或过去分词

senses.zh_definition: 〔英语；马来语混合口语〕以欢呼、喝彩等方式表达支持或赞许。
senses.en_definition: To shout encouragement, approval, or support.
senses.ms_definition: Bersorak untuk menyatakan sokongan, galakan atau pujian.
senses.nuances: 这是英语词的用法说明，不是马来语正式词条认证。规范马来语通常用 bersorak 或 memberikan sokongan。DBP 将 cheer 列于英马词典资料中：[Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=terhibur)。下列为混合口语搭配。

collocations.en: to cheer for the school team

senses.zh_definition: 〔英语；部分马来语团体活动语境〕表达团队口号和士气的加油喊话或助威表演。
senses.en_definition: A team chant or cheering routine expressing group spirit and support.
senses.ms_definition: Sorakan atau persembahan sorakan berkumpulan untuk menyatakan semangat dan identiti pasukan.
senses.nuances: 此处说明马来语活动报道中可见的英语插入用法，不把它认定为正式马来语借词，也不把每一次 cheer 都解释为完整啦啦队运动。实际使用例见：[马来西亚博特拉大学活动通讯](https://frsb.upm.edu.my/upload/dokumen/penerbitan/20241115160859SENSASI_46_FRSB_oktober.pdf)。

dual_scenarios.ms: Aktiviti yang dinamakan "cheer" dalam atur cara itu melibatkan sorakan berkumpulan untuk meningkatkan semangat peserta.
dual_scenarios.zh: 活动流程中称为“cheer”的环节，是通过集体助威来提升参与者士气。
dual_scenarios.en: The activity labelled "cheer" in the programme involved group chants to boost participants' morale.

dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Marilah kita bersorak untuk menyokong pasukan sekolah dalam perlawanan akhir nanti!

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)

etymology.historical_story: English cheer developed from Middle English chere, associated with the face or expression, through Anglo-French and Medieval Latin. Its meanings expanded toward mood, happiness, and vocal encouragement. In Malaysian Malay contexts, its appearance can reflect English code-switching, especially around sport and group activities; such use alone does not establish official Malay lexical status. Source: [Merriam-Webster: cheer](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/cheer).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 cheer 和球场上的一声“加油！”绑定；切换到规范马来语时，就换成 bersorak。

morphology.pattern_note: 整体词根，无可确认的马来语词缀。c 读 /tʃ/，ng 合读 /ŋ/，不是 /nɡ/；按词包分为 co.ngo 两音节。

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries preserve regional vocabulary as well as widely shared words. Kamus Dewan records congo with the label Jk, identifying Jakarta usage, and explains it as a thief or pickpocket. That label establishes a regional association, but does not establish an earlier source language or a borrowing date. The spelling alone gives no basis for connecting this word with the African name Congo.

word_family.gloss: 预防者；预防工具或物质

senses.zh_definition: 预防、阻止；采取措施使不良事件不发生，或阻止某种行为继续进行。
senses.en_definition: To prevent something undesirable from happening or to stop an action from proceeding.
senses.ms_definition: Menghalang atau mengusahakan supaya sesuatu kejadian atau perbuatan yang tidak diingini tidak berlaku atau tidak diteruskan.
senses.nuances: cegah 常见于祈使句、宣传标语及 cegah rasuah 等紧凑表达；完整的主动陈述句通常使用 mencegah。强调拦阻或预防，不保证已经消除根源。[DBP：cegah](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=cegah)。

senses.zh_definition: 制止、禁止；不让某人进行某种行为。
senses.en_definition: To forbid or restrain someone from doing something.
senses.ms_definition: Menegah atau menghalang seseorang daripada melakukan sesuatu perbuatan.
senses.nuances: 此义突出对人的行为加以约束，与预防事件发生的用法相关。常用结构为 mencegah seseorang daripada melakukan sesuatu；正式规章若要明确表达制度性禁止，也常用 melarang。[DBP：cegah](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=cegah)。

etymology.historical_story: The consulted DBP entry records cegah through the closely connected ideas of blocking, restraining and preventing. Its productive Malay family links personal action, mencegah, with prevention as an activity, pencegahan, and a preventive agent or instrument, pencegah. This explains its usefulness in public messaging without establishing an ancient origin or a particular donor language.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 听到 cegah，就想象伸手把坏事拦下：先拦住，才不会发生。

etymology.historical_story: DBP records com as a Kedah dialect adjective describing a displeased facial expression. Its dialect glossary also lists don with a similar meaning. These records establish regional usage, but they do not establish an earlier source language or historical derivation. The reliable cultural connection is therefore northern Malay speech, rather than a speculative borrowing story. [Source: DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=150348&keyword=masam+muka).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读 /tʃɔm/ 时想象嘴角一收、脸一板：com 就是“脸臭臭的”。这只是联想，不是词源解释。

morphology.pattern_note: 整词作为独立词素记忆；c 表示 /tʃ/，词尾 k 在常见马来西亚发音中实现为喉塞音 /ʔ/。派生 mencambuk 时，meN- 变为 men-，保留词根开头的 c。

senses.zh_definition: 鞭子；装有手柄、用于抽打或驱赶牲畜等的绳索状器具。
senses.en_definition: A whip consisting of a flexible lash attached to a handle.
senses.ms_definition: Alat berupa tali yang dipasang pada tangkai untuk menyebat atau menggerakkan binatang; cemeti.
senses.nuances: 指具体器具，近义词有 cemeti、sambuk。标准叙述中的“鞭打”通常用派生动词 mencambuk。不能在所有语境中把它与 rotan“藤条”视为同一种器具。释义依据 [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=cambuk)。

senses.zh_definition: 鞭策；促使人奋发、改进或采取行动的刺激因素，常指挫折、批评等带来的推动力。
senses.en_definition: A spur or stimulus that drives someone to greater effort or improvement.
senses.ms_definition: Sesuatu yang menjadi penggalak atau perangsang sehingga seseorang berusaha dengan lebih giat.
senses.nuances: 比喻义，语气通常比 dorongan 更强，常把不愉快的经历转化为行动动力；并不表示任何伤害性对待都是合理的。此义见 [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=cambuk)。

etymology.historical_story: Cambuk belongs to a vocabulary shared across regions connected by Indian Ocean exchange. A historical glossary traces it ultimately to Persian chābuk and records related forms in other languages. Malay also gives the physical whip a figurative role: an unpleasant experience can become the spur that moves someone towards greater effort. See [VOC Glossary](https://www.cortsfoundation.org/images/PDF/VOC_Glossary_Indonesia_V20180206_3.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 /tʃam.buʔ/ 想成挥鞭后突然收住的一声：实物是“鞭子”，转义是“催人前进的鞭策”。

morphology.pattern_note: 这是英语形式，不能按马来语 c＝/tʃ/ 的规则读作两个音节。所列 IPA 为英式英语读音；正式马来文通常按语义使用 kod 或 pengaturcaraan。

senses.zh_definition: 代码、代号或编码系统：用字母、数字或其他符号表示信息、身份或指令的约定形式。

senses.nuances: 本条记录英语词及其在马来语交谈中的语码转换，不将 code 标作官方马来语词形。以下 ms 搭配属于混合语体，正式写法分别为 kod pengesahan、kod promosi。词义及英语发音见 [Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/code)。

senses.nuances: 主要在英语固定短语或原文名称中遇到；并非每个 code 都应译为同一个马来词。以下 ms 字段保留混合语体中引用的英语短语。释义参见 [Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/code)。

senses.nuances: 这是英语动词用法；马来语混合口语中的 nak code 等结构不等于正式马来语构词。正式表达须按意思选择 mengatur cara、menulis kod 或 mengekod。参见 [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/code)。

etymology.historical_story: English code travelled through French from Latin codex, associated with wooden writing tablets and books. Its meanings developed from organized written rules to systems of symbols and computer instructions. In Malaysian conversation, speakers may retain the English spelling during language switching, while standard Malay uses kod. See [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/code).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: code 读成一个音节，c 发 /k/；看到软件、验证码或规则时，分别联想“程序代码、识别码、守则”。

senses.zh_definition: 喀戎：希腊神话中以智慧和教导英雄著称的半人马。
senses.en_definition: Chiron, the wise centaur of Greek mythology who taught several heroes.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas bagi sentaur dalam mitologi Yunani yang terkenal sebagai guru kepada beberapa orang wira.
senses.nuances: 这是专名义项，不是已有输入证据支持的DBP普通词条；马来语释义为编辑说明。不能仅凭小写形式chiron确定原文所指。神话人物及其与天体命名的关系见[NASA说明](https://nssdc.gsfc.nasa.gov/planetary/chiron.html)。

senses.zh_definition: 凯龙星：编号为2060的半人马类太阳系小天体，具有彗星活动。
senses.en_definition: Chiron, the Centaur object numbered 2060, which exhibits cometary activity.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas bagi jasad kecil Sistem Suria bernombor 2060, daripada kumpulan sentaur, yang menunjukkan aktiviti komet.
senses.nuances: 天文学专名，宜写成2060 Chiron以明确所指；不是冥王星的卫星Charon。其半人马类身份及彗星活动见[NASA资料](https://nssdc.gsfc.nasa.gov/planetary/chiron.html)。

senses.nuances: 这是车型专名，不应按神话人物或天体翻译。车名纪念Louis Chiron，并非直接以神话中的喀戎命名，见[布加迪官方命名公告](https://newsroom.bugatti.com/en/press-releases/the-new-bugatti-is-to-be-called-chiron-world)。

etymology.historical_story: Chiron connects several naming traditions. The astronomical object takes its name from the wise centaur of Greek mythology. Bugatti's car instead honours racing driver Louis Chiron. These distinct naming histories explain why an isolated occurrence cannot safely be assigned one meaning, pronunciation, or Chinese translation without context. [NASA](https://nssdc.gsfc.nasa.gov/planetary/chiron.html), [Bugatti](https://newsroom.bugatti.com/en/press-releases/the-new-bugatti-is-to-be-called-chiron-world)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先看搭档再记义：Achilles旁是喀戎，2060旁是凯龙星，Bugatti旁是跑车；三者不能混为同一个词义。

etymology.historical_story: In Malaysian public buildings, English space labels often appear alongside Malay descriptions. Sabah's railway department explicitly pairs Concourse with Ruang Legar on its rental information page. This provides a practical cultural connection: the English label helps visitors recognise signage, while the Malay phrase explains the shared circulation and gathering space.

etymology.historical_story: Star Trek's official account explains that Pavel Chekov joined the original series in its second season. His presence as a Russian crew member helped express a future of international cooperation during the Cold War. This explains the name's cultural prominence in television discussion; it does not establish the surname's linguistic origin or identify the supplied corpus occurrence. [Official character retrospective](https://www.startrek.com/news/best-of-pavel-chekov)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Chekov 与 Pavel、Enterprise 和《星际迷航》连接记忆；这是人物姓氏，不作马来语词根拆分。

morphology.formula: ∅ + co → co；化学符号规范写作 Co
morphology.pattern_note: 须区分方言词 co 与化学符号 Co：/tʃo/ 对应方言词的读法；化学符号在马来语讲解中通常读作元素名称 kobalt，不由字母 c 推导读音。两者均不按普通词缀规则派生。

senses.zh_definition: 钴的化学符号，规范写作 Co；钴的原子序数为27。
senses.en_definition: Co, the chemical symbol for cobalt, the element with atomic number 27.
senses.ms_definition: Simbol kimia bagi kobalt.
senses.nuances: 此项属于科学符号，pos 按指定字段近似标为 noun。必须写 Co；CO 表示一氧化碳。输入的小写词头仅保留索引形式，不应复制到化学式中。定义见 [DBP：co / Co](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=co)，元素资料见 [Royal Society of Chemistry：Cobalt](https://periodic-table.rsc.org/element/27/)。

senses.zh_definition: 试试；用于引导对方尝试某个动作的马来西亚北部方言表达，相当于标准马来语 cuba。
senses.en_definition: Try; a northern Malaysian dialect expression introducing a suggestion or request to attempt something.
senses.ms_definition: Cuba; bentuk dialek Kedah yang digunakan untuk mengajak atau menyuruh seseorang mencuba sesuatu.
senses.nuances: DBP 将小写 co 标为吉打方言，义为 cuba；相关北部方言词汇表也记录其引导请求的用法。这里按该功能标为 particle。它与钴的符号 Co 是两个不同项目。[DBP：北部方言 co](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=226380&keyword=Co)

etymology.historical_story: The packet brings together two unrelated forms: Co represents cobalt, while northern Malay co means cuba. Cobalt's name recalls German miners who blamed troublesome ores on kobolds, or goblins. This mining story explains the element name behind the symbol; it does not explain the Malay dialect word, whose deeper origin is not established here. [RSC](https://periodic-table.rsc.org/element/27/), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=co)

etymology.historical_story: Constance belongs to European naming history rather than Malay word formation. It derives from Latin constantia, meaning steadfastness or constancy. Medieval records document several related spellings, and the name entered England with the Norman Conquest. Its appearance in Malay writing therefore need not indicate lexical borrowing: a text may simply be naming a person. [Source: Dictionary of Medieval Names](https://dmnes.org/2018/1/name/Constance).
